main_text: Letybo® Botulinum Toxin Type A Letybo® Botulinum Toxin Type A Strength: 50units Size: 1 x 50units Form: Vial QuickFind Code: 37981b Cold Chain View Special Offers SIGN IN FOR PRICE Product Description Letybo® Botulinum Toxin Type A Letybo® contains the active substance botulinum toxin type A. It works by blocking nerve impulses to the muscles in which it has been injected. It prevents muscles from contracting, leading to a temporary paralysis. Letybo® is used in adults less than 75 years of age to temporarily improve moderate to severe vertical lines between the eyebrows, when their presence has a significant psychological impact on them. Letybo® is a white lyophilized powder for solution for injection provided in a clear glass vial with a rubber stopper and aluminium tamper-proof seal. Directions The recommended dose is 20 units divided into five injections of 0.1 mL (4 units). Each injection is given into the muscles above or between the eyebrows. Letybo® is for intramuscular use (IM use). After the solution is reconstituted, the vial must be used only for one session per patient. Any unused solution must be discarded, as explained after section 6 in the information for healthcare professionals. It is recommended to leave a minimum of 3 months between two treatments with Letybo®. Ingredients The active substance is botulinum toxin type A. One vial contains 50 units botulinum toxin type A produced by Clostridium botulinum. After reconstitution each 0.1 mL of the solution contains 4 units. The other excipients are human albumin and sodium chloride. description: Sunkeos Cell 15 Medical Device Formulated for The Treatment of the body Sunekos Cell 15 is a medical device that is formulated for the treatment of multiple areas on the body. These areas include the adipose panniculus in the abdomen, the gluteal-trochanteric, and the internal area of the knee as well as axillary pillars. Hyaluronic acid is a natural molecule that plays a key role in tissues, is naturally synthesised by the human body and is responsible for the visco-elastic properties but is affected by chronic inflammatory conditions which is associated with edematous fibrosclerotic panniculopathies known as EFPs. Sunkeos Cell 15 works to target and improve the appearance of skin and the skins quality including cellulite prone skin. Key Features Medical device made in accordance with Directive 93/42/ECC MDD Intended for use on of areas on the body, including the adipose panniculus in the abdomen, gluteal-trochanteric, the internal area of the knee and axillary pillars. Developed for professional use, focusing on cellulite prone skin appearance and quality concerns Treatment Areas Sunekos Cell 15 is suitable for the abdomen, gluteal-trochanteric area, thighs, abdominal site and hip. Key ingredients WFI-GRADE WATER, SODIUM HYALURONATE, GLYCINE, L-PROLINE, L-LEUCINE, L-LYSINE HCl, L-VALINE, L-ALANINE, SODIUM BICARBONATE, SODIUM Contraindications Proven hypersensitivity to the components. Do not use in patients with coagulation disorders or in the case of ongoing antiplatelet therapy. Local reactions may rarely occur, due to cases of hypersensitivity that appears with oedema, feelings of heat and/or itchiness. The reactions resolvevery quickly (maximum of two days); however,extremely rarely, episodes of infection may occur caused by the treatment type. Use the bottle/vial pair only during one, single session. Don’t repeat the treatment within 3 days of the previous treatment. Inform the patient on possible reactions/ contraindications before carrying out the treatment.

description: Advanced Polynucleotide HPT Training 10th SEPTEMBER 2026 TAMWORTH Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Description The Dermafocus Advanced Polynucleotide HPT® Training Course takes a deep dive into Polynucleotide HPT® and how the range can be used to treat bespoke and highly specific indications. Designed for practitioners already familiar with standard polynucleotide applications, this course is ideal for those looking to elevate their practice and confidently address new, advanced indications. This session will be led by an Expert Faculty member who is an advanced, exceptionally skilled trainer with years of hands-on experience and deep expertise in treating complex and challenging indications. Under their guidance, you will explore specialised treatment areas such as scarring, hands, neck, décolletage, and body using Plinest® and Newest® . Throughout the course, you’ll embark on a comprehensive learning journey that blends in-depth theoretical education with practical, hands-on training. With expert demonstration and support, you’ll gain the confidence and capability to utilise Polynucleotide HPT® products in innovative and impactful ways. By completing this course, you will have gained an extensive comprehension of Polynucleotide HPT® and their multifaceted applications. You'll be equipped to seamlessly integrate theoretical knowledge with practical expertise, driving enhanced patient outcomes. We're confident that you'll leave this course not only well-prepared but also inspired to excel in your professional journey. Get ready to elevate your understanding, refine your skills, and make a lasting impact in your field through the power of Polynucleotide HPT® science. Your journey starts here! * MODELS * This is a hands on event so you will have the opportunity to treat on the day. We ask that all practitioners treat each other, however if you would like to bring your own model, or you are not able to receive treatment, please make sure to speak to a member of the team in advance to make different arrangements. AGENDA -10:00am - 3:00pm Polynucleotide HPT® theory Live Demonstration LUNCH Hands on for delegates Q&A Includes 2 boxes of Polynucleotide product, one to use on the day and one to take away.

description: Croma Saypha Skincare Detox Mask 8 Pack Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description Description The serum within our Croma Detox Sheet Mask is composed of a unique blend of ingredients known to purify the skin and leave a smooth and radiant appearance. Calming and hydrating ingredients guarantee a gentle application without stripping the skin of its natural barrier. The sheet material is comprised of a mixture of bamboo fibres and charcoal which leave the skin feeling soft. The mask is the perfect addition to a regular skincare routine to remove dead skin cells and to purify the skin for a radiant skin complexion. Who should use the mask? Our Croma detox face mask is recommended for oily and combination skin as well as for skin with impurities, blackheads and spots. The integrated purifying complex is composed of bakuchiol, willow bark and magnolia leaf extract. Bakuchiol is known for being a strong antioxidant that helps to reduce sensitivity and soothe the skin. Willow bark extract is a natural source of salicylic acid that gently exfoliates Good to know Our detox mask is vegan and dermatologically tested. Step 4: After 15 minutes of relaxation, you can remove and discard the sheet mask. The excess serum can be massaged into your skin with gentle movements. We recommend using the mask in the evening to guarantee that the serum can be absorbed into the skin. Regular usage of the mask is recommended (1-2 per week). Ingredients purifying complex (composed by bakuchiol, white willow bark and magnolia leaf), charcoal powder, hyaluronic acid + POLY-y-glutamic acid, nutgrass Size and Care Info 8 pack

description: Fillmed JuveLook 50mg Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Description Juvelook is an Advanced Hybrid Dermal Biostimulator that combines the deep hydration of non-crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid with the collagen-restoring power of PDLLA microspheres—delivering radiant, firmer, and more youthful skin. Juvelook is a revolutionary biostimulator designed for subtle, natural-looking rejuvenation. It merges non-crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid for immediate hydration with Poly D,L-lactic Acid (PDLLA) microspheres to stimulate long-term collagen regeneration. This dual-action treatment improves skin tone, texture, and elasticity over time—without adding unnatural volume. With results that evolve gradually, Juvelook restores the skin’s glow, firmness, and smoothness, making it ideal for those seeking an enhanced but refined look. The updated JUVELOOK® with optimised reconstruction has been designed to support a more streamlined preparation process while maintaining the product’s performance and treatment characteristics. Reconstitution & Preparation Hand Mixing Method Add 6ml bacteriostatic saline to the JUVELOOK® vial. Withdraw the mixture into a syringe and express it back into the vial. Repeat this process 5 times. Hand mix by vigorous side-to-side shaking for 2 minutes. Inspect the product. If any powder or lumps remain, repeat the mixing process. Once fully dissolved, the product is ready for use. Vortex Mixing Method For clinics using a vortex mixer, the preparation process follows the existing vortex protocol, replacing the manual mixing stage with 5 minutes of vortex mixing before final inspection and use. Practitioners can choose between: Manual preparation using the recommended hand-mixing protocol. Vortex-assisted preparation using existing vortex devices and protocols. This flexibility allows clinics to select the preparation method that best suits their workflow and preferences. Key Benefits: Instant Hydration & Glow – HA plumps and moisturizes the skin right away Dual action: HA for immediate hydration + PDLLA for long-term collagen stimulation Results visible in 2–6 weeks; lasts up to 18–24 months Low particle size (20–40μm) = smoother injection, minimal clogging or trauma Approved by CE, FDA, KFDA; fully biodegradable into CO₂ and H₂O Ideal for delicate areas and superficial indications Can be micro needled How It Works: 1. Immediate Effect – HA hydrates and smooths skin instantly 2. Gradual Regeneration – PDLLA acts as a scaffold for collagen renewal 3. Lasting Transformation – Visible improvements develop over weeks and last 12–18 months Ideal For: Adults aged 25+ noticing signs of early aging Patients seeking subtle, progressive results Individuals avoiding volumizing fillers Recommended Treatment Areas Crow’s feet, forehead lines, perioral wrinkles Neck and décolletage Acne scars and enlarged pores Hands Technical Specs: Microsphere Size: 20–40 µm Injection Depth: Superficial to mid-dermis Duration: 12–24 months Reversible: Yes – HA with hyaluronidase; PDLLA can be reversed with RF/ultrasound energy Why Choose JUVELOOK? For patients who want natural, gradual skin enhancement without adding volume, Juvelook offers a science-backed solution that hydrates instantly and rejuvenates over time. Its unique formulation ensures subtle, radiant results with minimal downtime and maximum skin harmony. Gentle. Gradual. Glowing. Rejuvenate from Within. Ingredients (INCI) Water (Aqua), Sodium Hyaluronate, Poly D,L-lactic Acid, Sodium Chloride, Polysorbate 80, Tromethamine, Hydrochloric Acid

description: Fillmed Lenisna 200mg/vial Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Description LENISNA: Dual-Action Biostimulator for Structural Facial Rejuvenation. LENISNA is an advanced injectable that combines PDLLA and crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid for immediate lift, long-term collagen stimulation, and deep dermal rejuvenation—without surgery. LENISNA is an innovative injectable biostimulator that merges Poly D,L-lactic Acid (PDLLA) with crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid (HA) to deliver both immediate volumizing and long-term skin regeneration. Designed to restore facial structure, elasticity, and definition, LENISNA offers a minimally invasive alternative to surgery with results that can last up to 24 months. The updated LENISNA® with optimised reconstruction to provide a smoother and more efficient reconstitution process, offering greater convenience in clinical practice while maintaining the same collagen-stimulating benefits and treatment outcomes practitioners expect from LENISNA®. Reconstitution & Preparation Hand Mixing Method Add 6ml bacteriostatic saline to the LENISNA® vial. Hand mix by vigorous side-to-side shaking for 3 minutes. Withdraw the mixture into a 10ml or 20ml syringe. Attach a Baxter connector. In a second syringe, add either: 4ml bacteriostatic saline to achieve a total volume of 10ml, or 10ml bacteriostatic saline to achieve a total volume of 16ml. Mix between the two syringes 20 times. Inspect the product. If any powder or lumps remain, repeat the mixing process. Once fully dissolved, the product is ready for use. Vortex Mixing Method For clinics using a vortex mixer, the preparation process follows the existing vortex protocol, replacing the manual mixing stage with 5 minutes of vortex mixing before final inspection and use. Developed for patients experiencing facial volume loss, skin laxity and age-related structural changes, LENISNA® helps restore definition, firmness and facial harmony while maintaining natural-looking results. Key Benefits: Instant Volume & Lift: Crosslinked HA offers immediate contouring and hydration. Collagen Boosting: PDLLA microspheres stimulate long-term collagen production for firmer, more youthful skin. Long-Lasting Effects: Gradual results continue improving over 2–3 months and last up to 18–24 months. Safe & Biocompatible: Medical-grade biodegradable ingredients with a strong safety profile. Ideal for Key Structural Areas: Perfect for midface, temples, chin, jawline, and nasolabial folds. Minimally Invasive: Non-surgical solution with little to no downtime. How It Works: Immediate Action: Crosslinked HA fills and lifts target areas instantly. Progressive Regeneration: PDLLA microspheres remain in the dermis, gradually stimulating collagen synthesis. Sustained Results: A single treatment offers improvements that evolve naturally and endure for up to two years. Technical Specs: Main Ingredients: PDLLA Microspheres (40–60 µm), Crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid Injection Depth: Deep dermis or subcutaneous layer Target Areas: Cheeks, jawline, chin, temples, nasolabial folds Duration: 18–24 months Reversible: Contains HA, which can be dissolved with hyaluronidase Who Is LENISNA For? Adults aged 30+ seeking facial contour and skin elasticity Individuals with volume loss, sagging skin, or deep folds Patients looking for long-lasting, natural-looking lift without surgery Why Choose LENISNA? Stronger than traditional HA fillers and longer-lasting than standard biostimulators, LENISNA is ideal for patients who want powerful yet natural facial rejuvenation with fewer sessions and sustained benefits. Restore Volume. Redefine Beauty. Strong. Structured. Sophisticated. Ingredients (INCI) Water (Aqua), Sodium Hyaluronate (Crosslinked), Poly D,L-lactic Acid, Polysorbate 80, Sodium Chloride, Tromethamine, Hydrochloric Acidwith optimised reconstruction

description: HArmonyCa with Lidocaine 2 x 1.25 ml Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description HArmonyCa Achieve immediate volumizing results that improve over time with the new hybrid injectable dermal filler/collagen biostimulator, HArmonyCA, by Allergan. What is HArmonyCa? HArmonyCA is a new revolutionary injectable treatment with dual effects – designed to restore facial volume and also promotes the sustained generation of natural collagen formation, giving long lasting lifting and volumizing results. This latest product by Allergan provides immediate volumizing effects and contains cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid (HA), much like their other popular dermal filler range – Juvederm – but has a unique selling point in that the product also contains embedded Calcium Hydroxyapatite (CaHA) microspheres, which stimulates the body’s own production of collagen and elastin – improving the skin’s elasticity over time, even when the HA component has broken down. The Hyaluronic Acid element of this new collagen biostimulator product is naturally found in the body and elevates skin hydration and moisture, which is key to keep the skin looking plump and healthy and provides an immediate volumising effect. Calcium Hydroxyapatite generates a stable, inseparable gel that keeps the microspheres in the desired location, which minimises the risk of product migration and ensures a smooth appearance. CaHA is a biodegradable, biostimulatory soft tissue filler suitable for deeper folds and wrinkles, and encourages an increased natural formation of collagen and elastin within the skin to provide a sustained lifting effect. HArmonyCA also contains lidocaine to ensure a comfortable experience during the procedure. Size and Care Info 2 x 1.25ml

description: Novuma The Next-Generation CaHA Biostimulation 1.5ml Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description Novuma® is an injectable biostimulating gel developed using Advanced BioSphere Technology. It contains highly purified Calcium Hydroxyapatite (CaHA) microspheres at a high concentration (55–60% w/w) suspended in a Carboxymethyl Cellulose (CMC) gel carrier. The microspheres are designed to be perfectly smooth and round, providing strong collagen stimulation while helping limit inflammation. Novuma® is CE marked since 2020 and received MDR 2017/745 EU certification in 2025. It has been launched in more than 50 countries, with over 20,000 syringes injected worldwide since its introduction. The formulation was developed by experts in biomaterials. Novuma® responds to an increasing demand for treatments that offer more than filling lines. After the age of 45, loss of skin firmness becomes the primary aesthetic concern for women. Patients are looking for solutions that restore dermal density, rebuild facial structure and improve overall skin quality with natural and long-lasting results. Novuma® helps aesthetic practitioners address this need by providing sustained regeneration and visible clinical outcomes. Immediately after injection, Novuma® fills and lifts the treated area, providing a smoothing and plumping effect. The CaHA microspheres act as a scaffold within the tissue, activating fibroblasts and stimulating the production of new collagen. As the microspheres gradually degrade and are absorbed by the body, they leave behind a newly formed collagen network, restoring density and firmness to the skin. This regenerative process supports long-term results lasting up to 18 months, depending on treatment area and individual conditions. Novuma® is particularly suitable for addressing areas where ageing is most visible, including the face oval and cheeks, to redefine contours and improve skin density and smoothness. Key benefits include immediate lifting, progressive collagen stimulation, visible tightening, improvement of skin structure, firmer texture and long-lasting results. The product features low extrusion force and a homogeneous ceramic composition, making injection comfortable and controlled. It is supplied ready-to-use. Full application instructions are provided in the Instructions for Use. The composition of Novuma® consists of 55–60% Calcium Hydroxyapatite (solid bioceramic phase) and 40–45% Carboxymethyl Cellulose (viscoelastic carrier phase). Novuma® is designed to promote safe regeneration of tissue. Thanks to the Advanced BioSphere Technology, the CaHA particles support effective fibroblast activation while helping to control inflammation. Novuma® is intended for use by healthcare professionals only. Please refer to the Instructions for Use prior to application. Size and Care Info 1 x 1.5ml pre-filled syringe with sterile connector for dilution

description: Restylane Classyc Lido 1ml Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description Restylane is intended to be used for facial tissue augmentation. It is recommended to be used for the correction of wrinkles and for lip enhancement. Specifically designed for the correction of moderate facial wrinkles and for lip enchancement, Restylane has an intermediate gel particle size. It should be injected into the middle part of the dermis layer or in the submucosal layer of the lip. For facial areas with limited soft tissue support and soft tissue cover, e.g. the periorbital region, injection into the subcutaneous fatty tissue or supraperiostal administration are recommended. The addition of lidocaine provides a pain relieving effect during treatment Composition:- Stabilised hyaluronic acid 20 mg/mL Lidocaine hydrochloride 3mg/ml Phosphate buffered saline q.s. Indication: Cheeks. Disposable sterile 29G TW (thin-walled) needles are provided. In case a replacement needle is required a needle within the range of 29-30G should be used. Alternatively, a sterile blunt cannula 27-28G can be used. The size and the length of the cannula will affect the force needed to extrude the gel. If a thinner cannula is used the resistance during injection may be too high resulting in an increased risk for leakage or separation of the cannula and syringe. The same considerations are applicable for needles. Size and Care Info 1ml

description: Stylage Bi-Flex Hydro 1ml Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description STYLAGE ® HydroMax should not be injected superficially, but at a deeper level in the dermis as it can also be used to provide a light effect, as well as hydrating and rejuvenating the skin tissues. Just like with STYLAGE ® Hydro, it can be used as a complementary treatment with other STYLAGE ® products, and a treatment plan can be established with your practitioner to ensure the best results possible over several appointments. STYLAGE ® S was created to rehydrate the face, especially around the mouth area (for example, Smoker’s Lines), but also to treat light wrinkles that start to appear on the skin but have not become too deep. A veritable rejuvenating effect, this product helps gently smooth the skin for a refreshed look. Other indications that can be treated by STYLAGE ® S include the forehead and crow’s feet (smile lines around the eyes). On average, results are visible straight after injection and can last up to 12 months 2 . For more comfort during treatment, STYLAGE ® S is available with an anaesthetic* to numb the area being injected. Considered to be one of the most versatile products in the STYLAGE ® product range, STYLAGE ® M was created to fill regular skin depressions in the face for an authentic glow-up. It can be used to treat a number of indications in both men and women of any age and skin type. As well as filling wrinkles, this product also helps smooth the skin, with results being visible immediately after treatment. STYLAGE ® M is also available with an anaesthetic* to lightly numb the area during injection and help make the patient’s experience more pleasant. Some of the indications that can be treated with STYLAGE ® M include forehead, temples, nose, cheeks, nasolabial folds and marionette lines. Also considered a popular wrinkle filling and skin smoothing product amongst practitioners for their patients, STYLAGE ® L is a more volumizing gel than the STYLAGE ® S and STYLAGE ® M, as it helps treat deeper wrinkles and lines in ageing skin. If not treated right away, wrinkles will continue to mark the skin over time and a more volumizing product is needed to fill them as they become less superficial on the skin's surface. As well as being used to treat indications in the face, such as the nasolabial folds (smile lines around the mouth) and even the nose to hide a bump or lift the tip, STYLAGE ® L can also be used to bring back or add volume to the back of the hands. STYLAGE ® L is available with or without an anaesthetic* that quickly takes effect from the moment of injection, it consequently numbs the area and helps make the aesthetic treatment more comfortable for the patient. Created uniquely for the delicate and very sensitive area of the lips, STYLAGE ® Special Lips was the first product in VIVACY's product range 100% dedicated to the mouth and lip area. It is a gel that helps bring soft and subtle volume to the lips, whether they be a woman or a man. Once injected by a certified practitioner, the lips may look and feel a bit swollen, however the swelling will reduce within a few days, and the final results will be visible. Leaving a hydrated and subtle finish. Other indications in the lips that can be treated with STYLAGE ® Special Lips include more definition around the edges of the lips (contours), fine lines around the mouth (Smoker’s Lines), and of course, increased hydration to the area. An anaesthetic* is also available with this product as the lip area can be sensitive when injected. Following the treatment, results can last up to 12 months 2 . The newest product in the STYLAGE ® range, STYLAGE ® Lips Plus goes above and beyond to bring back or create volume in the delicate lip area. Though the product is more volumizing in nature than the STYLAGE ® Special Lips, after injection, the gel still feels soft and adapts perfectly to this area of the face. It can also be injected into the vermilion border (border of the red lip) in order to better contour and outline the mouth, leaving you with the perfect pout. While some other products in the STYLAGE ® range are available without anaesthetic*, STYLAGE ® Lips Plus is only available with a numbing aide for maximum comfort during and for some time after injection. The first product in VIVACY’s volumizing range is STYLAGE ® XL. Though it is slightly less viscous than the STYLAGE ® XXL, it still provides strong, long-lasting results to reduce the visible signs of ageing in the face. When it comes to facial ageing, it is not only wrinkles that betray our age. Over time, the face and the body go through both anatomical and functional changes, causing loss of volume, and consequently, facial sagging. STYLAGE ® XL is ideal for volume restoration, it can also provide light volume creation in patients of all ages. Some indications of this product include temples, cheekbones, jawline, and chin. It is available with an anaesthetic* for a more pleasant treatment with your certified practitioner. STYLAGE ® XXL is one of the most volumizing products. Due to its high elasticity 2 , it is able to respond perfectly to the mechanical pressures exerted on it after injection into the dermis. Another important characteristic is its high viscosity 2 , which makes it less prone to spreading within the tissues and is able to provide a strong, visible volumizing effect and projection that can last up to 18 months 2 . This product can help to sharpen cheekbones, improve the shape of the chin, fill sunken temples and define the facial oval. Thanks to VIVACY’s volumizing products, it is possible to redefine the facial contours, create volume where needed and restore volume to the most affected areas 3 . Once injected by a certified practitioner, the lips may look and feel a bit swollen, however the swelling will reduce within a few days, and the final results will be visible. Leaving a hydrated and subtle finish. Other indications in the lips that can be treated with STYLAGE ® Special Lips include more definition around the edges of the lips (contours), fine lines around the mouth (Smoker’s Lines), and of course, increased hydration to the area. An anaesthetic* is also available with this product as the lip area can be sensitive when injected. Following the treatment, results can last up to 12 months 2 . The newest product in the STYLAGE ® range, STYLAGE ® Lips Plus goes above and beyond to bring back or create volume in the delicate lip area. Though the product is more volumizing in nature than the STYLAGE ® Special Lips, after injection, the gel still feels soft and adapts perfectly to this area of the face. It can also be injected into the vermilion border (border of the red lip) in order to better contour and outline the mouth, leaving you with the perfect pout. While some other products in the STYLAGE ® range are available without anaesthetic*, STYLAGE ® Lips Plus is only available with a numbing aide for maximum comfort during and for some time after injection. The first product in VIVACY’s volumizing range is STYLAGE ® XL. Though it is slightly less viscous than the STYLAGE ® XXL, it still provides strong, long-lasting results to reduce the visible signs of ageing in the face. When it comes to facial ageing, it is not only wrinkles that betray our age. Over time, the face and the body go through both anatomical and functional changes, causing loss of volume, and consequently, facial sagging. STYLAGE ® XL is ideal for volume restoration, it can also provide light volume creation in patients of all ages. Some indications of this product include temples, cheekbones, jawline, and chin. It is available with an anaesthetic* for a more pleasant treatment with your certified practitioner. STYLAGE ® XXL is one of the most volumizing products. Due to its high elasticity 2 , it is able to respond perfectly to the mechanical pressures exerted on it after injection into the dermis. Another important characteristic is its high viscosity 2 , which makes it less prone to spreading within the tissues and is able to provide a strong, visible volumizing effect and projection that can last up to 18 months 2 . This product can help to sharpen cheekbones, improve the shape of the chin, fill sunken temples and define the facial oval. Thanks to VIVACY’s volumizing products, it is possible to redefine the facial contours, create volume where needed and restore volume to the most affected areas 3 . STYLAGE ® Hydro is one of the most hydrating products in the STYLAGE ® range. Its main role is to bring moisture and hydration back to the skin through superficial injections on the skin’s surface. This product is part of VIVACY’s Mesotherapy line and can be used to treat the full face. It can also be applied to the neck and décolleté, as it is not only the face that is prone to ageing or sun-damage. The hyaluronic acid gel is extremely fluid to help it absorb more quickly and easily into the skin’s surface. It is recommended to establish several injection appointments with STYLAGE ® Hydro to obtain optimal results and better skin quality! Size and Care Info 1 x 1ml

description: TSK STERiGLIDE Cannula 25G 38mm x 4 Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description Dome shape tip design The patented dome-shaped tip of the STERiGLIDE™ cannula is specifically engineered to create less resistance during insertion compared to traditional cannula tips. By reducing the force required to introduce the cannula, this innovative design minimizes tissue trauma and lowers the risk of bruising, swelling, or patient discomfort. The smooth, rounded tip glides effortlessly beneath the skin, allowing practitioners to navigate delicate areas with precision and confidence. This feature ensures safer, more efficient treatments while enhancing the overall patient experience. Proprietary surface treatment STERiGLIDE™ cannulas are crafted from the highest quality surgical-grade steel and feature a proprietary surface treatment that significantly reduces friction between the cannula and skin tissue. This low-friction surface allows for smoother, more comfortable insertions, minimizing pain and irritation for the patient. In addition, the surface treatment improves cannula handling for practitioners, enhancing tactile feedback and control during procedures. The combination of high-quality material and specialized surface treatment makes STERiGLIDE™ cannulas exceptionally reliable for precision injections. Nearest to tip filler delivery One of the key advantages of STERiGLIDE™ cannulas is that practitioners can see and feel the very end of the cannula tip. This allows for delivery of filler as close to the tip as possible, providing a highly accurate sense of placement and control. By delivering product precisely at the tip, practitioners can reduce waste, avoid overfilling, and achieve optimal results. The ability to sense the tip location also improves safety when injecting near sensitive areas, making treatments more predictable and precise. Clear side-port marking STERiGLIDE™ cannulas are designed with clear side-port markings and custom fittings for Juvederm syringes, allowing practitioners to monitor flow and maintain precise control throughout the injection. These markings help minimize product leakage, prevent hub pop-offs, and ensure an ideal flow rate for smooth, controlled delivery. By combining enhanced visibility, secure connections, and precise flow, STERiGLIDE™ cannulas enable seamless procedures and superior treatment outcomes, giving both practitioners and patients greater confidence in every injection. Size and Care Info 4 PACK

Alluzience 1x125 Units Single Pack Alluzience is a toxin and a prescription-only medicine indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines (vertical lines between the eyebrows) in adult patients under 65 years when the severity of these lines has an important psychological impact on the patient. Mode of Action: Botulinum toxin type A is a muscle relaxant that temporarily weakens muscle activity. After injection of Alluzience, the botulinum toxin type A works by blocking the transport of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine across the neuromuscular junction, located between the nerve end and the muscle fibre. The action results in stopping the contraction of the targeted muscles. Contraindications of Alluzience: – Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients – Presence of infection at the proposed injection sites – Presence of myasthenia gravis, Eaton Lambert Syndrome or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis Storage: Store in refrigerator 2-8°C. Letybo 50 Units Botulinum Toxin Type A Letybo is a prescription-only medicine indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe vertical lines between the eyebrows in adults <75 years old seen at maximum frown (glabellar lines) when the severity of the facial lines has an important psychological impact. Mode of Action: Clostridium botulinum neurotoxin type A blocks the peripheral release of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine at presynaptic cholinergic nerve terminals of neuromuscular junctions by cleaving SNAP-25, a protein integral to the successful docking and release of acetylcholine from vesicles situated within the nerve endings, thereby leading to denervation of the muscle and a flaccid paralysis. Contraindications of Letybo: -Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients. -Generalised disorders of muscle activity such as myasthenia gravis, Lambert-Eaton syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis -Presence of acute infection or inflammation at the proposed injection sites. Who Is the Ideal Patient For Letybo? Ideal patients for Letybo would be adults under the age of 75 with concerns of deep to severe glabellar lines. However, practitioners should always do a full consultation with clients to determine whether the treatment is both suitable and beneficial for the patient. Patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding should not use Letybo. Newest (1 x 2ml) Suggested to moisturise mature and dehydrated skin improving turgidity, elasticity and appearance. Treatment Areas / Indications PLINEST® Eye is specifically designed for the periorbital area and eye contour. It can treat: Fine lines and superficial wrinkles. Dark under-eye circles. Crow’s feet. description: Description Alluzience is a prescription-only medicine indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe Glabellar lines (vertical lines between the eyebrows) and Lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet lines) in adult patients under 65 years. Key Features: Relaxes the muscles to prevent contractions Blocks transport of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine across the neuromuscular junction, located between the nerve end and the muscle fibre Used in the treatment of moderate to severe wrinkles in patients Treatment Areas: Moderate to severe glabellar lines Lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet lines) Contraindications of Alluzience: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients Presence of infection at the proposed injection sites Presence of myasthenia gravis, Eaton Lambert Syndrome or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis Who should not use Alluzience? Pregnant and lactating women should not use this product as not enough clinical data has been collected to suggest that it is safe. There is a risk of this product passing through the mother to her baby Any individuals that develop hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to the product should also refrain from using it. Children under 18 and adults over 65 should also not use this product Anyone with an infection on the skin surface at the proposed injection site should wait for the infection to completely disappear first There is a probable muscle weakness(myasthenia gravis) already present then do not use Azzalure either. The following diseases and conditions should also rule out the use of this medicine: Eaton Lambert syndrome and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (degenerative nerve muscle disorder) Storage: Keep refrigerated at 2-8°C Additional Information: EMC: https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/6584

description: Description Azzalure is a prescription-only medicine indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe Glabellar lines (vertical lines between the eyebrows) and Lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet lines) in adult patients under 65 years. Key Features: Relaxes the muscles to prevent contractions Blocks transport of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine across the neuromuscular junction, located between the nerve end and the muscle fibre Used in the treatment of moderate to severe wrinkles in patients Treatment Areas: Moderate to severe glabellar lines Lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet lines) Contraindications of Azzalure: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients Presence of infection at the proposed injection sites Presence of myasthenia gravis, Eaton Lambert Syndrome or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis Who should not use Azzalure? Pregnant and lactating women should not use this product as not enough clinical data has been collected to suggest that it is safe. There is a risk of this product passing through the mother to her baby Any individuals that develop hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to the product should also refrain from using it. Children under 18 and adults over 65 should also not use this product Anyone with an infection on the skin surface at the proposed injection site should wait for the infection to completely disappear first There is a probable muscle weakness(myasthenia gravis) already present then do not use Azzalure either. The following diseases and conditions should also rule out the use of this medicine: Eaton Lambert syndrome and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (degenerative nerve muscle disorder) Storage: Keep refrigerated at 2-8°C Additional Information: EMC: https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/6584

description: Description PROFHILO ® STRUCTURA is indicated for facial treatment and for restoring adipose tissue. Stabilized Hybrid Cooperative Complexes (HCC) of high and low molecular weight Ultrapure Hyaluronic Acid in high concentration, produced with a unique and innovative thermal production process patented by IBSA, the NAHYCO ® Technology. Aging manifests as a result of the interplay of changes in the facial skeleton, ligaments, muscles, adipose tissue, and skin. The characteristic signs of aging in facial skin are, in part, associated with age-related alterations in the subcutaneous adipose tissue of the face. The movement of fat within compartments, due to gravity, can result in an inferomedial displacement of the overlying skin envelope. This repositioning or shift of fat often leads to increased hollows in the cheeks and to a flattening of facial angles. Consequently, there is a loss of fat volume in the middle and lateral cheek compartments. PROFHILO ® STRUCTURA provides a lipolifting effect by restoring adipose tissue and leading to deep firmness.

description: Description How does Jalupro HMW work? Jalupro HMW Skin Booster is an injectable solution that has been formulated using a clever combination of amino acids. Technically labelled as a dermal biorevitalizer, it eradicates skin depressions caused by ageing wrinkles and scars. The science behind Jalupro works by feeding the connective tissue under the skin layers, otherwise known as fibroblasts. Fibroblasts produce collagen and repair skin to ensure it always has elasticity and great looking texture. As skin ages, the fibroblasts function reduces in activity; this can be caused by many factors, including spending too much time in the sun, intense smoking and other reasons. Consequently, wrinkles appear. The amino acids in Jalupro HMW join forces with the existing fibroblasts to help them continue their pre-ageing function. The more abundant the amino acids, the more healthier the skin cells are, resulting in younger appearance. This natural phenomenon is an effective way for skin to look younger again without surgery. What’s in the Jalupro HMW box? 1 x glass syringe (disposable), pyrogen (sterile gel of Sodium Hyaluronate) 1 x glass bottle sterile solution based on Amino Acids. No needles. What are the benefits of Jalupro HMW? Jalupro HMW Skin Booster can be used to fade out scars and improve skin appearance by eliminating depressions specifically in the face, neck, decollete, underarms, hands, inner thighs, abdomen area and knees. When can Jalupro HMW be used? Jalupro HMW can be used as soon as the face area begins to show signs of ageing and photo-ageing. It can be used to correct dry and dehydrated skin. educe stretch marks and is especially ideal before or after any surgery is to take place. How long does Jalupro HMW Last for? Whilst results become more evident over time, the average effects can last for 6 months. Can be used prior to sunbathing and works well in mature aged skin.

The Speywood units of Azzalure are specific to the preparation and are not interchangeable with other preparations of botulinum toxin. Paediatric Population: · The safety and efficacy of Azzalure in individuals aged up to 18 years have not been established. The use of Azzalure is not recommended in subjects under 18 years. Method of Administration: · Azzalure should only be administered by a specialised practitioner with appropriate qualifications and expertise in this treatment and having the required equipment, in accordance with national guidelines. · Once reconstituted, Azzalure should only be used to treat a single patient, during a single session. · For instructions on reconstitution of the medicinal product before administration, see section 6.6. · Remove any make-up and disinfect the skin with a local antiseptic. · Intramuscular injections should be performed using a sterile suitable gauge needle. · The treatment interval depends on the individual patient's response after assessment. description: Botox 100 units SKU: DAL20395 Log In to View Price Description Additional Information Botox 100 Units is a trusted, FDA-approved injectable product designed to temporarily reduce the appearance of facial wrinkles and fine lines. Widely used by qualified aesthetic practitioners globally, Botox provides effective results for various cosmetic and medical purposes, including smoothing dynamic wrinkles, such as crow’s feet, frown lines, and forehead lines. Product Description Botox 100U Vial is a trusted product in the field of aesthetic medicine, providing qualified practitioners with a highly sought-after and powerful tool to address various cosmetic and medical concerns. This vial contains botulinum toxin type A, derived from Clostridium botulinum bacteria. Box Contents Each box of Botox 100 Units contains: - 1 vial of Botox (100 Units) for injection. - Detailed instructions for use. - Prescribing information and safety guidelines. Benefits Botox is a safe and effective solution for clinics to administer to their patients. The vial temporarily inhibits muscle activity, making it ideal for reducing the appearance of dynamic wrinkles, such as crow’s feet, frown lines, and forehead creases. This allows for a younger-looking appearance and with it, more confidence and self-esteem. Contraindications of Botox - Botox should not be used in the following cases: - Individuals with hypersensitivity to any of the components in the product. - Patients with infections at the proposed injection site(s). - Individuals with neuromuscular disorders such as myasthenia gravis, Eaton-Lambert syndrome, or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). - Pregnant or breastfeeding women, unless advised otherwise by a healthcare provider. - Those with a known history of allergic reactions to botulinum toxin or any of the product's ingredients. How to Use This Product Preparation and Dosage: Reconstitute the vial with 0.9% sterile, non-preserved saline. Use an appropriate-sized syringe for reconstitution and injection. Botox 100 Units is intended for intramuscular injection by a qualified healthcare professional. Injection Technique: - Identify the target muscles based on the desired aesthetic or therapeutic outcome. - Inject directly into the specific muscles to reduce muscle activity responsible for wrinkles or other medical conditions. - Avoid injecting near the eyes or in areas where muscles control critical functions unless specifically trained for such procedures. Post-Injection Care: - Avoid rubbing or massaging the treated area for at least 24 hours post-injection. - Refrain from lying down for 4 hours after the injection to prevent the spread of the toxin to unintended areas. - Follow the healthcare provider’s advice on aftercare and possible side effects. Side Effects of Botox 100U Patients may experience a range of different side effects. Some of these side effects are mild bruising, swelling, or redness at the injection sites, which do not remain visible for very long. In rare cases, patients may report headaches or flu-like symptoms. FAQs Q: How long do the effects of Botox 100 Units last? The effects of Botox typically last between 3 to 6 months, depending on individual factors such as the area treated, dosage, and the patient’s metabolic rate. Q: Is Botox safe? Yes, Botox is considered safe when administered by a qualified aesthetic practitioner. It has been widely used for cosmetic and medical purposes for over two decades. However, there are contraindications (see above) and potential side effects, so it is essential to consult a healthcare provider before use. Q: How soon will I see results after my Botox treatment? Typically within 3 to 7 days after treatment, with maximum effect visible in about 2 weeks. Q: What should I avoid after receiving Botox injections? Avoid strenuous exercise, lying down for 4 hours, and exposure to excessive heat (like saunas or hot tubs) for at least 24 hours after treatment. Also, avoid rubbing or massaging the treated area to prevent the spread of the toxin. Q: Can Botox be used for medical purposes? Yes, including chronic migraines, excessive sweating (hyperhidrosis), muscle spasms, and more. Your healthcare provider can advise on its suitability. Q: How much does a Botox 100 Units vial typically cost? The cost can vary depending on the healthcare provider, geographic location, and the extent of treatment. Achieve smoother, more youthful-looking skin with Botox 100 Units. Consult your healthcare provider today to see if Botox is right for you. description: Dysport 300iu SKU: DAL20401 Log In to View Price Description Additional Information Therapeutic indications Dysport is indicated for symptomatic treatment of focal spasticity of: - Upper limbs in adults - Lower limbs in adults affecting the ankle joint due to stroke or traumatic brain injury (TBI) - Dynamic equinus foot deformity in ambulant paediatric cerebral palsy patients, two years of age or older - Upper limbs in paediatric cerebral palsy patients, two years of age or older. Dysport is indicated in adults for symptomatic treatment of: - Spasmodic torticollis - Blepharospasm - Hemifacial spasm - Severe primary hyperhidrosis of the axillae, which does not respond to topical treatment with antiperspirants or antihidrotics. 4.2 Posology and method of administration The units of Dysport are specific to the preparation and are not interchangeable with other preparations of botulinum toxin. Dysport should only be administered by an appropriately qualified healthcare practitioner with expertise in the treatment of the relevant indication and the use of the required equipment, in accordance with national guidelines. For instructions on reconstitution of the powder for solution for injection, handling and disposal of vials please refer to section 6.6. Focal spasticity in adults Upper limb: Posology Dosing in initial and sequential treatment sessions should be tailored to the individual based on the size, number and location of muscles involved, severity of spasticity, the presence of local muscle weakness, the patient's response to previous treatment, and/or adverse event history with Dysport. In clinical trials, doses of 500 units and 1000 units were divided among selected muscles at a given treatment session as shown below. No more than 1 ml should generally be administered at any single injection site. The total dose should not exceed 1000 units at a given treatment session. Some of the key benefits of Juvederm Volite include improved skin hydration, improved skin texture and elasticity, and reduced appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Juvederm Volite is a HA-based treatment designed to improve skin quality by hydrating and revitalizing the skin from within. It is administered via a series of treatments into the skin, and the treatment typically takes about 30 minutes to complete. Juvederm Volite helps to replace lost volume and stimulate the production of collagen, which can help to improve the overall quality and texture of your skin. How does it work? Juvederm Volite works by adding HA into the skin. HA is a naturally occurring substance in your body that is responsible for keeping your skin hydrated and plump. As we age, our bodies produce less HA, which can lead to dry and thinning skin. By adding HA back into the skin, we can help to restore hydration and improve skin texture and elasticity. What to expect during and after treatment? Juvederm Volite is a non-invasive treatment that typically takes about 30 minutes to complete. After the treatment, you may experience mild swelling or bruising at the treatment site, but this should resolve within a few days. Results from Juvederm Volite can be seen immediately, with full results typically visible after about two weeks, and can last for up to nine months. Juvederm Volite (2 x 1ml) is a popular and effective treatment for improving the quality of your skin. By adding HA into the skin, Juvederm Volite can help to restore hydration & improve skin texture and elasticity, leaving you with a more youthful and healthy-looking complexion. description: Prostrolane Natural-B SKU: DAL20624 Log In to View Price Description Additional Information Prostrolane Natural B reduces medium to deep wrinkles on the face particularly quickly and effectively, such as nasolabial and perioral folds This product does not contain needles due to legal requirements. Prostrolane Natural B is a dermal filler for smoothing facial wrinkles. The filler is suitable for medium to deep wrinkles, such as forehead wrinkles, nasolabial folds, perioral wrinkles and marionette lines. In addition, the gel can be used for contouring the face. Another advantage of Natural B is that it revitalizes the facial skin and moisturizes the tissue for a longer period of time. The gel implant consists of a particularly effective anti-aging complex based on hyaluronic acid in combination with a unique peptide formula. Sagging facial skin looks fitter, younger and more radiant, and sunken facial contours regain their natural shape. The effective mode of action of Prostrolane Natural B Prostrolane Natural B is a true all-rounder in the field of dermal fillers. This anti-aging product not only visibly fills medium-deep to deep wrinkles over a longer period of time. It also promotes the body's own production of collagen and activates the skin cells. Furthermore, the contour of the face can be adjusted and the facial shape can be made more striking. The tissue is moisturized, providing the face with a natural and fresh appearance. The special technology of Prostrolane Natural B The gel implant from the manufacturer Caregen is characterized by a technology in which the effect is deliberately delayed. As a result, the effect is achieved bit by bit, which prolongs the duration of the effect. The special complex of active ingredients consists of hyaluronic acid and a cocktail of peptides. The skin receives more moisture, wrinkles are reduced and the coture becomes more prominent. By purchasing Prostrolane Natural B today, you can provide your patients with a long-term balanced, natural and fresh appearance. FAQ about Prostrolane Natural B For which wrinkles is Prostrolane Natural B suitable? This product can be used for moderate to deep wrinkle treatment of the following areas: Forehead wrinkles, nasolabial folds, perioral wrinkles and marionette lines. Is the Prostrolane Natural B suitable for defining the facial contour? Yes, the Natural B is very suitable for adjusting the facial contours and making them more prominent. What are the ingredients of Prostrolane Natural B? The Natural B consists of the following active ingredients: 0.7% sodium hyaluronate, PBS as well as a special Prostrolane Natural B complex consisting of the peptides Oligopeptide-24, Decapeptide-36, Octapeptide-11, Oligopeptide-34, Oligopeptide-92. What is included in one package of Prostrolane Natural B? One package consists of one injection syringe with 2 ml content and two traceability labels. Due to legal requirements, no needles are included. However, you can purchase them separately from us. How quickly can results be seen after treatment with Natural B? The first results are slightly visible after the first treatment session, with a total of 3 sessions recommended. However, when exactly the results are visible depends on the individual patient. At what rhythm should Prostrolane Natural B be used? The actual number of treatments depends on the areas to be treated. On average, 3 sessions are recommended at an interval of approximately 2 weeks. Under which skin layer should Prostrolane Natural B be injected? This product should be injected into the mid to deep dermis of the skin. The injection technique depends on the desired treatment and must be decided on an individual basis. What factors can influence the effect of Prostrolane Natural B? Various factors, such as the patient's age, skin type and sporting activity, can influence the effect achieved by Prostrolane Natural B. Radiesse (1×1.5ml) works by adding volume to the skin and stimulating collagen production, resulting in a smoother and more youthful appearance. The effects of Radiesse (1×1.5ml) can last up to 18 months with optimal treatment. How is Radiesse (1×1.5ml) administered? Radiesse (1×1.5ml) is typically administered through a series of applications into the targeted treatment areas. The process is relatively quick and should cause minimal discomfort. To ensure the best results, it’s important to choose an experienced and licensed healthcare professional to administer the treatment. What are the benefits of Radiesse (1×1.5ml)? The benefits of Radiesse (1×1.5ml) go beyond just reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. The treatment can also improve skin firmness and texture, diminish acne scars, and restore the natural contours of the face. Additionally, since Radiesse (1×1.5ml) is made of biocompatible and biodegradable materials, it is a safe and predictable treatment option for most patients. What are the potential side effects of Radiesse (1×1.5ml)? Like with any medical treatment, there are potential side effects associated with Radiesse (1×1.5ml). It can be a great option for people who want to rejuvenate their skin without the need for recovery time. description: Restylane® Eyelight Dermal Filler 1 × 0.5 mL Restylane® Eyelight with Lidocaine is an injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler medical device developed by Galderma for the treatment of infraorbital hollowing and tear trough deformities . Specifically formulated for the delicate under-eye area, Restylane Eyelight is designed to provide subtle volume restoration while maintaining smooth tissue integration. The inclusion of lidocaine improves patient comfort during injection. The gel is engineered for precise placement in the infraorbital region , offering controlled correction in thin skin areas prone to shadowing and contour irregularities. Unlike volumising fillers used in cheeks or jawline, Restylane Eyelight filler is tailored for refined under-eye correction rather than large-scale structural enhancement. What Restylane® Eyelight Is Similar To Restylane Eyelight can be regarded alongside other tear trough–specific hyaluronic acid fillers designed for infraorbital hollow correction. Within the Restylane portfolio, it is positioned for delicate periorbital treatment requiring precision and smooth integration. Compared with standard volumising fillers, Restylane Eyelight with lidocaine offers a formulation adapted to thin periorbital tissue. It is not intended for high-lift midface contouring or lip augmentation. For example, Restylane Eyelight for lips would not be considered appropriate due to its targeted design for the under-eye area. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Restylane Eyelight is indicated for the correction of infraorbital hollowing (tear trough area). Treatment areas include: Tear trough • Infraorbital region • Under-eye hollows Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth: Supraperiosteal or deep subcutaneous placement in the infraorbital region. Volume per point / injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle or cannula specification: Supplied with sterile needles as per packaging. Frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions with advanced knowledge of periorbital anatomy. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is marked as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Cross-linked hyaluronic acid (non-animal origin) Lidocaine hydrochloride Physiological buffer solution Other excipients as per IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 0.5 mL pre-filled sterile syringe Shelf-life: Not specified in public documentation; refer to packaging for expiry date. Longevity (treatment duration): Results are typically reported to last approximately 9–12 months , depending on patient factors and injection technique. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any component of the product. Avoid use in patients with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin in the periorbital area until resolved. Extreme caution is required in the infraorbital region due to vascular structures; intravascular injection must be avoided. Single use only; do not reuse the syringe; ensure packaging is intact and within expiry. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device in Europe. UKCA status: verify via IFU or authorised distributor. Restylane Eyelight is a hyaluronic acid dermal filler specifically formulated for the correction of tear trough deformities and infraorbital hollowing. 2. Does Restylane Eyelight contain lidocaine? Yes. Restylane Eyelight with lidocaine includes lidocaine to improve comfort during treatment. 3. How long do Restylane Eyelight results last? Results are commonly reported to last between 9 and 12 months , depending on individual patient metabolism and technique. 4. Can Restylane Eyelight be used for lips? No. Restylane Eyelight for lips is not indicated, as the formulation is specifically designed for the delicate under-eye area. 5. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? Treatment of the tear trough requires advanced anatomical knowledge and precise injection technique to minimise risks, particularly vascular complications.

short_description: Plenhyage XL Medium is a professional polynucleotide skin-booster designed to improve skin quality in moderately aged or photo-damaged areas. Clinicians use it to enhance skin elasticity, hydration and surface texture while promoting tissue repair and collagen support. Supplied as a 2 ml prefilled syringe for single-patient use, it is intended for administration by qualified healthcare professionals. Plenhyage XL Medium is selected where subtle structural and dermal quality gains are required — for example in periorbital maintenance, cheeks, neck and décolletage — without creating bulk or volumetric lift.
description: Plenhyage XL Medium 1 × 2 ml Clinical description Plenhyage XL Medium is a CE-marked, Class-III injectable biorevitaliser from Bioformula s.r.l. formulated from high-molecular-weight polynucleotides (PDRN, salmon-derived DNA) at 2.0% (≈20 mg/ml) . The product is indicated to support tissue regeneration by stimulating fibroblast activity, encouraging extracellular-matrix repair and improving dermal hydration and elasticity. It is intended for clinical use where skin quality improvement is required—reducing fine lines, improving texture and supporting recovery of photodamaged or atrophic skin—rather than for volumetric correction. The formulation is sterile, biocompatible and resorbable; manufacturer documentation emphasises its role in improving skin density, tone and turgor through regenerative (biostimulatory) mechanisms. What Plenhyage XL Medium is similar to Plenhyage XL Medium sits in the polynucleotide (PDRN) biostimulator / polynucleotide category alongside other PN products and combination formulations (e.g., certain Jalupro® variants which combine amino acids with DNA fragments). Mechanistically, Plenhyage XL Medium acts via polynucleotide-driven fibroblast stimulation and extracellular matrix support; this contrasts with hyaluronic-acid (HA) fillers (e.g., Juvederm®/Restylane®) that primarily provide immediate volumetric augmentation via hydrophilic gels. Compared with lighter Plenhyage XL “Thin” or more concentrated “Strong” formulas in the same product family, the Medium formulation (2.0%) is positioned for moderate skin-quality concerns — stronger than Thin for structural support but less concentrated than Strong for advanced regenerative indications. For orientation, Profhilo® (an ultra-pure HA bioremodeling product) also targets skin quality rather than volume, but uses HA rather than PDRN; clinical choice depends on desired mechanism (biostimulation vs HA-mediated hydration). This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment areas / indications Manufacturer-stated suggested treatment areas: face, neck and décolletage . Manufacturer product page also notes applicability to other body zones requiring regenerative support (e.g., hands, areas of mild atrophy) depending on clinical assessment. If a specific area is required, verify on the product pack/IFU. Usage / Administration (IFU-only section) Note: the following items reproduce only parameters that are present in the manufacturer’s public product documentation. Where the IFU or manufacturer page does not specify a parameter, this is stated explicitly. Injection depth: not provided by manufacturer. Volume per point / injection site: not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: not provided by manufacturer. Manufacturer packaging statement: syringe supplied with 2 disposable needles (pack contents), but needle gauge is not specified on the publicly available product page. Frequency / number of sessions: Manufacturer states “multiple sessions are usually required; the aesthetic doctor will develop a personalised treatment plan.” No precise session count/interval is given in the public IFU. Professional-use disclaimer: Intended for professional medical use only ; to be administered by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. Non-IFU professional practice note (not part of the official IFU): some clinicians report common practice of a course of 2–4 sessions with 2- to 4-week intervals and maintenance treatments thereafter; this protocol is reported by distributors and practitioner forums, but is not specified in the manufacturer IFU and should be used only where clinically justified. Ingredient list Active: Polynucleotides (PDRN) — high molecular weight, 2.0% (approx. 20 mg/ml). Excipients: sterile water and buffering components as per manufacturer formulation (detailed excipient list in full IFU/fact sheet available to registered professionals). Lidocaine: not provided by manufacturer. (Manufacturer product page does not list lidocaine content.) Hyaluronic acid: some supplier pages reference PN-HA combination products, but for Plenhyage XL Medium the manufacturer declares polynucleotides (2.0%) as the key active; HA is not presented as a primary active on the official product page. If HA content is critical for clinical choice, verify on the IFU/pack. Presentation & longevity Presentation / pack: 1 glass syringe of 2 ml supplied with 2 disposable needles (single-patient sterile pack). Shelf life / storage: not provided by manufacturer on the public product page; consult the product carton/IFU for shelf-life and storage temperature. Duration of effect: Manufacturer: “duration varies depending on individual needs; multiple sessions usually required.” Distributor/clinic reports commonly cite modest improvements that can be sustained with maintenance treatments (numerous sellers report typical effect windows in the order of months), but manufacturer does not provide a fixed longevity figure. Safety notes / contraindications (Manufacturer-aligned summary; always refer to full IFU before treatment) Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component. Do not inject into or adjacent to areas of active skin infection, inflammation or open wounds. Caution or avoid use in pregnancy and breastfeeding unless local regulations and clinician judgement allow (manufacturer documentation advises professional assessment). Administer only by trained healthcare professionals; improper injection technique may increase risk of adverse events. Regulatory status CE-marked : Class III medical device, CE 0373 (manufacturer documentation). UKCA / FDA: UKCA marking and FDA clearance are not specified on the public manufacturer page; verify regulatory status on the product carton, local distributor records or via regulatory databases before use in non-EU/UK markets. FAQ Q1 — How does Plenhyage XL Medium work? A1 — Plenhyage XL Medium delivers purified polynucleotides (PDRN) into the dermis where they act as biostimulatory molecules: studies and manufacturer data indicate PDRN can promote fibroblast activity, support collagen and extracellular matrix repair, and improve dermal hydration and tissue resilience. These mechanisms lead to gradual improvement in skin texture and elasticity rather than immediate volumetric filling. Q2 — Is treatment safe and what side effects occur? A2 — According to the manufacturer, Plenhyage XL Medium is well tolerated when used by trained clinicians; common transient reactions include redness, swelling, mild bruising or local sensitivity at injection sites. Serious adverse events are rare when used according to professional standards. Proper screening and aseptic technique reduce risks. Refer to the full IFU for detailed safety information. Q3 — What is the recommended treatment schedule? A3 — The manufacturer specifies that multiple sessions are usually required and that clinicians should personalise the protocol. The public IFU does not give a fixed session count or interval; therefore clinicians often plan an initial series (clinically reported at 2–4 sessions in some practices) with individualised maintenance. Always follow the official IFU and local clinical guidance. Q4 — How long do results last? A4 — Manufacturer guidance states that duration varies by individual and treated area ; no fixed longevity is published on the public product page. Clinical reports from distributor sources commonly indicate improvements lasting months with maintenance—actual duration depends on skin condition, patient factors and treatment plan. Q5 — Can Plenhyage XL Medium replace hyaluronic-acid fillers? A5 — No direct interchange: Plenhyage XL Medium is a PDRN biostimulator intended to improve skin quality and promote tissue regeneration, whereas HA fillers primarily provide immediate volume and structural support. Choice should be indication-led: use PN products for dermal quality and HA for volumetric restoration or contouring. In many protocols both modalities are complementary.

description: DR. CYJ Hair Filler Double Pack 2 × 1 mL DR. CYJ Hair Filler is indicated for aesthetic protocols addressing hair thinning, reduced hair density, and weakened hair follicles , rather than for volumetric tissue augmentation. short_description: Nucleofill Strong is an advanced polynucleotide skin booster formulated to improve skin quality through hydration, bio-stimulation, and tissue support. Featuring a concentrated 25 mg/ml polynucleotide gel, it is intended for patients presenting with more advanced signs of skin ageing, loss of elasticity, and environmental skin damage. The product is widely incorporated into professional aesthetic treatment plans targeting facial rejuvenation, skin firmness enhancement, and regenerative skin therapy. Unlike volumising fillers, Nucleofill Strong focuses on improving tissue quality and supporting natural biological processes within the skin. Practitioners researching Nucleofill Strong , Nucleofill 25 polynucleotide , buy Nucleofill Strong , or buy Nucleofill 25 often select this formulation when stronger bio-restructuring support is desired.
description: Clinical Description Nucleofill 25, commonly marketed as Nucleofill Strong , is a high-concentration polynucleotide-based injectable medical device developed by Promoitalia Medical Aesthetics. Designed for advanced skin bio-restructuring and tissue regeneration, it contains highly purified polynucleotides at a concentration of 25 mg/ml (2.5%), making it the strongest formulation within the Nucleofill range. The product functions through multiple biological mechanisms. Polynucleotides provide intensive hydration through water-binding activity, support fibroblast stimulation, promote extracellular matrix regeneration, and contribute antioxidant protection against free radical damage. These combined effects aim to improve skin elasticity, firmness, texture, and overall tissue quality. Nucleofill Strong is generally indicated for mature skin, significant skin laxity, photoaged skin, and areas requiring enhanced regenerative support. It is frequently selected by practitioners seeking a more intensive polynucleotide treatment compared with lower-concentration formulations such as Nucleofill Medium. What Nucleofill Strong Is Similar To Nucleofill Strong belongs to the growing category of regenerative injectable treatments, alongside products such as Nucleofill Medium, Plenhyage XL Strong, and Profhilo®. Compared with Nucleofill Medium, Nucleofill Strong contains a higher concentration of polynucleotides (25 mg/ml versus 20 mg/ml), providing greater viscosity and a stronger regenerative profile intended for patients with more advanced skin ageing concerns. Profhilo®, by contrast, is based on stabilised hyaluronic acid and primarily focuses on hydration and tissue remodelling. While both products aim to improve skin quality, Nucleofill Strong relies on polynucleotide-mediated fibroblast activation and antioxidant activity rather than hyaluronic acid bio-remodelling. Similarly, other polynucleotide products may share regenerative goals, but formulation concentration, molecular characteristics, and treatment indications differ between manufacturers. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to publicly available manufacturer and distributor information, Nucleofill Strong may be used in: Face Neck Décolletage Hands Abdomen Inner arms Thighs Areas affected by skin laxity Areas affected by photoageing Stretch marks Superficial scars Treatment suitability should be determined by a qualified healthcare professional following clinical assessment. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only Section) Injection Depth Deep dermis administration is referenced within publicly available manufacturer documentation. Volume per Injection Site Not provided by manufacturer. Needle Gauge Supplied with: 2 × 30G needles Approximate needle length 12–13 mm Frequency / Number of Sessions Not provided by manufacturer. Some practitioners utilise multi-session treatment protocols and maintenance schedules; however, these approaches are not included in the manufacturer’s publicly available official IFU guidance . Professional Use Statement Nucleofill Strong should only be administered by appropriately trained healthcare professionals using aseptic injection techniques and according to applicable local regulations. Hyaluronic Acid Concentration Not applicable. Lidocaine No lidocaine reported in publicly available product documentation. Presentation & Longevity Packaging Nucleofill Strong is supplied as: 1 × 1.5 ml sterile syringe 2 × 30G needles included Shelf Life Not provided by manufacturer. Treatment Duration / Longevity Longevity is not provided by manufacturer in publicly available documentation. Clinical outcomes vary according to patient factors, treatment area, practitioner technique, and individual biological response. Safety Notes / Contraindications Publicly available documentation provides limited contraindication information. Standard precautions include: Do not use in patients with known hypersensitivity to any product component. Avoid treatment in areas with active infection, inflammation, or skin disease. Product safety during pregnancy and breastfeeding has not been established. Administration should only be performed by qualified healthcare professionals. As with all injectable procedures, appropriate aseptic technique and patient assessment are essential. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device. Reported as a Class III medical device within European medical device classifications. Intended exclusively for professional medical use. UKCA status: verify via current IFU or authorised distributor documentation. FAQ 1. What is Nucleofill Strong? Nucleofill Strong is a high-strength polynucleotide injectable developed for skin bio-restructuring and regenerative aesthetic treatments. It contains 25 mg/ml purified polynucleotides designed to support hydration, tissue quality, and fibroblast activity while helping improve overall skin condition. 2. How is Nucleofill Strong different from Nucleofill Medium? The primary difference is concentration. Nucleofill Strong contains 25 mg/ml polynucleotides, while Nucleofill Medium contains 20 mg/ml. The higher concentration provides a stronger regenerative profile and is often selected for patients with more advanced signs of skin ageing or tissue laxity. 3. Does Nucleofill Strong contain hyaluronic acid? No. Nucleofill Strong is a polynucleotide-based injectable and does not rely on hyaluronic acid as its primary active ingredient. Its mechanism focuses on bio-stimulation, hydration support, antioxidant activity, and extracellular matrix enhancement through purified polynucleotides. 4. How long do Nucleofill Strong results last? The manufacturer does not specify an exact duration of effect in publicly available documentation. Longevity may vary depending on treatment protocol, patient characteristics, skin condition, and maintenance schedules determined by the treating practitioner. 5. Is Nucleofill Strong a dermal filler? Nucleofill Strong is generally classified as a regenerative injectable skin booster rather than a volumising dermal filler. Its primary purpose is to improve tissue quality, hydration, elasticity, and skin condition rather than providing structural volume replacement.

description: Belotero Soft with Lidocaine Dermal Filler 1x1ml for Superficial Line Correction Belotero Soft with Lidocaine is a resorbable hyaluronic acid–based dermal filler formulated for the correction of superficial fine lines and delicate skin depressions. It is composed of non-animal, cross-linked hyaluronic acid combined with lidocaine hydrochloride for enhanced patient comfort during injection. The filler is manufactured using Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM®) technology, which enables uniform integration within the superficial dermal layers while maintaining skin flexibility and smoothness. The product is indicated for the treatment of fine facial wrinkles where subtle correction and even tissue distribution are required. Its rheological properties are specifically designed to minimise the risk of visibility or palpability when placed superficially. Belotero Soft with Lidocaine is biodegradable and gradually resorbed through physiological metabolic processes. It is intended exclusively for professional aesthetic use by trained medical practitioners under aseptic conditions. What Belotero Soft with Lidocaine Is Similar To Belotero Soft with Lidocaine can be compared to other soft, low-density hyaluronic acid dermal fillers intended for superficial dermal correction, such as Belotero Balance® or Juvederm® Volbella . All are designed to address fine lines and delicate wrinkles rather than provide deep volumisation or structural contouring. Belotero Balance® uses the same CPM® technology but is generally positioned for slightly deeper dermal placement and moderate wrinkles. Juvederm® Volbella, formulated with Vycross® technology, is commonly used for fine perioral lines and lip refinement, offering different gel cohesivity and persistence characteristics. Compared with these products, Belotero Soft is specifically tailored for very superficial indications, prioritising smooth integration and natural skin appearance. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Belotero Soft with Lidocaine is indicated for the correction of superficial facial fine lines and wrinkles.
