short_description: Lumi Eyes (1x1ml) is an advanced eye booster formulated with high-purity polynucleotides (PDRN) to target under-eye concerns such as dark circles, fine lines, puffiness, and dermal thinning. Designed for intradermal administration in mesotherapy protocols, Lumi Eyes supports dermal regeneration and tissue repair without volumizing effects
description: Lumi Eyes 1x1ml – Polynucleotide Injectable for Periorbital Skin Regeneration Lumi Eyes is an injectable polynucleotide (PN/PDRN)-based medical aesthetic device specifically developed for periorbital skin rejuvenation . The product is designed to improve under-eye skin quality by targeting dermal thinning, dehydration, fine lines, dark circles, and fatigue-related changes without adding volume. The formulation contains high-purity polynucleotides derived from DNA fragments , which act as biostimulatory agents within the dermis. When administered intradermally, Lumi Eyes supports fibroblast activation, extracellular matrix repair, improved microcirculation, and tissue hydration , making it suitable for patients presenting with fragile, crepey, or photo-aged under-eye skin. Lumi Eyes is non-volumising and intended for regenerative skin improvement rather than contour correction or filling of the tear trough. What Lumi Eyes Is Similar To Lumi Eyes can be considered alongside other regenerative eye-area injectables such as Rejuran® i , Nucleofill® Eyes , or Sunekos® Performa , which aim to improve skin quality and biological function rather than volumisation. Rejuran® i uses polynucleotides with a focus on dermal repair and anti-inflammatory activity. Sunekos® combines amino acids and HA to stimulate collagen and elastin synthesis. Lumi Eyes relies specifically on polynucleotide-driven tissue regeneration , hydration, and microvascular support. Unlike traditional HA dermal fillers (e.g. Juvederm® or Restylane®), Lumi Eyes does not provide structural lift or bulk and should not be used as a tear-trough filler substitute. This comparison is for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to distributor and manufacturer documentation, Lumi Eyes is indicated for the periorbital region , particularly where skin quality deterioration is present. Primary indications: Under-eye (infraorbital) area Periorbital fine lines and superficial wrinkles Thin, crepey, or lax under-eye skin Dark circles related to poor microcirculation or dermal thinning Fatigue-related under-eye appearance Usage / Administration (IFU-based where available) Injection depth: Superficial to mid-dermal (intradermal mesotherapy technique) Technique: Micro-papular or linear threading, depending on practitioner preference Needle / cannula: Commonly 30–33 G needles (not always supplied) Frequency / number of sessions: Recommended course: 3 treatment sessions , spaced 3–4 weeks apart Maintenance: Every 6–9 months , depending on patient response Professional-use disclaimer: For administration by trained medical or aesthetic professionals only under aseptic conditions If a specific parameter is not explicitly stated in the official IFU, it is considered “not provided by manufacturer”. Ingredient List (Lumi Eyes Ingredients) Active component: Polynucleotides (PN / PDRN) – DNA fragments typically within the 250–350 kDa range, supporting tissue regeneration and dermal repair Other components: Sodium chloride Phosphate buffer system Water for injection Lidocaine: Not provided by manufacturer Cross-linking agents (e.g. BDDE): None Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1 ml pre-filled sterile syringe Lumi Eyes (1x1ml) format intended for precise periorbital treatment Shelf-life: Refer to product packaging and IFU for expiry Longevity (treatment duration): Clinical reports suggest visible improvement lasting 6–12 months following a complete treatment course, depending on patient age, skin condition, and lifestyle factors. Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component Avoid use in areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless advised by local regulation Do not inject intravascularly or into muscle tissue Single-use product only; do not reuse syringe Regulatory Status CE-marked medical aesthetic device (classification dependent on jurisdiction) Regulatory status may vary by country; practitioners should verify compliance via IFU and local distributor documentation FAQ 1. How does Lumi Eyes treatment work? Lumi Eyes treatment works by delivering polynucleotides into the dermis of the under-eye area. These biologically active DNA fragments stimulate fibroblast activity, improve extracellular matrix repair, support hydration, and enhance microcirculation, resulting in improved skin texture, elasticity, and brightness. 2. Is Lumi Eyes the same as a dermal filler? No. Lumi Eyes is not a volumising filler . Unlike cross-linked HA fillers designed to lift or fill, Lumi Eyes focuses on regenerative skin improvement and is unsuitable for tear-trough volumisation. 3. How many sessions are required and how long do results last? A standard protocol includes three sessions spaced 3–4 weeks apart . Results typically last 6–12 months , depending on individual skin condition and maintenance strategy. 4. Can Lumi Eyes be combined with other treatments? Yes. Lumi Eyes is commonly combined with microneedling, chemical peels, skin boosters, or polynucleotide-based facial treatments as part of a comprehensive regenerative protocol, provided appropriate timing and skin recovery are respected. 5. What are the key safety considerations? Due to the delicate vascular anatomy of the periorbital region, advanced anatomical knowledge and conservative technique are essential. Practitioners should avoid deep injections and monitor for swelling or bruising post-treatment.

short_description: Sculptra is a collagen-stimulating injectable designed for gradual and long-term facial volume restoration. It supports correction of facial wrinkles and age-related fat loss by activating the skin’s own collagen production over time. The treatment suits patients who prefer progressive improvement rather than immediate volumisation. Results develop steadily following a structured treatment protocol and contribute to improved facial structure and contour. Sculptra is intended for professional use by trained medical practitioners and forms part of advanced aesthetic treatment plans focused on long-term tissue quality and volume support.
description: Sculptra Poly-L-Lactic Acid Injectable for Facial Volume Loss and Collagen Stimulation Sculptra is a class III injectable medical device composed of microparticles of poly-L-lactic acid suspended in sterile water for injection. It is indicated for the correction of shallow to deep nasolabial fold contour deficiencies, other facial wrinkles, and for the restoration or correction of signs of facial fat loss in immune-competent adult patients. Following injection, the poly-L-lactic acid microparticles trigger a controlled biological response in the deep dermis or subcutaneous tissue. This stimulates fibroblast activity and promotes new collagen type I synthesis over a period of months. The volumetric effect develops gradually as endogenous collagen increases. Sculptra does not act as a conventional gel filler and does not provide instant correction at the time of treatment. What Sculptra Is Similar To Sculptra belongs to the category of biostimulatory injectables intended to improve tissue structure through collagen induction. neverthless It is often compared with other collagen-stimulating products such as calcium hydroxylapatite-based injectables and other poly-L-lactic acid products. Treatment Areas / Indications • Shallow to deep nasolabial fold contour deficiencies • Other facial wrinkles in immune-competent adults • Restoration or correction of signs of facial fat loss Treatment areas include the face, particularly nasolabial folds, cheek regions, and areas affected by facial lipoatrophy. Use in other anatomical regions is not provided by manufacturer and requires practitioner verification. Usage / Administration • Injection depth: deep dermis, subcutaneous layer, or supraperiosteal plane depending on anatomical site • Volume per point or injection site: quantity depends on area treated and expected outcome. Limited correction is advised during the first session • Needle gauge: 25 G or 26 G • Frequency or number of sessions: up to four injection sessions approximately three weeks apart • Professional use only. Administered by qualified medical professionals under sterile conditions Some practitioners use grid or cross-hatch techniques. These are not included in the manufacturer’s official IFU. Ingredient List of Sculptra • Poly-L-lactic acid microparticles, 150 mg per vial • Sodium carboxymethylcellulose, 90 mg per vial • Non-pyrogenic mannitol, 127.5 mg per vial • Sterile water for injection for reconstitution • Lidocaine: not provided by manufacturer as a permanent component. Optional addition during preparation may be used at clinician discretion Presentation & Longevity Sculptra is supplied as two single-use vials containing dry powder. Each vial requires reconstitution with sterile water for injection to form a suspension prior to use. Storage is at room temperature up to 30 °C. Do not freeze. Clinical data report that treatment effects may persist for up to 24 months when a full treatment protocol is completed. A specific duration of effect is not guaranteed by the manufacturer and varies between patients. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the product. Do not use in patients with a history of hypertrophic scarring or keloid formation. Injection should be avoided in areas with active inflammation, infection, nodules, pimples, or hives. Vials are single use only and must not be reused or resterilised. Full safety information is detailed in the manufacturer IFU. Regulatory Status CE marked medical device in Europe for aesthetic injectable indications. FDA cleared as Sculptra Aesthetic for correction of facial lipoatrophy and wrinkles. Regulatory classification in the United States is class III injectable implant. Verify local market authorisation where applicable. FAQ How does Sculptra stimulate collagen formation Sculptra contains poly-L-lactic acid microparticles that trigger a controlled biological response after injection. As the particles are gradually resorbed, they stimulate fibroblasts to produce new collagen type I. This process leads to progressive volume restoration and improved tissue structure over several weeks to months. Is Sculptra the same as a hyaluronic acid filler Sculptra is not a hyaluronic acid filler. Hyaluronic acid fillers provide immediate volume through gel placement. Sculptra works through collagen stimulation, with results developing gradually. The correction is progressive and relies on the body’s own tissue response rather than instant filling. What is the treatment schedule and duration of effect of Sculptra four treatment sessions spaced approximately three weeks apart. Clinical studies report that results may last up to 24 months when the full protocol is followed. Duration varies based on patient factors, anatomy, and treatment plan. Which areas can Sculptra be used for Approved indications include nasolabial folds, other facial wrinkles, and facial fat loss. Use in additional areas such as hands or body regions is outside the stated indications and depends on practitioner assessment and local regulation.

short_description: PROFHILO® H+L is designed for professional injectable use, providing a high concentration of non-cross-linked HA to deliver skin bioremodelling and deep hydration rather than volumetric filling. It offers clinicians a tool to treat areas of skin laxity with fewer injection points and sessions. Suitable for trained aesthetic practitioners, this device focuses on improving skin quality, texture and tissue tone, making it a valuable component in aesthetic practice.
description: Profhilo H+L Facial Treatment for Hydration and Facial Lifting PROFHILO® H+L is a class of injectable medical-device gel comprising ultra-pure hyaluronic acid (HA) sodium salt in a high-concentration “hybrid cooperative complex” format combining high-molecular-weight (H-HA) and low-molecular-weight (L-HA) chains via the patented NAHYCO® technology. The product is indicated primarily for the treatment of facial skin laxity – for example the malar-zygomatic and sub-malar regions – and for the re-definition of contours and remodelling of lax tissue. The gel is non–chemically cross-linked (i.e., no BDDE) and designed to diffuse within the dermal and sub-cutaneous layers to support hydration, restructure the extracellular matrix, and promote a corrective effect in photo- and chrono-aged skin. What PROFHILO® H+L Is Similar To PROFHILO® H+L can be regarded alongside other skin-booster or bioremodelling injectables such as Sunekos® or Rejuran®, in that all aim to improve skin architecture rather than provide significant volumetric augmentation. For example, Sunekos® uses amino-acid and peptide complexes to stimulate collagen and elastin, while PROFHILO uses HA hybrid complexes for hydration and matrix stimulation. However, unlike many traditional dermal fillers (e.g., HA volumisers such as Juvederm® or Restylane®) which are designed to restore volume or fill wrinkles, PROFHILO® H+L emphasises tissue remodelling and hydration over lifting or bulk augmentation. Its longevity is also distinct: after a primary two-session protocol it is reported to last around six months in many cases , whereas volumising HA fillers may last 9–18 months depending on cross-linking and location. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, PROFHILO® is indicated for the face and body for contour re-definition and laxity remodelling; in particular the malar-zygomatic, sub-malar, brachial (arm) and abdominal areas. Treatment areas: Face (malar & sub-malar) • Body (arms, abdomen, brachial) → For PROFHILO® H+L specifically, the IFU emphasises treatment of facial skin laxity (malar-zygomatic and sub-malar regions) and states use on the body where indicated. Usage / Administration Injection depth : Deep dermal/sub-cutaneous bolus. Volume per point / injection site : 0.2 mL per injection site. Needle gauge : 29 G × ½” (0.33 × 12 mm) is supplied with syringe. Frequency / number of sessions : Initial cycle of two treatment sessions at 30-day (approximately) intervals; maintenance treatments every 2 months if necessary. Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid sodium salt: 32 mg high-molecular-weight HA (H-HA) + 32 mg low-molecular-weight HA (L-HA) per 2 mL syringe. Sodium chloride Sodium phosphate Water for injection Lidocaine: Not provided by manufacturer. Other excipients as per IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation : 1 × 2 mL pre-filled sterile syringe, supplied with 2 × 29 G × ½” needles (0.33 × 12 mm) Longevity (treatment duration) : The effects are typically reported to last about six months after the initial two-session protocol, although individual results may vary depending on patient age, anatomy and injection technique. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the product. Avoid in patients with active skin infections or inflammation at the injection site (e.g., cysts, pimples, rashes) until condition is resolved. Do not inject intravenously, into muscles, tendons or for mammary (breast) augmentation. Single use only; do not reuse syringe; ensure packaging intact and within expiry. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device (CE 0197) in Europe. UKCA status: verify via IFU or distributor. Regulatory classification not fully specified in public documentation for all jurisdictions; verify on the product pack or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ 1. How does PROFHILO® H+L work in the skin? PROFHILO® H+L uses a hybrid complex of low- and high-molecular-weight HA which, once injected into the deep dermal/sub-cutaneous layer, spreads via the BAP (Bio Aesthetic Points) technique and diffuses across the tissue. Its mechanism is described as “bioremodelling” the low-MW HA contributes immediate hydration, while the high-MW HA supports dermal scaffold integrity and stimulates fibroblasts to synthesize new collagen and elastin. 2. Is PROFHILO® H+L the same as a traditional dermal filler? No. Unlike volumising HA fillers that are designed to fill wrinkles or restore volume (via thicker gels, higher cross-linking), PROFHILO® H+L is formulated for tissue remodelling and skin quality improvement rather than structural augmentation. It uses non-cross-linked HA in a spreadable form and fewer injection sites, focusing on hydration, laxity and skin tone. 3. What is the typical treatment protocol and how long do the results last? The standard protocol involves two sessions spaced approximately 30 days apart; after the initial cycle, maintenance treatments may be administered every two months if required. Clinical reports suggest the effect lasts around six months, though this varies with patient factors and injection technique. 4. Can PROFHILO® H+L be used on areas beyond the face? Yes manufacturer documentation includes body areas such as brachial (arms) and abdomen for contour re-definition and skin laxity remodelling. However, practitioners should verify local regulatory indications and patient suitability for off-label uses. 5. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? As with all injectable devices, strict aseptic technique, knowledge of anatomy and patient medical history are essential. Because the product diffuses widely, care must be taken to avoid off-target injection or intravascular placement. Contraindications include active skin infection, severe allergies, bleeding disorders. Post-treatment, patients should avoid strong UV exposure and protect treated areas with sun-block for a few days.

short_description: Teoxyal® RHA Kiss is a professional dermal filler specifically formulated to enhance lip volume, refine shape, and address fine perioral lines with a natural, dynamic result. Its resilient hyaluronic acid gel adapts to facial movement while providing controlled, soft volumisation in mobile areas like the lips and adjacent contours. With 0.3 % lidocaine included for injection comfort, RHA Kiss supports a smoother treatment experience. Intended exclusively for trained healthcare professionals, this product offers a refined solution for clinicians seeking natural‑looking results that respect lip anatomy and expression.
description: Teoxane Teosyal RHA Kiss (2×0,7ml) Teosyal® RHA Kiss is a CE‑marked hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler designed for professional aesthetic use in lip augmentation, contour refinement, and correction of fine perioral lines . Utilising patented RHA® (Resilient Hyaluronic Acid) technology , the gel comprises 23 mg/mL cross‑linked HA of non‑animal origin and 0.3 % lidocaine hydrochloride to enhance comfort during injection. RHA technology is engineered to preserve longer HA polymer chains with resilience and elasticity, making it suited for dynamic mobile regions like the lips, where natural movement is important. The viscoelastic properties support soft volume enhancement and improved lip definition while accommodating facial motion. RHA Kiss is indicated for adding subtle dynamic volume and smoothing perioral wrinkles such as “barcode” lines. Its effects are typically observed immediately with ongoing hydration, and clinical data suggest durations of approximately 6–8 months depending on individual metabolism, injection technique, and anatomical considerations. What Teosyal® RHA Kiss Is Similar To Teosyal® RHA Kiss is comparable to other lip‑oriented HA dermal fillers such as Restylane® Kysse and Juvederm® Volbella XC , which are designed to add subtle volume and refine lip contours while addressing perioral fine lines. Like these products, RHA Kiss uses cross‑linked hyaluronic acid to attract and retain water in tissues, enhancing hydration and structure. The distinguishing feature of RHA Kiss is its resilient HA network , intended to maintain elasticity in dynamic regions like lips and perioral zones. Both Restylane Kysse and Juvederm Volbella also balance volume with flexibility, but differences in HA concentration, particle size, cross‑linking, and rheologic behaviour can influence lift capacity and integration under motion. Longevity for these lip fillers is generally in the 6–9 month range , subject to metabolic and anatomical factors. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications Lip volume enhancement (mucosal tissue) Lip contour definition and symmetry refinement Correction of fine perioral wrinkles (“barcode” lines) Treatment areas per manufacturer/distributor information. Usage / Administration (IFU‑Only Section) Only use data directly supported by official product documentation. Where items are not stated in the publicly available IFU, this is noted. Injection depth: Lip mucosa for volume and vermilion enhancement Mid‑dermis for perioral fine lines Volume per point / injection site: Not provided by manufacturer Needle gauge: 30G × ½″ sterile needles included in packaging Frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer Professional‑use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions Some clinicians may use specific layering or micro‑linear techniques for perioral lines; such approaches are not part of the official manufacturer guidance. Ingredient List Hyaluronic Acid (HA): 23 mg/mL cross‑linked RHA of non‑animal origin Lidocaine Hydrochloride: 0.3 % for procedural comfort Phosphate Buffer (pH 7.3): stabilising excipient Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 2 × 0.7 ml pre‑filled syringes, 2 × 30G × ½″ needles , traceability labels, product insert Shelf life: Not provided by manufacturer Treatment duration: ≈6–8 months , variable by individual factors Safety Notes / Contraindications Hypersensitivity: Contraindicated in individuals with known hypersensitivity to HA, lidocaine, or any component of the formulation. Active conditions: Avoid injection in areas of active infection, inflammation, or compromised tissue integrity. Pregnancy / breastfeeding: Contraindicated, as with many HA fillers, unless otherwise authorised in local IFU. Allergy caution: Prior allergy assessment is recommended for patients with a history of hypersensitivity reactions. Regulatory Status CE‑marked Class III medical device under EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR). Regulatory classification not specified in public documentation; verify on product pack or manufacturer IFU. FAQ 1. What is Teosyal® RHA Kiss? Teosyal® RHA Kiss is a resilient hyaluronic acid dermal filler formulated to enhance lip volume, redefine lip contours, and improve fine perioral lines . It utilises RHA® technology, combining elastic cross‑linked HA (23 mg/mL) with 0.3 % lidocaine to support dynamic movement and patient comfort during injection by trained professionals. 2. How does RHA Kiss work? The product works by increasing volume and hydration within lip and perioral tissues through HA’s capacity to retain water. Its resilient cross‑linked structure is designed to adapt to movement, providing flexibility and natural integration in mobile facial zones. 3. Where is RHA Kiss indicated? According to available product data, RHA Kiss is indicated for lip mucosal augmentation , lip contour refinement , and correction of fine perioral wrinkles (“barcode” lines) . Injection depth varies by target tissue, with mucosal placement for lips and mid‑dermal for perioral lines. 4. How long do results last? Distributor and product literature suggests that results from Teosyal® RHA Kiss typically persist around 6–8 months , influenced by individual metabolism, anatomy, and injection technique. 5. Is RHA Kiss safe? When administered by trained clinicians following aseptic technique and proper patient assessment, RHA Kiss is generally well tolerated. As with all HA fillers, transient reactions like mild swelling, redness, or tenderness may occur. Contraindications include known component hypersensitivity and active infection at the treatment site.

description: Teoxane Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 (1×3 mL) Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 is a non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA) skin booster medical device developed by Teoxane Laboratories to improve skin hydration, redensification, and early signs of aging across the face, neck, and décolletage. Its formula combines 15 mg/mL of free high-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid with a patented dermo-restructuring complex of amino acids, antioxidants, minerals, and vitamin B6 — plus 0.3 % lidocaine to enhance patient comfort during injection. The nutrient-enriched gel is injected into the superficial to mid dermis to support tissue hydration, firmness, and prevention of fine lines and wrinkles. Teosyal Redensity 1 is intended for use by trained healthcare professionals experienced in aesthetic injectable treatments. Teosyal Redensity 1 is distinct from traditional volumising dermal fillers; rather than restoring volume, it focuses on skin texture improvement, enhanced hydration and redensification of aged or dehydrated skin, helping to support a fresher and more resilient appearance. What Teosyal Redensity 1 Is Similar To Teosyal Redensity 1 belongs to the Teosyal® PureSense line of skin boosters and can be regarded alongside other nutrient-enriched HA treatments that target skin quality rather than volumetric augmentation . Like Profhilo® or other HA-based hydration boosters, Redensity 1 uses unmodified free HA to attract and retain water in tissues, thereby enhancing hydration and general skin health. However, in addition to HA, Redensity 1 incorporates a dermo-restructuring complex of amino acids, antioxidants, minerals, and vitamin B6 designed to support cellular activity and dermal integrity. In contrast to thicker cross-linked HA fillers (e.g., Juvederm® or Restylane® volumisers), which are designed for deep wrinkle correction and volume restoration, Teosyal Redensity 1 emphasises subtle improvement in skin texture, tonicity, and hydration . This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer and distributor documentation, Teosyal PureSense Redensity 1 is indicated for: Skin redensification and hydration of the face, neck, and décolletage. Prevention and reduction of fine lines and early signs of aging . Improvement of skin texture, firmness, and overall luminosity . Treatment areas and injection depth should be determined by a qualified medical professional based on individual assessment and aesthetic goals. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Superficial to mid dermis, depending on treatment area. Volume per injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: Typically supplied with 30 G × ½″ needles . Frequency / number of sessions: Treatment protocols often involve multiple sessions spaced approximately 3 weeks apart , with maintenance sessions recommended periodically; official guidance may vary. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified healthcare professionals experienced in dermal injections under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted from official IFU or product documentation, it is recorded as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid (HA): 15 mg/mL of non-cross-linked HA. Lidocaine hydrochloride: 0.3 % (w/w) to enhance injection comfort. Dermo-restructuring complex: 8 amino acids (e.g., glycine, lysine, threonine, proline, isoleucine, leucine, valine, arginine) 3 antioxidants (e.g., glutathione, N-acetyl-L-cysteine, alpha-lipoic acid) 2 minerals (zinc, copper) Vitamin B6 All excipients and supplemental buffering agents are included per IFU and ensure compatibility with HA. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 3 mL pre-filled sterile syringe (traceability labelling included). Shelf life: Not specified in public documentation; refer to product packaging for expiry date. Longevity (treatment duration): According to manufacturer guidance for PureSense products, Teosyal Redensity 1 has an estimated in-vivo lifetime of at least 3 months following treatment. Individual duration may vary with skin condition, injection technique, and lifestyle factors. Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any component of the formulation. Avoid injection into areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin integrity. Strict aseptic technique and detailed anatomical knowledge are essential to minimise risks. Refer to the official Instructions for Use for complete warnings, precautions, and post-treatment care. Regulatory Status Teosyal PureSense Redensity 1 is a CE-marked medical device authorised for aesthetic use in Europe. Users should verify region-specific regulatory details (e.g., UKCA) via product packaging or formal IFU documentation. FAQ 1. What is Teosyal Redensity 1? Teosyal Redensity 1 is a nutrient-enriched skin booster based on non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid combined with antioxidants, amino acids, minerals, and vitamin B6 to hydrate, redensify and improve skin quality . It includes 0.3 % lidocaine to enhance injection comfort and is used in superficial dermal layers. 2. How long does Teosyal Redensity 1 last? According to manufacturer guidance for Teosyal PureSense products, the estimated in-vivo lifetime of Redensity 1 is at least 3 months after treatment. Effects can vary based on skin characteristics, treatment protocol, and injection technique. 3. What areas can Teosyal Redensity 1 be used on? Teosyal Redensity 1 is typically injected into the face, neck, and décolletage to improve hydration, skin texture, and reduce early signs of aging. 4. Is Teosyal Redensity 1 a traditional volumising filler? No — Redensity 1 is a skin booster , not a structural volume filler. Its primary purpose is skin redensification and hydration , rather than restoring deep volume like thicker cross-linked HA fillers. 5. Can Teosyal Redensity 1 be combined with other aesthetic treatments? Treatment protocols may include combining Redensity 1 with other aesthetic procedures, but this should be determined by a qualified clinician. Official IFU instructions do not prescribe combination therapies and such decisions remain at the practitioner’s discretion.

short_description: Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 is intended for practitioners seeking a hyaluronic acid skin booster focused on skin quality improvement rather than volume correction. Its formulation combines non-cross-linked HA with a revitalising dermal complex, while lidocaine supports improved comfort during treatment. Supplied in sterile, single-use syringes, Redensity 1 is designed for intradermal administration by trained medical professionals only. Product selection and treatment planning should follow a thorough patient assessment and comply fully with the official Teoxane IFU and applicable regulatory standards.
description: Teoxane Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 (2x1ml) Teoxane Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 is a sterile, resorbable hyaluronic acid–based skin booster designed to improve skin quality rather than provide volumisation. It combines non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid with a dermal revitalising complex of amino acids, antioxidants, and minerals, intended to support hydration and overall skin condition. The formulation incorporates lidocaine hydrochloride to enhance patient comfort during injection. Redensity 1 is classified as a biorevitalising injectable and is indicated for professional aesthetic use in patients presenting with early signs of skin ageing, dullness, or dehydration. Unlike volumising dermal fillers, it is designed for superficial intradermal placement and aims to support skin quality across treated areas. Clinical outcomes depend on patient-specific factors and strict adherence to the manufacturer’s Instructions for Use (IFU). Administration must be performed only by qualified medical professionals under appropriate clinical conditions . What Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 Is Similar To Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 belongs to the category of injectable skin boosters and biorevitalisers formulated to improve hydration and skin quality rather than restore volume. In this respect, it may be clinically compared to products such as Profhilo® or Sunekos® , which are also designed to support dermal quality through hyaluronic acid–based mechanisms. While all three products aim to enhance skin condition, they differ in formulation and biological approach. Redensity 1 combines non-cross-linked HA with a defined complex of amino acids and antioxidants, whereas Profhilo® relies on hybrid HA complexes and Sunekos® incorporates specific amino acid blends. Longevity and treatment protocols vary between products and depend on manufacturer guidance and patient factors. Redensity 1 includes lidocaine within the formulation, which is not present in all comparable skin boosters. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer and distributor documentation: Face Neck Décolletage Hands Indicated for improvement of skin quality, hydration, and dermal support. Usage / Administration (IFU-only section) All administration parameters must strictly follow the official Teoxane IFU. Injection depth: intradermal Volume per injection point / site: not provided by manufacturer Needle gauge: 30G (supplied) Frequency / number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer Professional-use disclaimer: Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 must be administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions and in accordance with the manufacturer’s IFU and local regulations. Some practitioners apply specific treatment protocols based on clinical experience; these are not included in the manufacturer’s official IFU . Ingredient List Non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid – 15 mg/mL Amino acids (including glycine, proline, lysine, leucine, valine, alanine, arginine) Antioxidants and minerals (dermal revitalising complex) Lidocaine hydrochloride – present (0.3%) Phosphate buffer Water for injections Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 2 × 1.0 mL prefilled syringes Needles: supplied with sterile 30G needles Shelf life: not provided by manufacturer Treatment longevity: not provided by manufacturer Clinical duration may vary depending on patient factors and treatment protocol. Safety Notes / Contraindications Based on manufacturer documentation and standard medical-device guidance: Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any component of the formulation Contraindicated in areas with active skin infection or inflammation Not recommended for use during pregnancy or breastfeeding as a precaution Intravascular injection must be avoided Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device UKCA status: verify via authorised distributor or product packaging Regulatory classification not specified in public documentation; verify on the product pack or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ What is Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 used for? Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 is an injectable skin booster designed to improve skin quality, hydration, and dermal condition. It is not intended for volumisation but rather for biorevitalisation of areas showing early signs of ageing or dehydration. Treatment must be carried out by qualified medical professionals in accordance with the IFU. How does Redensity 1 differ from dermal fillers? Unlike volumising dermal fillers, Redensity 1 uses non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid combined with amino acids and antioxidants to support skin quality. It is placed intradermally and aims to improve overall skin condition rather than restore volume or contour . Does Redensity 1 contain lidocaine? Yes. Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 contains lidocaine hydrochloride at a concentration of 0.3% to help improve patient comfort during injection. This information is provided by the manufacturer and distributors . How long do results last? The manufacturer does not specify a fixed duration of effect for Redensity 1. Longevity may vary depending on patient metabolism, treatment area, and treatment protocol, and should be discussed during consultation . Who can administer Redensity 1? Redensity 1 must only be administered by trained and qualified medical professionals operating within a regulated clinical environment and following the manufacturer’s IFU and local regulations .

short_description: Teoxane Teosyal® PureSense Ultra Deep is a professional hyaluronic acid filler designed for deep volumising and contour correction in areas of significant tissue loss. Its cohesive gel structure supports controlled projection while maintaining integration within surrounding tissues. Formulated with lidocaine for enhanced injection comfort, the product is suitable for clinicians seeking a reliable solution for advanced volume restoration. Supplied as prefilled syringes and manufactured to European medical-device standards, Teosyal PureSense Ultra Deep is intended for trained practitioners delivering deep structural aesthetic treatments.
description: Teoxane Teosyal® PureSense Ultra Deep Teosyal® PureSense Ultra Deep is a CE-marked hyaluronic acid dermal filler developed for deep tissue volumisation and structural support in areas requiring significant projection and contour restoration. Manufactured by Teoxane Laboratories , the product contains cross-linked hyaluronic acid of non-animal origin , formulated to maintain stability under dynamic facial movement while providing robust lifting capacity. The inclusion of lidocaine hydrochloride (PureSense technology) is intended to improve patient comfort during injection. Teosyal PureSense Ultra Deep is characterised by a highly cohesive gel structure , supporting placement in deeper anatomical planes where mechanical strength and shape retention are required. The product is supplied in prefilled syringes and is intended for use exclusively by qualified medical professionals, in accordance with manufacturer guidance and applicable regulatory standards. What Teosyal® PureSense Ultra Deep Is Similar To Teosyal® PureSense Ultra Deep belongs to the category of high-density hyaluronic acid dermal fillers designed for deep volumisation and contour support. Comparable products include Juvederm® Voluma and Restylane® Lyft , which similarly utilise cross-linked HA to restore volume in deeper tissue planes. Compared with mid-dermal fillers or skin-boosting injectables such as Profhilo® , Ultra Deep is formulated specifically for structural correction rather than skin hydration or bio-remodelling . Its gel characteristics are optimised for projection and shape retention rather than superficial tissue integration. Longevity across this category varies depending on HA cross-linking technology, injection depth, anatomical area, and patient-specific metabolic factors. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only Section) Only parameters explicitly supported by manufacturer or IFU-level documentation are listed. Injection depth: not provided by manufacturer Volume per injection point: not provided by manufacturer Needle gauge: not provided by manufacturer Frequency / number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. Some practitioners apply region-specific deep-plane techniques; these are not included in the manufacturer’s official IFU. Ingredient List Cross-linked hyaluronic acid (non-animal origin) — concentration not provided by manufacturer Lidocaine hydrochloride — percentage not provided by manufacturer Physiological buffer solution (excipients) Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 2 × 1.2 ml prefilled syringes Shelf life: not provided by manufacturer Treatment duration: not provided by manufacturer Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any formulation component Should not be used in the presence of active skin infection or inflammation at the injection site Use with caution in patients with autoimmune conditions or a history of severe allergic reactions , in accordance with general HA filler precautions Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device for aesthetic use within the European market Regulatory classification not specified in public documentation; verify on the product packaging or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ 1. What is Teosyal® PureSense Ultra Deep used for? Teosyal PureSense Ultra Deep is intended for deep tissue volumisation and structural contour correction in cases of significant volume loss. It is formulated to provide mechanical support in deeper tissue planes rather than superficial skin improvement. 2. How does Teosyal PureSense Ultra Deep work? The product uses cross-linked hyaluronic acid to physically restore volume by occupying space within deep soft tissues. Its cohesive gel structure supports shape retention and resistance to deformation under facial movement. 3. Does Teosyal PureSense Ultra Deep contain lidocaine? Yes. The formulation includes lidocaine hydrochloride to support patient comfort during injection. The exact concentration is not specified in publicly available manufacturer documentation. 4. How long do results last? The manufacturer does not state a defined duration of effect. Longevity depends on multiple factors including injection depth, treatment area, patient metabolism, and volume used. 5. How does it differ from mid-dermal fillers? Ultra Deep is designed for deep structural support , whereas mid-dermal fillers focus on moderate volume correction or wrinkle smoothing. It is not intended for superficial skin hydration or bio-remodelling applications.

description: Sunekos® Performa (Sunekos® 200) 2 × 3.5 mL Sunekos® Performa , also known as Sunekos® 200 , is an injectable medical device formulated with a patented combination of low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid and a specific amino acid complex. description: Seventy Hyal 2000 is a highly advanced skin booster designed to address the physiological depletion of hyaluronic acid within the skin. As an injectable skincare solution, it integrates deep into the dermis to deliver intense hydration, improve skin elasticity, and stimulate the natural production of collagen and elastin. One of the key advantages of Seventy Hyal 2000 is its use of high molecular weight HA (>2000 kDa), which offers long-lasting hydration and structural support to the skin. Unlike traditional dermal fillers, this skin booster does not add excessive volume but instead imparts a natural glow and smooths out fine lines. Its biocompatible, CE-marked, and vegan-friendly composition ensures safety and effectiveness for all skin types, making it an ideal choice for aesthetic practitioners seeking high-performance skin rejuvenation treatments. Seventy Hyal 2000 is suitable for treating the face, tear troughs, neck, décolletage, hands, and lips , offering a comprehensive approach to non-surgical facial revitalization. The results of this treatment are visible almost immediately due to the high molecular weight HA, with continued improvements over time. The recommended treatment protocol varies depending on the patient’s skin quality and individual needs, with optimal outcomes seen after a series of sessions. description: Clinical Description RRS® Hyalift 75 is a CE-marked injectable dermal implant and skin biorevitalisation product designed for the treatment of skin photoageing, dermal atrophy, dehydration, and age-related deterioration in skin quality. The formulation contains non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA) at a concentration of 15 mg/mL (75 mg per 5 mL vial), suspended within a protective solution containing amino acids and antioxidant components intended to support dermal hydration and extracellular matrix maintenance. Unlike volumising dermal fillers, RRS® Hyalift 75 is primarily intended to improve skin hydration, elasticity, texture, and overall skin quality rather than create structural volume. The product is commonly used in professional aesthetic medicine protocols targeting facial and body areas affected by photoageing and tissue laxity. According to manufacturer information, treatment indications include skin photoageing and its consequences, dermal atrophy, and hydration support for ageing skin. What RRS® Hyalift 75 Is Similar To RRS® Hyalift 75 belongs to the category of injectable skin boosters and biorevitalisation products. It is most comparable to products such as Profhilo® and Jalupro® , although important differences exist. Like Profhilo®, RRS® Hyalift 75 uses hyaluronic acid to improve hydration and skin quality. However, Profhilo® contains hybrid cooperative complexes of high- and low-molecular-weight HA, whereas RRS® Hyalift 75 uses non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid combined with amino acids and antioxidant compounds. Compared with Jalupro®, RRS® Hyalift 75 shares the inclusion of amino-acid support ingredients intended to assist extracellular matrix maintenance. However, the specific formulation, concentration profile, and manufacturer protocols differ. RRS® Hyalift 75 is generally positioned as a hydration-focused biorevitalisation product for skin quality enhancement rather than a volumising filler or collagen-stimulating implant. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer information, commonly treated areas include: Face Neck Décolletage (cleavage) Back of hands Inner arms Inner thighs Peri-umbilical area Abdomen, including stretch-mark-prone areas Primary indications include: Skin photoageing Dermal atrophy Dehydrated skin Fine superficial wrinkles Reduced skin elasticity Age-related skin quality deterioration Usage / Administration (IFU-Only Section) Treatment frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer in publicly available documentation. Professional-use statement: RRS® Hyalift 75 is intended to be administered only by legally qualified healthcare professionals in authorised clinical settings under appropriate aseptic conditions. Important: Some practitioners describe intradermal mesotherapy protocols using fine-gauge needles. However, these approaches are not included in the manufacturer’s publicly available official IFU referenced for this description . Do not use in patients with known hypersensitivity to any product component. Avoid treatment in areas with active infection, inflammation, or skin disease. Treatment should be postponed in patients presenting with local infectious processes at the intended treatment site. Where the complete IFU is unavailable, standard injectable-device precautions apply, including careful patient assessment and adherence to aseptic technique. No FDA approval information was identified in publicly available documentation reviewed for this product. FAQ 1. What is RRS® Hyalift 75? RRS® Hyalift 75 is an injectable skin biorevitalisation product containing non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid at 15 mg/mL combined with amino acids and antioxidant-supporting ingredients. The formulation delivers non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid directly into the skin, where it contributes to hydration and water retention. The accompanying amino acids and antioxidant components are designed to support extracellular matrix maintenance and skin revitalisation processes. 3. Is RRS® Hyalift 75 a dermal filler? While it contains hyaluronic acid, its primary purpose is skin hydration and biorevitalisation rather than structural volume replacement. It is generally used to improve skin quality, texture, and hydration. 4. Which areas can be treated with RRS® Hyalift 75? Manufacturer information identifies several treatment areas including the face, neck, décolletage, back of the hands, inner arms, inner thighs, peri-umbilical region, and abdomen. These areas are commonly affected by photoageing, dehydration, and dermal atrophy. 5. How long do results from RRS® Hyalift 75 last? The manufacturer does not publish a specific longevity claim for RRS® Hyalift 75 in publicly available documentation. Treatment duration varies according to patient factors, treatment protocols, and practitioner recommendations. For this reason, expected longevity should be discussed during professional consultation.

short_description: Revolax Fine precisely diminishes fine lines and wrinkles. Its high-viscosity hyaluronic acid gel, possessing viscoelastic properties, ensures a pliable consistency that distributes evenly for a natural look. description: Revolax Fine with Lido offers an exceptional solution for fine lines and wrinkles, including glabellar lines, neck wrinkles, and crow’s feet. This lightweight, high-viscosity dermal filler, made from high-purity hyaluronic acid, blends seamlessly with human skin tissue. Consequently, it provides a natural and smooth finish while quickly penetrating the skin to deliver instant and enduring results. Treatment Areas Crow’s Feet : Reduces fine lines around the eyes. Glabellar Lines : Smooths vertical lines between the eyebrows. Neck Wrinkles : Minimizes lines and wrinkles on the neck. Usage Administer Revolax Fine with Lido through precise injections into the targeted superficial areas. The high-viscosity gel allows for excellent molding and adjustment during application. Thus, it ensures tailored and long-lasting results. Additionally, the inclusion of lido provides a more comfortable injection experience by minimizing discomfort. Ingredient List Cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid : 24 mg/ml – Provides high-density, long-lasting volume and support. Lido HCI : 3 mg/ml – An anesthetic agent included to reduce injection pain. Phosphate Buffered Saline Solution, pH 7.0 : q.s. – Ensures the stability and biocompatibility of the filler. Product Dimensions/Size Volume : 1.1 ml per syringe Needles : Includes 2 sterile 30G needles Packaging : Available in single 1.1 ml syringe packs Product Duration Revolax Fine with Lido offers long-lasting results, typically between 12-18 months. However, this duration may vary depending on the individual’s skin type and treatment area. Manufacturer Across, a renowned company in the field of aesthetic medicine known for its innovative and high-quality dermal fillers, manufactures Revolax Fine with Lido. Features High Viscoelasticity : Provides long-lasting volume and support. Low Phase Angle : Ensures the filler stays closer to the injection site for longer, reducing migration risks. Patented Particle Technology : Achieves uniform particle size for easier injections and enhanced treatment effects. High Quality & Density : Offers one of the densest HA fillers available, achieving a particle weight of 2,500,000 Da for added volume. Biodegradable : Natural absorption ensures safety and efficacy. Recommendations Revolax Fine with Lido suits individuals seeking to diminish fine lines and wrinkles, particularly in the crow’s feet, glabellar lines, and neck wrinkles. However, consider the following precautions: Pregnant or lactating women should not use it. Individuals with allergies to hyaluronic acid or lido should avoid it. It is not recommended for children under 18 or adults over 65. Do not use on skin with infections at the injection site. Avoid if there is a history of muscle weakness conditions (e.g., myasthenia gravis). Patients with coagulation disorders or those on anticoagulants or platelet aggregation inhibitors should not use it. Patients should avoid makeup for 12 hours post-injection and minimize exposure to sunlight, UV light, and extreme temperatures for two weeks after the injection. Precautions Revolax Fine with Lido is for single use only; do not re-sterilize. Avoid mixing with other products before implantation. Hyaluronic acid products are incompatible with quaternary ammonium salts like benzalkonium chloride. If the needle gets stuck, stop the injection, replace the needle, and continue. Summary Revolax Fine with Lido stands out as an effective, high-quality dermal filler designed for treating superficial lines and wrinkles. With its high-purity hyaluronic acid and added lido for comfort, it ensures a natural, youthful appearance with long-lasting results.

This skin booster is commonly used by aesthetic practitioners for facial rejuvenation and treatment of areas demonstrating reduced elasticity or dehydration, including the face, neck, décolletage, and hands. Restylane® Vital with Lidocaine is generally positioned as a skin quality treatment rather than a volumising dermal filler. description: Radiesse® Lifting & Volume Filler by Merz Aesthetics 1 × 1.5 mL Radiesse® Lifting & Volume Filler is an injectable calcium hydroxylapatite (CaHA) dermal filler medical device developed by Merz Aesthetics for the correction of moderate to severe facial wrinkles and folds , as well as facial contour enhancement and volume restoration. Merz Radiesse is designed for deep dermal to subdermal placement, offering firm projection and long-lasting support in areas requiring structural definition rather than superficial refinement. Compared with softer HA fillers, Radiesse offers firmer structural support and is typically selected for deeper folds or contouring procedures. The formulation integrates high and low molecular weight hyaluronic acid to support superficial adipose tissue and facial contour definition. description: Profhilo Structura with cannula 2x1ml Profhilo Structura is an injectable hyaluronic acid product indicated for patients with age related loss of facial adipose tissue and reduced structural support. It uses patented NAHYCO technology, combining high and low molecular weight hyaluronic acid into hybrid cooperative complexes. This composition supports superficial fat compartments, improves facial contour, and enhances deep tissue hydration. Unlike traditional dermal fillers this gel product contains no chemical cross linking agents and is not designed for focal volumisation. Its mechanism focuses on biological interaction with subcutaneous tissue to support firmness and structural integrity. Profhilo Structura is used in professional aesthetic practice for midface volume loss, contour refinement, and age associated changes linked to adipose tissue reduction. What Profhilo Structura Is Similar To Profhilo Structura belongs to the category of hyaluronic acid injectables designed for tissue remodelling rather than traditional wrinkle filling. It shares a related technological platform with Profhilo, as both products use hybrid complexes of high and low molecular weight hyaluronic acid. Standard Profhilo focuses on skin hydration, elasticity, and dermal bio remodelling, with primary effects in the dermis. Profhilo Structura differs by targeting superficial adipose tissue and structural support, with indications centred on contour refinement and volume support in areas affected by age related fat loss. Structura also contains a higher total hyaluronic acid content per syringe. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Is Profhilo Structura a dermal filler Profhilo Structura is not a conventional dermal filler. Traditional fillers create defined volume in specific areas. Profhilo Structura focuses on tissue support and contour through adipose interaction rather than focal volumisation. Clinical outcomes vary between individuals and develop gradually following treatment as the hyaluronic acid integrates with tissue. How does Profhilo Structura differ from Profhilo Both products use hybrid hyaluronic acid complexes. Profhilo targets dermal hydration and skin quality. short_description: Plenhyage XL Thin offers a refined solution for clinicians seeking to revitalise delicate or early-aging skin without adding bulk. With its polynucleotide-based formula, it supports tissue regeneration, improves skin resilience and enhances hydration in sensitive zones such as the periorbital area, neck or décolletage. Utilised by trained professionals, this device is designed for subtle skin quality transformation rather than deep volumetric correction.
description: Plenhyage XL Thin 1 × 2 ml – In stock Clinical Description Plenhyage XL Thin is a Class III injectable medical-device from Bioformula s.r.l. (Italy) based on high-molecular-weight polynucleotides (PDRN) for professional use. Its core mechanism entails the stimulation of fibroblasts, support of collagen and extracellular-matrix regeneration, and hydration via polymerised DNA fragments derived from salmon sperm DNA, fully biocompatible and resorbable. Indicated for improving skin quality in delicate, thin, fragile or photo-aged zones (rather than for volumetric filling), Plenhyage XL Thin acts as a biorevitaliser/skin-booster to restore tone, elasticity and structure of the skin. What Plenhyage XL Thin Is Similar To Plenhyage XL Thin occupies the category of polynucleotide-based biostimulation injectables, akin to products such as Jalupro (which combine amino acids + PDRN) and the broader range of Plenhyage XL (Medium and Strong). For example, Jalupro offers skin-quality improvement by stimulating fibroblasts and ECM repair; similarly Plenhyage XL Thin focuses on cellular renewal using PDRN. The main difference lies in indication and concentration: while Jalupro may include peptides and amino acids, Plenhyage XL Thin is a dedicated high-molecular polynucleotide gel with very delicate skin indication [2]. Compared to its sibling formulations such as Plenhyage XL Medium (≈2 %) or Strong (≈2.5 %) [3], Thin employs a lower concentration better suited to fragile zones. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to marketing/manufacturer information: Face: delicate zones (thin skin) Periorbital area (around the eyes) Neck and décolletage Sensitive or fragile skin zones & post-treatment support (laser/peel) If strictly following the manufacturer IFU, the full list of indicated areas is: “face, neck and décolleté”. Usage / Administration (IFU-only section) Injection depth: not provided by manufacturer for this specific “Thin” variant . Volume per point/injection site: not provided by manufacturer . Needle gauge: not provided by manufacturer . Frequency / number of sessions: Manufacturer states “multiple sessions are usually required; doctor to develop a personalised treatment plan.” Some professional sources note a recommended course of 2-4 sessions at 14-21 day intervals , followed by a maintenance session every 3-6 months. (This is not part of the official manufacturer IFU). Professional-use disclaimer: “Intended for professional medical use only” and “administered by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions”. Ingredient List Polynucleotides (PDRN), high molecular weight ~0.75 % for Thin variant. Sterile Water. Buffering Solution.Lidocaine: not provided by manufacturer . HA concentration: not applicable / not provided by manufacturer , as this is a polynucleotide-based product, not a hyaluronic acid filler. Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 1 pre-filled glass syringe of 2 mL with 2 disposable needles. Shelf life/storage: not provided by manufacturer in publicly accessible sources . Longevity/duration of effect: While the manufacturer states “duration varies depending on individual needs” some distributor information cites up to 4-6 months for Thin variant. Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the device. Contraindicated at injection sites with active skin infection or inflammation. Use is not indicated for pregnant or breastfeeding women as per some sources. Use is for professional medical use only — improper use may increase risk of adverse events. Note: Since the manufacturer did not provide a full public IFU on injection depth or techniques, practitioners must adhere to local regulatory and best-practice guidelines for polynucleotide injections. Regulatory Status CE marked: Class III medical device, CE 0373. UKCA: not explicitly stated in the publicly available documentation; verify on product pack or with distributor . FDA: No US FDA 510(k) or PMA cleared status found in the publicly available documentation — verify with manufacturer or regulatory database. FAQ How does Plenhyage XL Thin work? Plenhyage XL Thin uses high-molecular-weight polynucleotides (PDRN), which stimulate fibroblast activity and extracellular-matrix regeneration, support hydration by binding water, and improve skin elasticity and texture [1]. The device thereby enhances the skin’s structural environment rather than volumising it. Is the treatment safe? Yes — as a Class III CE-marked device for professional use only, Plenhyage XL Thin has a documented safety profile for its intended use. Transient injection-site reactions (redness, swelling, bruising) may occur, as with any injectable device [1]. Proper patient selection (excluding active infection, hypersensitivity, pregnant/breastfeeding women) and aseptic technique are essential. What is the recommended treatment schedule? The manufacturer states that multiple sessions are required and a personalised plan should be developed by the clinician [1]. Some professional sources (not in the official IFU) indicate 2-4 sessions at 14-21 day intervals with maintenance at 3-6 months [4]. How long do results typically last? The official manufacturer information states that duration varies depending on skin condition and treatment area [1]. Distributor-listed information for Thin suggests results typically last 4-6 months [5]. Individual outcomes may differ. How does Plenhyage XL Thin compare to hyaluronic-acid fillers? Unlike traditional hyaluronic-acid dermal fillers, which primarily provide volume and structure, Plenhyage XL Thin is designed for skin-quality improvement via biostimulation rather than volumisation [2]. It is especially suited for thin, delicate skin zones where adding volume is not desirable. It should be selected based on indication rather than being considered a direct substitute for HA fillers.

description: Clinical Description Plenhyage XL Strong is a Class III CE-marked injectable medical device produced by Bioformula s.r.l. (Italy), formulated with 2.5% high-molecular-weight polynucleotides (PDRN) derived from salmon DNA. The mechanism centres on fibroblast activation, extracellular-matrix regeneration and enhanced dermal hydration via polynucleotide-mediated tissue renewal. The formulation is designed for treating more advanced signs of skin aging, photo-damage or fibrotic tissue changes, rather than volumetric augmentation. Suggested indications include skin laxity, loss of elasticity, fine lines and sun-damaged skin over face, neck, décolletage and body regions. What Plenhyage XL Strong Is Similar To Plenhyage XL Strong falls within the higher-concentration polynucleotide (PN) biostimulator category and can be compared with products like Jalupro Advanced (which combines amino acids + PDRN) and other PN-based skin boosters. While Jalupro offers a combined amino-acid/PDRN modality targeting moderate skin degradation, Plenhyage XL Strong provides a higher single-active PDRN concentration (2.5%) for more intensive regenerative support. Compared to its sister formulations — Plenhyage XL Medium (~2.0%) and Plenhyage XL Thin (~0.75%) — the Strong variant is suited to more pronounced skin aging or body applications. For orientation, the HA-based bioremodeller Profhilo targets skin quality improvement via large-volume HA diffusion rather than PN-based cellular activation; thus choice depends on mechanism and indication. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer product page: Face (including moderate-to-advanced signs of aging) Neck and décolletage Body zones (hands, inner arms, thighs, knees) in cases of skin laxity/fibrosis Usage / Administration (IFU-only section) Injection depth: not provided by manufacturer in publicly-accessible product page. Volume per point / injection site: not provided by manufacturer . Needle gauge: not provided by manufacturer . Frequency / number of sessions: Manufacturer states: “duration of the treatment varies depending on individual needs and the area treated. Hyaluronic acid: Some distributor pages mention HA inclusion, but manufacturer site focuses on PN only; exact HA concentration for this variant is not verified in public documentation . Distributor references suggest effects lasting 6–12 months in many cases (depending on skin condition and maintenance) but this is not officially guaranteed . Do not inject into or adjacent to sites with active skin infection, inflammation or open wounds. Use only by trained medical professionals under sterile conditions. Improper use may increase adverse-event risk. For details on other contraindications (e.g., pregnancy/breastfeeding, immunocompromised states, autoimmune disorders) refer to full IFU and local regulations — public documentation is limited. They stimulate fibroblasts, enhance extracellular-matrix repair and increase dermal hydration via binding water molecules. This supports improved skin elasticity and structure rather than immediate volumetric fill . Q2: Is Plenhyage XL Strong safe to use? A2: According to manufacturer data, the device is well-tolerated when administered by a qualified medical professional. Mild transient reactions (e.g., swelling, redness, bruising) are possible. Strict adherence to professional use, aseptic technique and proper patient selection minimise risks . Q3: How often should the treatment be performed? A3: The manufacturer indicates that multiple sessions are usually required and that treatment plans should be personalised. Specific injection intervals or counts are not given in the IFU [1]. Some practitioner protocols – not official – suggest 2–4 sessions with 2–4-week intervals, followed by maintenance every 6–12 months . Q4: How long will the results last? A4: Manufacturer guidance states that results vary depending on patient factors and treatment area. While distributor practice data report 6–12 months duration for many cases, this is not a guaranteed timeframe and should be discussed with the clinician. Q5: Can Plenhyage XL Strong be used instead of a hyaluronic-acid filler? A5: Not as a direct replacement: Plenhyage XL Strong is a polynucleotide-based biostimulator targeting tissue regeneration and skin quality improvement, whereas HA fillers primarily provide volume and structural support. Treatment choice should align with the clinical objective — regeneration vs volumisation .

description: LUMI-PN EYES is a polynucleotide (PDRN) based skin booster formulated for periocular (under-eye and eye-area) use. Its active component is ultra-pure PDRN at approximately 20 mg/ml, delivering a total of 30 mg PDRN per 1.5 ml syringe, aimed at supporting tissue regeneration in delicate skin zones.¹²³ Rather than functioning as a volumising dermal filler, LUMI-PN EYES works via a regenerative mechanism: PDRN fragments are proposed to stimulate dermal repair, support fibroblast activity, and promote extracellular matrix remodelling potentially improving skin tone, elasticity, hydration, and reducing signs of fatigue or dark circles around the eyes.¹²⁴ What LUMI-PN EYES Is Similar To LUMI-PN EYES belongs to the class of polynucleotide-based skin boosters rather than traditional hyaluronic acid (HA) fillers. As such, it more closely resembles treatments aimed at skin quality improvement — similar in intent to products like Profhilo (skin-hydrating HA booster) or other PDRN/PN skin-boosters used for skin rejuvenation and texture improvement rather than volumising. short_description: EXP DATE: 02/2027 Lumifil L-Lite with Lidocaine 1 x 1.0 ml is a lightweight hyaluronic acid filler designed for subtle lip enhancement, hydration, and refined texture. Ideal as a lumifil lip booster with integrated lidocaine for improved comfort during injection.
description: Lumifil L-Lite with Lidocaine 1 x 1.0 ml – Soft Hyaluronic Acid Lip Filler Lumifil L-Lite with Lidocaine 1 x 1.0 ml is a lightweight cross‑linked hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler with integrated lidocaine designed for subtle lip enhancement, hydration, and refinement in delicate facial areas. Unlike deep volumising fillers, it provides mild volume, restores hydration, and smooths fine texture with soft integration into tissue, making it suitable for aesthetic professionals seeking natural‑looking results. What Lumifil L-Lite with Lidocaine Is Similar To Lumifil L-Lite can be considered alongside other light‑density HA fillers or lip boosters such as Juvederm® Volbella, Restylane® Silk, and Teosyal® Rha 1 that prioritise hydration, natural enhancement, and texture improvement without significant volumetric augmentation. Its gel profile is softer and less dense than high‑projection fillers, offering smooth results with minimal heaviness. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer and distributor documentation, Lumifil L-Lite with Lidocaine is indicated for enhancement and rejuvenation of the lips and surrounding perioral area. Treatment areas: Lips — mild augmentation, hydration, vermillion softness Perioral lines and superficial textural correction → Lumifil L-Lite is particularly suited for patients seeking subtle enhancement, improved hydration, and refined texture in areas with minimal volume loss. Usage / Administration (IFU‑only) Injection depth: Superficial to mid‑dermal depending on treatment objective and anatomy. Volume per point / injection site: Not specified by manufacturer; practitioners typically use small micro‑droplet or linear threading techniques. Needle gauge: Administered using an appropriately sized needle or micro‑cannula as per clinical preference. Frequency / number of sessions: One to two treatment sessions spaced 3–4 weeks apart are common; maintenance sessions may be administered every 6–9 months if required. Professional‑use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical or aesthetic professionals under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is noted as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid sodium salt (cross‑linked): Low‑density HA designed to provide hydration and mild volume. Lidocaine hydrochloride: Local anaesthetic incorporated to reduce procedural discomfort. Other excipients include sodium chloride, phosphate buffer, and water for injection; additional trace components are not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1.0 ml pre‑filled sterile syringe containing HA and lidocaine. Shelf‑life: Refer to product packaging for expiry date. Longevity (treatment duration): Results are typically reported to last approximately 6–9 months , though individual duration may vary based on injection technique, metabolic factors, and lifestyle. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any component of the product. Avoid use in patients with active infections, inflammation, or compromised skin at the injection site until resolved. Do not inject intravascularly. Single‑use only; do not reuse syringe. Strict aseptic technique and anatomical knowledge are essential for safe outcomes. Regulatory Status Lumifil L-Lite with Lidocaine is CE‑marked as a medical device where applicable. Regulatory classification and approved indications may vary by jurisdiction; practitioners should confirm local compliance and IFU details via manufacturer or authorised distributor documentation. FAQ How does Lumifil L-Lite with Lidocaine work in the tissue? Lumifil L-Lite uses a soft, cross‑linked HA gel that integrates into the superficial to mid‑dermal layer of the lips and perioral area, providing hydration, subtle volume, and improved tissue texture. Lidocaine minimises injection discomfort. Is Lumifil L-Lite the same as a high‑volume dermal filler? No. Lumifil L-Lite is formulated for gentle enhancement, hydration, and texture correction rather than deep volumisation or structural contouring. What is the typical treatment protocol and how long do results last? A typical protocol may involve one to two sessions spaced 3–4 weeks apart. Results generally last about 6–9 months , though this varies with patient factors and injection technique. Can Lumifil L-Lite be used for patients new to fillers? Yes. Its softer gel profile and natural integration make it suitable for first‑time filler patients seeking subtle improvement. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? Practitioners should apply strict aseptic technique, ensure detailed anatomical knowledge, and avoid injecting into areas with active infection or compromised skin.

description: LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster | 1x1ml per pack – Polynucleotide Eye Booster LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster is a specialized injectable polynucleotide (PN) formulation designed for rejuvenation of the delicate periorbital area. Each 1x1ml pre-filled syringe contains purified polynucleotides at 5 mg/ml to improve hydration, elasticity, and fine texture around the eyes. It stimulates tissue regeneration and helps restore a youthful appearance, reducing the appearance of fine lines, dark circles, and early signs of aging. This product is indicated for patients seeking gentle improvement of skin quality without volumizing effects. LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster integrates smoothly into the dermal tissue, promoting tissue repair and maintaining natural, refreshed results. What LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster Is Similar To LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster can be considered alongside other polynucleotide or regenerative skin boosters , such as Rejuran I and other PN-based eye treatments, in that all aim to improve skin quality rather than volumize tissue. Unlike traditional dermal fillers which add volume, LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster enhances elasticity, hydration, and cellular regeneration of the periorbital skin. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster is indicated for: Treatment areas: Periorbital region (under-eye area) Lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet) Delicate periocular skin prone to fine lines and early laxity → LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster is primarily used to improve skin texture, hydration, and elasticity , making it ideal for practitioners aiming for subtle, natural rejuvenation around the eyes. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth: Superficial to mid-dermal layer. Volume per point / injection site: Small micro-droplet or linear threading techniques as per practitioner judgment. Needle gauge: Supplied needle or micro-cannula appropriate for periorbital use. Frequency / number of sessions: Initial cycle of 2–3 sessions at 3–4 week intervals; maintenance treatments every 6–9 months as clinically indicated. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical or aesthetic professionals under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is marked as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Polynucleotides (PN): 5 mg/ml Sodium chloride Phosphate buffer Water for injection Other excipients are as per manufacturer IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Lidocaine is not included . Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1ml pre-filled sterile syringe. Shelf-life: Refer to packaging for expiry date. Longevity (treatment duration): Effects are typically reported to last 4–6 months after the initial 2–3 session protocol, though individual results may vary depending on patient age, anatomy, and injection technique. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to polynucleotides or any excipient. Avoid use in patients with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin at the injection site. Do not inject intravascularly. Single-use only; do not reuse syringe. Strict aseptic technique and detailed anatomical knowledge are essential. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device in applicable regions. Regulatory classification may vary by jurisdiction; practitioners should confirm local compliance via the manufacturer’s IFU or authorised distributor documentation. FAQ How does LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster work in the skin? LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster uses highly purified polynucleotides that integrate into the superficial to mid-dermal layer. It promotes tissue regeneration, improves hydration and elasticity, and reduces fine lines around the eyes. Is LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster the same as a traditional dermal filler? No. Unlike volumising HA fillers, this product is formulated to improve skin quality and texture rather than add volume. It targets regeneration and hydration in delicate periocular tissue. What is the typical treatment protocol and how long do the results last? Initial treatment usually consists of 2–3 sessions spaced 3–4 weeks apart. Effects are typically maintained for 4–6 months, depending on patient anatomy and injection technique. Can LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster be used beyond the under-eye area? Yes, it may be applied to other delicate periocular regions such as lateral canthal lines, though practitioners should follow local regulatory indications and clinical judgment. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? Strict aseptic technique, detailed anatomical knowledge, and patient history review are essential. Avoid injecting into areas with active infection or compromised skin.
