short_description: LUMI-PN FACE is a high-concentration polynucleotide skin booster designed for aesthetic clinics. With 50 mg of ultra-pure PDRN in a 2.5 ml syringe, it supports cellular regeneration, improves skin hydration, and enhances elasticity ideal for face, neck, décolletage and hands. Its water-based PDRN solution helps restore skin tone, smoothness, and radiance, offering a non-volumising rejuvenation alternative for clients seeking healthier, more youthful-looking skin.
description: Clinical Description LUMI-PN FACE is a polynucleotide (PDRN) skin-booster product, formulated with ultra-pure polydeoxyribonucleotides (PDRN) at a concentration of 20 mg/ml, delivering a total of 50 mg per 2.5 ml syringe. Rather than acting as a volumising filler, its mechanism is regenerative: PDRN fragments are claimed to support skin tissue repair, stimulate fibroblast activity, promote extracellular matrix remodelling, and improve skin hydration, tone, elasticity and overall skin quality. The formulation targets skin rejuvenation rather than structural volume augmentation, making it suitable for skin that is dull, dehydrated, thin, or showing early signs of ageing. What LUMI-PN FACE Is Similar To LUMI-PN FACE belongs to the class of regenerative skin boosters (like polynucleotide or PDRN boosters) rather than traditional hyaluronic acid (HA) fillers. For orientation, it is similar in purpose to treatments such as Profhilo — which aim to improve skin hydration, elasticity, and quality rather than volumising — although Profhilo uses high-concentration HA rather than PDRN. Unlike HA fillers (which add volume and define contours), LUMI-PN FACE focuses on skin regeneration, collagen/elastin support and improving skin texture and tone. Compared with simpler mesotherapy or superficial boosters (vitamins, low-dose HA), LUMI-PN FACE provides a higher polynucleotide load per treatment, targeting deeper regenerative effects. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to available manufacturer/distributor information, LUMI-PN FACE is suitable for: face, neck, décolletage, and hands. If other zones are used (e.g., under-eye, periocular, scarred areas) — these are not explicitly specified. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth / method: Not clearly specified in publicly available documentation. Several distributors list the product under “microneedling / mesotherapy / skin booster” categories rather than classical dermal fillers. Volume per point / injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge / tool: Not provided by manufacturer. Some sources indicate use with microneedling devices or mesotherapy needles rather than large-gauge filler needles. Frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer; common industry practice (not official) is a course of several sessions spaced a few weeks apart. Professional-use disclaimer: Product intended for use by qualified aesthetic practitioners under aseptic conditions. Because public documentation does not describe a standard IFU specifying depth, needle, or protocol, any mention of serial-puncture, microneedling or injection technique derives from how some clinics offer the product — not from a verified IFU. Ingredient List Polynucleotides (PDRN) 20 mg/ml (total 50 mg per 2.5 ml syringe) Water (Aqua) as base solvent. Sodium DNA / Sodium Chloride / Phosphate salts (buffer components) — listed in one retailer’s ingredient specification. No hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or cross-linked gel is declared — thus, no volumising carrier matrix is indicated. Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 1 × 2.5 ml pre-filled syringe. Shelf life / expiry: Not provided in publicly available documentation. Treatment duration: Because the product is regenerative rather than volumising, “longevity” is not defined as a lasting filling effect. The effect depends on skin renewal and patient-specific factors; a fixed duration is not provided by manufacturer. Safety Notes / Contraindications Public sources do not provide a full IFU-based list of contraindications. Based on standard practice for skin-boosting or PDRN treatments, and on disclaimers by distributors: Should be administered only by qualified professionals under aseptic conditions. Use is contraindicated in patients with active skin infection, inflammation, or open wounds at the target site (standard caution for injectables / mesotherapy) — though not explicitly stated, this is general good practice. Allergic or hypersensitivity reactions possible: as with any biologically derived product, origins of PDRN should be considered; patients with sensitivity should be assessed individually. Not recommended for self-administration. Regulatory Status The product is sold in the UK market. However, none of the publicly accessible retailer pages clearly state a CE-mark, UKCA marking, or registration status. For example, the product description pages for UK distributors list “Polynucleotide Skin Booster” without regulatory labelling. Regulatory classification not specified in public documentation; verify on the product pack or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ Q1: What exactly is PDRN, and how does LUMI-PN FACE act on the skin? A1: PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) are fragments of DNA derived from purified sources; when applied to the skin (via injection or mesotherapy), they are believed to support cellular repair, stimulate fibroblast activity, and encourage extracellular matrix regeneration. LUMI-PN FACE delivers 50 mg of ultra-pure PDRN per syringe, aiming to promote skin repair, improved hydration, elasticity, and overall skin quality rather than volumising. Q2: Will LUMI-PN FACE add volume like a dermal filler? A2: No — LUMI-PN FACE is not designed as a volumising filler. It does not contain hyaluronic acid gel or cross-linked HA; its base is an aqueous PDRN solution. The purpose is skin rejuvenation, hydration and regeneration, not structural contouring or volume augmentation. Q3: Which treatment areas can be addressed with LUMI-PN FACE? A3: According to distributor information, LUMI-PN FACE can be used on the face, neck, décolletage and hands. Additional use on other zones or delicate areas (e.g., peri-ocular) is not explicitly confirmed in public documentation. Q4: What is the recommended administration method and treatment schedule? A4: The official public sources do not provide a detailed injection protocol (depth, needle gauge, number of sessions, volume per point). Only that it is marketed under “skin booster / microneedling / mesotherapy” treatments.Therefore, administration and treatment planning must rely on practitioner judgement, local standards, and a licensed IFU. Q5: Can LUMI-PN FACE be regarded as a safe regenerative alternative to fillers? A5: When administered by qualified professionals under aseptic conditions, PDRN-based skin boosters like LUMI-PN FACE offer a non-volumising approach focused on skin quality, hydration, and tissue regeneration — which may carry lower risk of overfilling or unnatural contour changes compared with volumising fillers. However, because robust publicly accessible clinical trial data or regulatory documentation is limited, practitioners should exercise caution, inform patients clearly, and monitor outcomes carefully.

short_description: Lanluma X 1x40ml is a high-volume PLLA biostimulator designed for deep tissue collagen stimulation and gradual volumisation in face and body treatments.with 630mg of PLLA It induces neocollagenesis for long-lasting structural support and natural-looking rejuvenation.
description: Lanluma X 1x40ml – High-Volume PLLA Biostimulator of 630 mg of PLLA mgLanluma X 1x40ml is a professional injectable poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) biostimulator suspension designed to address moderate to advanced volume loss, tissue laxity, and age-related structural deficiency across large treatment areas such as the face and body. The product consists of a 40 ml sterile vial of PLLA powder that must be reconstituted prior to administration. Consequently, once injected, Lanluma X stimulates collagen production and dermal renewal, providing gradual and natural-looking volume restoration with extended durability. This product contains 630mg of PLLA built for deep subcutaneous injection in large body areas. Lanluma X differs from traditional hyaluronic acid fillers, which provide immediate volume through gel implantation. Instead, it promotes neocollagenesis and tissue remodelling , leading to sustained improvements in skin structure and volume over a series of treatments — a critical distinction for practitioners planning long-term aesthetic outcomes. What Lanluma X Is Similar To Lanluma X belongs to the family of biostimulatory injectables focused on inducing collagen synthesis. It is clinically comparable to PLLA biostimulators such as Sculptra® in its mechanism of action, which does not rely on gel deposition but on stimulating the body’s own fibroblasts to regenerate collagen. While HA volumisers address fine lines and superficial volume loss, Lanluma X targets deeper structural rejuvenation and volumetric deficiency . This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer and distributor documentation, Lanluma X 1x40ml with 630mg of PLLA is indicated for: Treatment areas: Body areas with significant volume depletion (e.g., arms, abdomen, buttocks) Structural enhancement in age-related soft tissue descent → Lanluma X is ideal for patients with moderate to severe volume loss or those seeking long-lasting collagen stimulation and tissue support beyond what conventional fillers can achieve. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth: Deep dermal to subcutaneous, depending on anatomy and target volume. Product preparation: Reconstitution with sterile water for injection according to official protocol; adequate mixing and hydration are essential for optimal distribution. Injection technique: Administered via cannula or needle in fanned, cross-hatching patterns to cover broad areas of deficit. Frequency / number of sessions: Treatment typically involves multiple sessions spaced 4–6 weeks apart , with practitioner assessment guiding the number of treatments. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by trained and qualified medical or aesthetic professionals with expertise in collagen biostimulation and large-volume injections. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is noted as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List (LanlumaX Ingredients) Poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA): 180 mg per vial (40 ml powder) Excipients: Sodium carboxymethylcellulose, mannitol Lanluma X is supplied as a sterile lyophilised powder and must be reconstituted prior to use. The product does not contain lidocaine. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 40 ml vial requiring reconstitution. Shelf-life: Refer to product packaging and IFU for expiry details. Longevity (treatment duration): Results develop progressively over weeks as collagen synthesis occurs. Clinical outcomes may last 18–24 months or longer , depending on patient variables, injection technique, and treatment plan. Lanluma X price varies by region, supplier, and clinic pricing strategy; practitioners should consult authorised distributors for current pricing. Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to PLLA or any excipient. Avoid use in areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised tissue. Do not inject intravascularly. Single-use product; do not reuse. Strict aseptic technique and advanced anatomical understanding are required for large-volume biostimulatory injections. Regulatory Status Lanluma X is CE-marked as a medical device where applicable. Regulatory classification, approved indications, and usage protocols may vary by jurisdiction; practitioners should verify local compliance via the official IFU or authorised distributor documentation. FAQ 1. What is Lanluma? Lanluma refers to a class of poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) biostimulators designed to stimulate the body’s own collagen production for gradual volumisation and tissue support. Lanluma products differ from traditional fillers because they induce neocollagenesis rather than depositing gel to add immediate volume. 2. How does Lanluma X work in the skin? Lanluma X is reconstituted and injected into deep dermal or subcutaneous tissue, where the PLLA particles act as a scaffold that promotes fibroblast activation and new collagen formation over time. This leads to progressive improvement in volume, firmness, and skin architecture . 3. Is Lanluma X the same as a dermal filler? No. While dermal fillers such as HA gels provide immediate volume, Lanluma X works through biostimulation , leading to gradual, long-lasting structural improvements rather than instant physical augmentation. 4. What is the typical treatment protocol and how long do results last? A typical course involves multiple sessions spaced roughly 4–6 weeks apart. Results emerge gradually over several weeks to months and are often reported to last 18–24 months or longer. 5. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? Practitioners must use strict aseptic technique , detailed anatomical understanding, careful reconstitution, and appropriate injection patterns. Avoid areas of active infection or compromised tissue and monitor for typical post-treatment responses (e.g., mild swelling, tenderness).

description: Saypha Dermal Filler Rich – Skin Booster for Deep Hydration and Skin Revitalisation Saypha® Rich is a sterile injectable dermal filler and skin booster developed by Croma Pharma , formulated with cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA) combined with glycerol to enhance skin hydration, elasticity, and overall dermal quality. The product is designed primarily for skin revitalisation rather than volumetric augmentation , making it suitable for patients presenting with early signs of skin ageing, dehydration, and loss of elasticity. Unlike traditional volumising fillers, Croma Saypha Rich focuses on improving skin texture, tone, and hydration at the dermal level. It is commonly used as a Saypha Rich skin booster to restore skin vitality and achieve a refreshed appearance, particularly in delicate areas of the face, neck, décolletage, and hands. What Saypha® Rich Is Similar To Saypha Rich filler can be considered alongside other injectable skin boosters and biorevitalisation products such as Profhilo®, Restylane® Skinboosters, or Jalupro®, as these treatments aim to improve skin quality rather than provide structural volume. However, Saypha Rich is distinguished by its inclusion of glycerol , which works synergistically with hyaluronic acid to prolong hydration and improve skin smoothness. While traditional HA fillers are designed to contour or volumise facial structures, Saypha Rich is optimised for hydration, elasticity improvement, and skin revitalisation , making it unsuitable for deep wrinkle filling or contour sculpting. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. short_description: Saypha Dermal Filler with Lido is a professional injectable hyaluronic acid gel formulated with 23 mg/mL cross-linked HA and 0.3 % lidocaine for added patient comfort. Designed for correction of moderate to severe facial wrinkles and lip augmentation, it integrates viscoelastic properties to restore volume and support natural-looking outcomes when used by qualified practitioners.
description: Saypha Dermal Filler with Lido – HA Injectable for Wrinkle Correction and Volume Saypha® Dermal Filler with Lido is a class of injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler medical device formulated with high-concentration, cross-linked sodium hyaluronate and 0.3 % lidocaine hydrochloride to enhance patient comfort during injection. The HA is of non-animal origin and manufactured using advanced viscoelastic technology to produce a smooth, elastic gel suitable for soft tissue augmentation and wrinkle correction. It is indicated primarily for the correction of moderate to severe facial wrinkles, folds and lines , and for augmentation of lip volume and contouring . The integrated lidocaine reduces procedural discomfort and facilitates a more comfortable treatment experience for patients. The gel is intended for injection into the mid to deep dermis or submucosal layer depending on the treatment area. Once placed, the HA binds to tissue water, restoring volume and improving skin smoothness while providing structural support to aging skin. The viscoelastic properties enable even distribution and natural-looking outcomes when administered by qualified professionals. What Saypha Dermal Filler with Lidocaine Is Similar To Saypha Dermal Filler with Lido can be regarded alongside other hyaluronic acid dermal fillers with lidocaine , such as Restylane® with Lidocaine or Juvederm® Ultra with Lidocaine, in that all use cross-linked HA to add volume, correct moderate to severe wrinkles, and improve facial contours. All these products contain a local anesthetic to improve comfort during injection. Unlike skin-booster or bioremodelling products such as Profhilo® H+L — which are designed primarily for hydration and tissue quality with minimal volumetric lifting — Saypha Dermal Filler with Lido emphasises volume augmentation and wrinkle correction in targeted facial areas. Hyaluronic acid fillers with higher cross-linking are generally formulated to resist enzymatic degradation longer than non-cross-linked HA boosters, providing structural support as well as hydration . This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer and distributor information, Saypha Dermal Filler with Lido is indicated for the following: Correction of moderate to severe facial wrinkles, folds and lines , including nasolabial folds, marionette lines, glabellar lines and perioral wrinkles. Lip augmentation and contouring to enhance volume and shape. Treatment areas are consistent with typical hyaluronic acid dermal fillers and are determined by clinical need and practitioner assessment. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Mid to deep dermis; submucosa for lip augmentation. Volume per injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: Two 27 G × ½″ (thin wall) sterile needles supplied with the syringe. Frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals trained in aesthetic injectable techniques and aseptic procedures. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is recorded as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Cross-linked hyaluronic acid (23 mg/mL). Lidocaine hydrochloride (0.3 %). Phosphate buffer and sodium chloride (physiologic buffer). This formulation uses non-animal sourced HA with BDDE cross-linking to provide viscoelastic structure and durability. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1.0 mL pre-filled sterile syringe supplied with two 27 G × ½″ needles (CE 0197 traceable). Shelf life: Not specified in public documentation; refer to product packaging for expiry date. Longevity: Results are typically observed for up to approximately 9 months , although individual outcomes depend on patient metabolism, injection technique and treated area. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the product, including hyaluronic acid or lidocaine. Avoid injecting into areas with active skin infection or inflammation until the condition resolves. Do not inject intravenously or into non-target tissues. As with other dermal fillers, strict aseptic technique and anatomical knowledge are essential to minimise risks of vascular occlusion or adverse tissue reactions. Purposes beyond the indicated facial areas should be assessed on a case-by-case basis. Regulatory Status Saypha Dermal Filler with Lido is a CE-marked medical device in the European Union under the Medical Device Regulation (MDR). Specific UKCA listings should be verified via the official Instructions for Use or authorised distributor documentation. FAQ 1. How does Saypha Dermal Filler with Lido work? Saypha Dermal Filler with Lido is a viscoelastic gel of cross-linked hyaluronic acid that binds water molecules in the dermis to restore volume and soften facial wrinkles and folds. The incorporated lidocaine (0.3 %) acts as a local anaesthetic to help reduce procedural discomfort during injection. 2. What distinguishes Saypha Filler from skin-booster products? Unlike skin boosters or bioremodelling injectables that focus on diffuse hydration and tissue quality improvement, Saypha Filler is formulated as a volumetric dermal filler intended to correct discrete folds and restore contour in specific facial regions. 3. Where is Saypha Filler typically injected? The product is intended for injection into the mid to deep dermis for wrinkle correction and into the submucosa for lip volume enhancement. Precise depth and injection technique should be determined by a qualified practitioner based on area and indication. 4. How long do results last? Clinical experience and distributor information suggest that visible effects can last up to approximately 9 months , though this varies with patient metabolism, treatment site, and injection technique. 5. Is Saypha Filler suitable for everyone? As with all injectable medical devices, use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component or in the presence of active infection at the injection site. Treatment should be administered only by qualified medical professionals with appropriate anatomical training.

description: Clinical Description PhilArt Eye (also marketed in some regions as PolyPhil Eye) is a polynucleotide-based injectable medical-aesthetic treatment specifically developed for the delicate periorbital area. Manufactured by Croma Pharma, the product belongs to the PhilArt regenerative medicine range and is designed to support tissue quality, hydration, and skin revitalisation around the eyes through the biological activity of highly purified polynucleotides (PN). Polynucleotides are purified DNA-derived molecules that have demonstrated hydrating and tissue-supportive properties within regenerative aesthetic medicine. Their mechanism is associated with water-binding capacity, extracellular matrix support, and the promotion of a favourable environment for tissue repair processes. PhilArt Eye is intended for professional use in patients presenting with signs of periocular ageing, reduced skin elasticity, skin quality concerns, and age-related changes affecting the eye contour area. Unlike volumising dermal fillers, PhilArt Eye is primarily classified as a regenerative biostimulator focused on tissue quality improvement rather than volume augmentation. Like Nucleofill Eyes, PhilArt Eye is intended to address skin quality concerns around the eyes through regenerative mechanisms rather than volume replacement. Both products are commonly used within aesthetic protocols focused on improving periocular tissue quality and hydration. Compared with hyaluronic acid dermal fillers used for tear trough correction, PhilArt Eye serves a different clinical purpose. description: Belotero Revive Dermal Filler by Merz Aesthetics 1×1 mL Belotero® Revive is a hyaluronic acid–based injectable dermal filler medical device developed by Merz Aesthetics for skin revitalisation, hydration, and improvement of skin quality . It combines cross-linked hyaluronic acid with glycerol , forming a formulation intended to enhance dermal hydration, elasticity, and resilience. Belotero Revive is indicated for the treatment of early signs of skin ageing , such as dullness, fine lines, and reduced skin elasticity, rather than for volumetric correction or contour augmentation. The gel is designed to integrate evenly within the superficial to mid-dermal layers , supporting hydration and improving skin texture while maintaining natural skin movement. As part of the Belotero dermal filler range, Belotero Revive focuses on improving skin condition and dermal quality rather than creating lift or structural volume. What Belotero® Revive Is Similar To Belotero Revive can be regarded alongside other skin quality–focused injectable treatments that aim to improve hydration, elasticity, and overall dermal condition rather than provide significant volumetric augmentation. Products in this category are commonly used for skin revitalisation and prevention of early ageing changes , particularly in patients who do not require traditional volumising fillers. Unlike classic volumising Belotero fillers or other hyaluronic acid dermal fillers designed to restore contour and structure, Belotero Revive dermal filler is formulated to distribute smoothly within superficial dermal layers. Its inclusion of glycerol differentiates it from standard HA-only formulations by supporting enhanced water retention and dermal comfort. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Belotero Revive is indicated for skin hydration and revitalisation in areas affected by early ageing changes. Treatment areas may include: Face • Neck • Décolletage • Hands → Belotero Revive is intended for skin quality improvement and is not designed for volumetric correction or structural contouring. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth: Superficial to mid-dermal layer. Volume per point / injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: Supplied with appropriate sterile needles as per packaging. Frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is marked as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid (cross-linked), non-animal origin Glycerol Physiological buffer solution Lidocaine: Not provided by manufacturer. Other excipients as per IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1 mL pre-filled sterile syringe Shelf-life: Not specified in public documentation; refer to packaging for expiry date. Longevity (treatment duration): The effects are typically reported to last several months, depending on skin condition, treatment protocol, and individual patient factors. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the product. Avoid use in patients with active skin infections or inflammation at the injection site until the condition has resolved. Do not inject intravascularly or into unintended tissue layers. Single use only; do not reuse the syringe; ensure packaging is intact and within expiry. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device in Europe. UKCA status: verify via IFU or distributor. Regulatory classification may vary by jurisdiction; verify on the product packaging or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ 1. How does Belotero® Revive work in the skin? Belotero Revive delivers hyaluronic acid and glycerol into the superficial dermis, where it supports hydration, improves skin elasticity, and enhances overall skin quality. The formulation integrates smoothly within the tissue to revitalise dehydrated or dull skin. 2. Is Belotero Revive the same as a traditional dermal filler? No. Unlike traditional Belotero fillers used for volume or contour correction, Belotero Revive dermal filler is designed for skin revitalisation and hydration , not for restoring facial volume or reshaping contours. 3. How long do the results of Belotero Revive last? Results are generally reported to last several months. Longevity varies depending on skin condition, injection technique, and treatment frequency, and maintenance treatments may be required. 4. Can Belotero Revive be used on areas other than the face? Yes. Manufacturer information includes use on the neck, décolletage, and hands, where improvement in skin quality and hydration is desired. Practitioners should confirm suitability based on local regulatory guidance. 5. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? As with all injectable medical devices, strict aseptic technique, knowledge of anatomy, and careful patient assessment are essential. Care must be taken to avoid intravascular injection and inappropriate placement.

short_description: Belotero® Lip Contour with Lidocaine is a hyaluronic acid lip filler designed for precise lip border definition and contour refinement rather than volumisation. Used alone or alongside Belotero Lips Shape, it supports natural-looking lip enhancement with results lasting several months when administered by trained professionals.
description: Belotero Lip Contour with Lidocaine Lip Filler 1×0.6 mL Belotero® Lip Contour with Lidocaine is an injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) lip filler medical device developed by Merz Aesthetics for the definition, refinement, and contouring of the lips . Formulated using Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM®) technology , the product is designed to integrate smoothly into the delicate lip tissue, allowing precise enhancement of the vermilion border and cupid’s bow while preserving natural lip movement. The inclusion of lidocaine supports improved patient comfort during injection. Belotero Lip Contour is indicated primarily for lip border definition, correction of lip asymmetry, and refinement of lip shape , rather than for volumetric lip augmentation. It is commonly used as part of a combined lip treatment approach alongside Belotero Lips Shape , where contour definition and projection are addressed separately. What Belotero® Lip Contour Is Similar To Belotero Lip Contour can be regarded alongside other lip-specific hyaluronic acid fillers designed for border definition and contour refinement rather than volume enhancement. Within the Belotero range, it is most closely associated with Belotero Lips Shape , with the two products often used together in comprehensive lip treatments. While Belotero Lips Shape and Lips Contour are frequently combined, they are not the same product . Belotero Lips Shape focuses on lip projection and structure, whereas Belotero Lip Contour targets precision along the lip margins. Compared to traditional volumising lip fillers, Belotero Lip Contour prioritises definition and control over bulk augmentation. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Belotero Lip Contour with Lidocaine is indicated for aesthetic treatment of the lips, particularly where definition and refinement are required. Treatment areas include: Upper and lower lip borders • Cupid’s bow • Vermilion outline → Belotero Lip Contour is intended for lip contouring and definition and is not designed to create significant lip volume. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth : Mucosal or submucosal layer of the lips. Volume per point / injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: Supplied with appropriate sterile needles as per packaging. Frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is marked as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Cross-linked hyaluronic acid (non-animal origin) Lidocaine hydrochloride Physiological buffer solution Other excipients as per IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 0.6 mL pre-filled sterile syringe Shelf-life: Not specified in public documentation; refer to packaging for expiry date. Longevity (treatment duration): Results are typically reported to last approximately 6–9 months , depending on injection technique, lip movement, and individual patient factors. → How long does Belotero Lips Shape and Lips Contour last for? When used together, results generally persist for several months, with longevity influenced by metabolism and treatment approach. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any component of the product. Avoid treatment in patients with active infections, inflammation, or lesions at the injection site until resolved. Do not inject intravascularly or into unintended tissue layers. Single use only; do not reuse the syringe; ensure packaging is intact and within expiry. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device in Europe. UKCA status: verify via IFU or authorised distributor. Regulatory classification may vary by jurisdiction; verify on the product packaging or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ 1. What is Belotero® Lip Contour with Lidocaine? Belotero Lip Contour with Lidocaine is a hyaluronic acid lip filler designed specifically for lip border definition and contour refinement , using CPM® technology to ensure smooth integration and natural movement. 2. What is Belotero Lips Shape and Lips Contour? Belotero Lips Shape and Lips Contour are two complementary products used together in lip treatments. Shape focuses on projection and structure, while Contour refines the lip outline and definition. 3. Are Belotero Lips Shape and Lips Contour the same product? No. They are distinct formulations with different clinical purposes. Lips Shape enhances volume and projection, while Lips Contour is intended for precision and border definition. 4. How long does Belotero Lips Shape and Lips Contour last for? Results typically last 6–9 months , though longevity varies depending on lip movement, injection technique, and individual patient metabolism. 5. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? As with all injectable lip fillers, strict aseptic technique, detailed anatomical knowledge, and careful patient assessment are essential. Particular care must be taken to avoid intravascular injection due to the vascular nature of the lips.

description: Belotero Balance with Lidocaine Dermal Filler for Moderate Wrinkle Correction Belotero Balance with Lidocaine is a resorbable hyaluronic acid–based dermal filler formulated for the correction of moderate facial wrinkles and folds. It is composed of non-animal, cross-linked hyaluronic acid combined with lidocaine hydrochloride to enhance patient comfort during injection. The filler is manufactured using Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM®) technology, which supports smooth integration within the superficial to mid-dermal layers while maintaining tissue elasticity and natural facial movement. The product is indicated for the treatment of moderate facial wrinkles where balanced correction, flexibility, and uniform tissue distribution are required. Its rheological profile is designed to provide effective wrinkle smoothing while minimising palpability or irregular texture. Belotero Balance with Lidocaine is biodegradable and gradually resorbed through physiological metabolic processes. It is intended exclusively for professional aesthetic use by trained medical practitioners under aseptic conditions. What Belotero Balance with Lidocaine Is Similar To Belotero Balance with Lidocaine can be compared to other hyaluronic acid dermal fillers intended for moderate wrinkle correction, such as Juvederm® Ultra or Restylane® Refyne . These products are designed to address deeper lines than superficial fillers while preserving natural facial expression. Within the Belotero range, Belotero Soft is positioned for very superficial fine lines, whereas Belotero Balance is formulated for more pronounced wrinkles requiring additional structural support. Juvederm® Ultra and Restylane® Refyne use alternative cross-linking technologies, resulting in different gel cohesivity and elasticity profiles. Compared with these, Belotero Balance prioritises homogeneous dermal integration and adaptability to dynamic facial areas. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. description: Lip Filler Belotero® Lips Shape with Lidocaine 1×0.6 mL Belotero Lips Shape with Lidocaine is a hyaluronic acid (HA) lip filler developed by Merz Aesthetics for lip enhancement, shape definition, and contour improvement . Formulated using Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM®) technology , this filler integrates smoothly into lip tissue, allowing precise shaping while maintaining softness and natural movement. This product is specifically designed for patients seeking enhanced lip shape and projection , rather than simple volume alone. The inclusion of lidocaine (0.3%) helps improve treatment comfort during injection, making it a popular choice among practitioners for aesthetic lip procedures. Belotero Lips Shape is intended for use by trained medical professionals only. What Belotero Lips Shape Is Used For Belotero Lips Shape is indicated for: Defining lip shape and borders Enhancing lip projection Improving lip symmetry Refining the cupid’s bow Supporting lip contour without over-volumisation It is commonly combined with Belotero Lips Contour in full lip treatments, where Shape enhances structure and projection while contour products refine borders. This complementary approach is often referred to clinically as Belotero lips shape and contour . How Belotero Lips Shape Works Thanks to CPM® technology, Belotero Lips Shape distributes evenly within the lip tissue, reducing the risk of lumpiness while providing controlled shaping. The gel’s elasticity allows lips to remain soft and flexible, supporting natural facial expressions. This makes Belotero a preferred lip filler option for patients who want definition and refinement rather than a heavy or rigid appearance. Treatment Areas / Indications Upper and lower lips Cupid’s bow Vermilion body Lip projection zones Lip shape refinement Injection technique and treatment planning should always be tailored to the patient’s anatomy and aesthetic goals by a qualified practitioner. Ingredient List Cross-linked hyaluronic acid Lidocaine hydrochloride 0.3% Physiological buffer solution Belotero fillers are produced using non-animal-derived hyaluronic acid . What is Belotero Lips Shape? Belotero Lips Shape is a hyaluronic acid lip filler designed to enhance lip shape, projection, and definition while maintaining softness and natural movement. 2. short_description: Bellast Prime Hard with Lidocaine is a premium-grade, high-density HA filler engineered for structural facial enhancement. Its viscous HA gel delivers reliable volumising and shaping ideal for deeper folds, cheeks, chin, or jawline while 0.3% lidocaine helps improve patient comfort during injection. With immediate visible results and excellent volume retention, this CE-marked filler offers professional practitioners a cost-effective solution for effective facial contouring and deeper wrinkle correction.
description: Bellast Prime Hard is a CE-marked hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler from the Bellast Prime range by Fox Pharma. It is formulated with a high-density cross-linked HA (24 mg/ml) and 0.3% lidocaine, creating a viscous gel with uniform particles designed for deep dermal injection. The high viscoelasticity and gel density of Bellast Prime Hard provide structural support and volumising effect, restoring lost facial volume and contour. The filler is bio-absorbable, gradually metabolised by endogenous hyaluronidases over time. Indications include correction of deeper wrinkles/folds and facial contouring in areas requiring significant volume or definition (e.g., nasolabial folds, cheeks, chin, jaw). What Bellast Prime Hard Is Similar To Bellast Prime Hard can be compared to other high-density HA fillers used for deep dermal or subdermal augmentation, such as Restylane® (or other thicker HA fillers designed for cheeks, chin, or nasolabial folds). Like Restylane and similar fillers, Bellast Prime Hard uses cross-linked HA to provide structural support, volume restoration, and skin contouring. The 24 mg/ml HA concentration and robust viscoelastic gel of Bellast Prime Hard offer volume retention and support comparable to well-established deep fillers. However, differences may arise in gel rheology, particle size, and clinical handling — potentially affecting gel integration, mouldability, and longevity. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications Nasolabial folds Cheeks (malar area) Chin Jaw / jawline contouring Usage / Administration (IFU-based) Delivery form: 1 × 1 ml prefilled syringe. Needles included: 25G and 27G sterile needles. Injection depth: as per manufacturer, “deep dermis” for Bellast Prime Hard. Volume per point / injection site: not provided by manufacturer. Frequency / number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. Note: If a practitioner uses different techniques (e.g., cannula, layering, micro-bolus), these are not part of the official manufacturer’s IFU. Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid, cross-linked — 24 mg/mL Lidocaine — 0.3% Excipients / buffer / carrier gel: not specified in public documentation Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 1 × 1.0 ml prefilled syringe (ergonomic design) with 1 × 25G needle and 1 × 27G needle included Shelf-life or expiry: not provided by manufacturer (publicly available). Expected duration of clinical effect: between 6 and 12 months after injection. Safety Notes / Contraindications According to the manufacturer: Do not use in patients with bleeding disorders or those on medication affecting platelet function. Not to be resterilised or mixed with other products before injection. Not recommended for patients prone to keloid formation or with active inflammation / infection at the injection site. Contraindicated in individuals with known lidocaine allergy. Not advised in pregnancy or breastfeeding. Standard caution (if not otherwise specified): Additional contraindications may include active skin infections, autoimmune or immunosuppressive conditions, and recent dental/dermal procedures; full medical history and consultation required prior to treatment. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device. UKCA status not explicitly stated — verify via IFU or distributor at time of purchase. FAQ Q1: What makes Bellast Prime Hard different from other HA fillers? A1: Bellast Prime Hard combines a high concentration of cross-linked HA (24 mg/ml) with a viscous, high-density gel formulation — resulting in increased viscoelasticity and structural support. This makes it especially suitable for deep dermal injection to restore volume, contour cheeks/chin/jaw, and correct deep folds. Q2: How long will the results of Bellast Prime Hard last? A2: According to the manufacturer, visible aesthetic results can last between 6 and 12 months. However, longevity can vary depending on factors such as injection technique, patient metabolism, lifestyle, and treatment area. Q3: Is the injection of Bellast Prime Hard painful? A3: The filler contains 0.3% lidocaine, a local anaesthetic, which helps reduce discomfort during injection.As with all dermal filler procedures, patients may still experience some mild stinging or pressure, but overall pain is generally minimised. Q4: Can Bellast Prime Hard filler be reversed when needed? A4: Since Bellast Prime Hard is HA-based, like other HA dermal fillers, it is biocompatible and bio-absorbable. In most clinical practice, HA fillers can be dissolved using hyaluronidase if required (though the manufacturer’s IFU should be consulted for compatibility). Q5: What are the main risks or complications associated with HA fillers like Bellast Prime Hard? A5: Common mild adverse effects include swelling, bruising, redness, tenderness, or lumps immediately after injection.In rare cases, more serious complications such as vascular occlusion (which may lead to skin necrosis or, very rarely, vision loss) have been reported especially in high-risk injection zones or with improper technique. It is critical that injections are performed by trained medical professionals with full knowledge of facial anatomy and safety protocols.

short_description: Bellast Prime Soft with Lidocaine offers practitioners a soft, easy-to-handle filler that restores gentle volume and smoothness, especially in delicate facial regions. With 24 mg/mL HA and integrated 0.3% lidocaine, it provides comfortable injections and immediate, natural-looking results. Its lightweight gel consistency makes it ideal for treating fine lines and superficial wrinkles while maintaining skin softness and elasticity.
description: Bellast Prime Soft with Lidocaine is a CE-marked hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler belonging to the Bellast Prime range from Fox Pharma. It is formulated with 24 mg/mL high-density HA and 0.3% lidocaine, yielding a lightweight, low-viscosity gel.The filler is designed for superficial injection into the upper dermis, making it suitable for fine lines, superficial wrinkles, and delicate facial areas where subtle volume restoration and smoothing are required. What Bellast Prime Soft Is Similar To Bellast Prime Soft resembles other light or fine-texture HA fillers used for fine lines and surface-level correction — for example, the well-known Profhilo (though Profhilo is more of a skin-bio-remodelling product rather than a volumising filler) or softer variants of classical HA fillers. Like those, Bellast Prime Soft works via HA’s hydrophilic and volumising properties to draw in water and plump the dermal tissue. However, while Profhilo focuses on skin hydration and biorevitalisation, Bellast Prime Soft is formulated for superficial wrinkle smoothing and subtle volume restoration. Compared to thicker fillers used for deep folds or structural contouring (e.g., mid to deep-dermal fillers), Bellast Prime Soft is more delicate, easier to layer, and designed for minimal invasiveness. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications Periorbital area (e.g., around eyes) Superficial lines and fine facial wrinkles Tear-trough area (only when injected by fully trained and insured practitioners) Usage / Administration (IFU-based) Injection depth: Upper dermis / superficial dermis. Needle gauge & contents: Syringe plus 2 sterile 30G needles included in the box. Volume per syringe: 1 × 1 ml. Frequency / number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: To be administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. (Implicit in product being sold to clinics / practitioners only.) Note: No further injection-pattern, layering, or frequency guidance is provided in publicly available manufacturer data. Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid — 24 mg/mL (high-density, cross-linked) Lidocaine — 0.3% (local anesthetic incorporated for injection comfort) Other excipients / stabilisers / buffers — not provided by manufacturer Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 1 × 1 ml pre-filled syringe, supplied with 2 sterile 30G needles. Longevity / duration of effect: manufacturer indicates results typically last 6–12 months . Shelf life / storage instructions: not provided by manufacturer in public listing Safety Notes / Contraindications According to the manufacturer: Should not be used in patients with bleeding disorders. Not to be re-sterilised. Do not mix with other products before injection. Not recommended for patients prone to keloid formation. Contraindicated where there is inflammation, infection, or any active skin disease at or near the injection site. Not for use in patients with known lidocaine allergy. Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. If manufacturer IFU is unavailable or does not detail other contraindications: standard caution applies — avoid in patients with hypersensitivity to components, active skin infections, or systemic conditions affecting wound healing. FAQ Q1: How does Bellast Prime Soft improve the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles? A1: Bellast Prime Soft uses high-density hyaluronic acid (24 mg/mL) which, when injected into the superficial dermis, attracts and binds water molecules. This increases dermal volume and provides structural support beneath fine lines and superficial wrinkles, thereby smoothing the skin surface and reducing wrinkle depth. The gel also adds immediate physical support and hydration to the tissue. Q2: Is the injection painful for patients? A2: The filler includes 0.3% lidocaine, a local anaesthetic, to reduce discomfort during injection. This helps make the procedure more comfortable compared to filler without anaesthetic. Q3: How long do results from Bellast Prime Soft typically last? A3: According to the manufacturer, visible effects generally persist between 6 to 12 months post-treatment, depending on individual patient factors such as skin type, lifestyle, and treatment area. Q4: Can Bellast Prime Soft be used in the tear-trough (under-eye) area? A4: Yes — the manufacturer lists “tear trough” among the possible treatment areas. However, it is specified that injections in this delicate area must only be carried out by fully trained and insured practitioners. Q5: Is Bellast Prime Soft interchangeable with thicker fillers for deeper folds or volume restoration? A5: No — Bellast Prime Soft is formulated as a lightweight, low-viscosity filler for superficial dermal injection, fine lines, and delicate areas. Thicker fillers with higher viscosity and deeper injection depth (e.g., those designed for mid- to deep-dermis or subcutaneous tissue) are better suited for significant volume restoration, deep folds, or structural facial contouring. Therefore, Bellast Prime Soft should not be used interchangeably with heavier fillers for deep volumisation.

short_description: Aliaxin SV – 2×1 ml is a superior volume hyaluronic acid dermal filler by IBSA Derma for deep tissue augmentation, facial contouring, and structural support with natural‑looking, long‑lasting results.
description: Aliaxin SV – 2×1 ml – Superior Volume Dermal Filler Aliaxin SV – 2×1 ml is a high‑performance hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler manufactured by IBSA Derma , formulated to provide deep soft‑tissue volumisation, structural support, and facial contour enhancement . As part of the Aliaxin® range, the SV (Superior Volume) variant is engineered for areas requiring increased projection and tissue support, such as the cheeks, chin, and jawline. Its balanced rheology allows reliable integration and long‑lasting results while maintaining natural facial dynamics. What Aliaxin SV Is Similar To Aliaxin SV can be clinically compared to other deep volumising HA fillers such as Juvederm Voluma, Restylane Lyft, and Belotero Volume, which are designed for deep tissue support and augmentation. These products focus on mid‑to‑deep dermal and subcutaneous correction of age‑related volume loss. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation and clinical practice, Aliaxin SV is indicated for: Treatment areas: Mid‑face (cheek) volumisation Chin projection and contouring Jawline definition Correction of deep facial folds (e.g., nasolabial and marionette lines) Structural support where natural facial balance is needed → Aliaxin SV filler is frequently used when significant volume restoration and architectural support are desired in patients with moderate to advanced volume loss. Usage / Administration (IFU‑only) Injection depth: Deep dermal to subcutaneous tissue depending on the target area and aesthetic goal. Volume per injection site: Determined by clinician based on anatomical assessment and desired outcome. Needle/Cannula: Fine gauge needles or appropriate cannulae may be used based on practitioner preference and anatomical considerations. Frequency / number of sessions: Typically a single session; touch‑ups may be considered based on clinical response. Professional‑use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical or aesthetic professionals under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is not provided in the official IFU, it is marked “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List (Aliaxin SV Ingredients) Cross‑linked hyaluronic acid (HA): High concentration HA optimised for deep support and volumisation. Physiological buffers and stabilisers as indicated in the official IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: Two 1 ml pre‑filled sterile syringes with needles. Shelf‑life: Refer to product packaging for expiry details. Longevity (treatment duration): Results from Aliaxin SV treatments are typically visible immediately and may last up to 12–18 months , depending on individual metabolism, anatomical site, and injection technique. Aliaxin filler price varies by distributor, region, and clinic pricing strategy; practitioners should consult authorised suppliers for up‑to‑date pricing and availability when they buy Aliaxin SV or other Aliaxin products. Safety Notes / Contraindications Aliaxin SV is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid or any component of the formulation. Avoid injecting into areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin integrity. Intravascular injection must be strictly avoided; careful aspiration and slow, controlled injection technique are recommended to minimise risk. Single‑use syringes must not be reused. Typical transient reactions include mild swelling, redness, tenderness, or minor bruising at injection sites, usually resolving within a few days. Regulatory Status Aliaxin SV is a CE‑marked medical device in applicable regions. Regulatory classification, approved indications, and usage protocols may vary by jurisdiction; practitioners should verify local compliance and review the official IFU prior to clinical use. FAQ 1. What is Aliaxin SV? Aliaxin SV is a high‑density hyaluronic acid dermal filler by IBSA Derma designed for deep volumisation and structural facial support . 2. Where is Aliaxin SV commonly used? It is commonly used for mid‑face (cheek) volumisation, chin projection, jawline definition , and correction of deep facial folds. 3. How long do the results from Aliaxin SV last? Results are typically visible immediately and can last up to 12–18 months , depending on treated area, patient metabolism, and technique. 4. What makes Aliaxin SV different from lighter HA fillers? Aliaxin SV has a higher HA concentration and viscoelasticity , making it suitable for deeper tissue support and volumisation compared to softer fillers that focus on hydration or fine lines. 5. What should practitioners consider regarding Aliaxin filler price? Aliaxin filler price varies by region, supplier, and clinic. Clinics should consult authorised distributors when they buy Aliaxin SV or other Aliaxin products to ensure authenticity and current pricing.

description: Aliaxin LV – 2×1 ml – Lips Volume and Fine Wrinkle Dermal Filler Aliaxin LV – 2×1 ml is a premium hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler manufactured by IBSA Derma, designed to provide lips volume enhancement, soft tissue support, and correction of fine to moderate facial wrinkles . The “LV” in the name stands for Lips Volume , reflecting this product’s optimisation for areas such as the lips and adjacent regions where controlled, natural volume enhancement is required. What Aliaxin LV Is Similar To Aliaxin LV can be regarded alongside other lip-focussed and versatile HA fillers such as Juvederm Ultra Smile, Restylane Kysse, Teosyal Kiss, and Belotero Lip Volume. These fillers are formulated to enhance lip projection, define borders, and improve hydration while maintaining soft, natural movement. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation and clinical practice, Aliaxin LV filler is indicated for: Treatment areas: Lip volume enhancement ( Aliaxin LV lips volume ) Vermillion border definition Perioral fine lines and superficial wrinkles Soft contour refinement adjacent to lip and perioral regions → Aliaxin LV is frequently used where natural, balanced lip enhancement and subtle correction of lines around the mouth are desirable, making it suitable for patients seeking enhanced lip shape and hydration with minimal stiffness. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Superficial to mid-dermal, depending on targeted anatomy and desired outcome. Volume per injection site: Small aliquots; total volume tailored per clinical assessment. Needle gauge: Fine gauge needle appropriate for safe and accurate placement in delicate lip and perioral tissues. Frequency / number of sessions: A single session is typically sufficient; additional touch-ups may be considered based on clinical response. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical or aesthetic professionals under strict aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU it is marked “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List (Aliaxin LV Ingredients) Cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA): Optimised for soft projection and tissue integration. Physiologic buffers and stabilisers as included in the official IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: Two 1 ml pre-filled sterile syringes with needles. Shelf-life: Refer to product packaging for expiration details. Longevity (treatment duration): Effects from Aliaxin LV treatments are typically visible immediately and can last up to 9–12 months depending on the anatomical location, metabolic rate, and injection technique. Aliaxin LV price varies by distributor, region, and clinic pricing strategy; practitioners should consult authorised suppliers to confirm current pricing and availability when they buy Aliaxin LV . Safety Notes / Contraindications Aliaxin LV is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid or any component of the formulation. Avoid injection in areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin integrity. Intravascular injection must be strictly avoided; slow, controlled injection with aspiration is recommended. Single-use syringes must not be reused. Common transient effects include mild swelling, redness, tenderness, or bruising at injection sites, which generally resolve within a few days. short_description: Aessoa Global with Lidocaine is a dermal filler intended to address fine wrinkles, periorbital lines, and lip contouring with a comfortable injection experience. The product is based on cross-linked hyaluronic acid, optimised for mid-dermis placement to enhance skin hydration and texture through water retention and gel integration. The addition of lidocaine (0.3%) is specifically formulated to support patient comfort during administration. Supplied as a 1×1ml prefilled syringe , it is suitable for aesthetic professionals seeking predictable performance in fine-line correction and contour enhancement. The device must be administered by trained clinicians in a clinical setting following manufacturer guidance.
description: Aessoa Global with Lidocaine Hyaluronic Acid Dermal Filler for Fine to Moderate Wrinkle Correction Aessoa Global with Lidocaine is a high-purity, hyaluronic-acid-based dermal filler formulated for aesthetic soft-tissue augmentation and wrinkle correction. This device comprises a monophasic cross-linked hyaluronic acid gel at approximately 24 mg/ml with 0.3% lidocaine hydrochloride , a local anaesthetic included to improve patient comfort during injection. Delivered via a sterile, prefilled 1.0 ml syringe, the filler is designed primarily for mid-dermis placement , where water-binding properties aid skin texture improvement and hydration . Its viscoelastic properties (approx. 100–200 Pa·s) facilitate smooth extrusion and moulding at treatment sites. The inclusion of lidocaine assists in analgesia without altering the fundamental rheologic behaviour of the hyaluronic acid gel. Aessoa Global is indicated for fine to moderate wrinkle correction, contour refinement, and aesthetic enhancement when used by qualified and trained medical professionals in accordance with the official instructions for use (IFU) and appropriate aseptic technique. What Aessoa Global with Lidocaine Is Similar To Aessoa Global with Lidocaine belongs to the widely used class of hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal fillers , functioning through volumetric support and water binding to improve the appearance of wrinkles and facial contours. In this category, products such as Teosyal Puresense Global Action also utilise cross-linked HA with lidocaine to provide comfort-assisted injections for lines and contouring. Both types aim to replace lost volume and integrate within the dermal matrix to support smoother skin topography. Differences among HA fillers typically relate to HA concentration, cross-linking chemistry, viscosity, and manufacturer-specified indications. Aessoa Global’s formulation is positioned for fine to moderate superficial wrinkles and hydration enhancement , whereas some other fillers in the same family may be optimised for deeper folds or larger volumetric augmentation. As with all injectable gels, clinician technique, anatomical placement depth, and product rheology influence clinical outcomes. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications Based on publicly available professional descriptions: Fine to moderate facial wrinkles Periorbital lines (around the eyes) Perioral lines Lip contouring Texture improvement / hydration enhancement treatment areas not explicitly provided by manufacturer in official IFU. Usage / Administration Official manufacturer IFU details are not publicly available online; therefore, the following are based on label descriptions from authorised distributors: Injection depth: mid dermis Volume per point / injection site: not provided by manufacturer Needle gauge: recommended 30 G needle (distributor suggestion; not official IFU) Frequency / number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer Professional-use disclaimer: administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid (HA): ~24 mg/ml (cross-linked) Lidocaine hydrochloride: ~0.3% Excipients / buffer: not provided by manufacturer Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1 ml prefilled syringe Shelf life: not provided by manufacturer Treatment duration / longevity: up to 12–18 months based on clinical experience and distributor information (may vary per patient) Safety Notes / Contraindications Public IFU details are limited; include standard clinical cautions: Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any component . Avoid treatment in areas with active skin infection or inflammation . Not for use in individuals with severe allergy history or systemic conditions without qualified medical assessment. Device for single-use only; do not reuse . Regulatory Status Aessoa fillers including Global are widely CE-marked in EU markets according to distributor declarations. Regulatory classification not specified in public documentation; verify on the product pack or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ 1:What is Aessoa Global with Lidocaine and how does it work? Aessoa Global with Lidocaine is a hyaluronic acid-based dermal filler intended for mid-dermis injection. It binds to water molecules within the skin to improve texture and hydration while replacing volume to reduce fine and moderate wrinkles. Lidocaine serves as a local anaesthetic to support injection comfort. 2: Which areas can Aessoa Global be used on? Professional descriptions indicate use for fine facial lines, periorbital and perioral wrinkles, and lip contour definition. Official manufacturer IFU details on specific zones are not published; clinicians should follow training and IFU guidance. 3: How long do results typically last? Distributor information commonly cites longevity of up to 12–18 months , though individual results may vary based on metabolism, treatment area, and product placement. 4: Is lidocaine included and why? Yes — Aessoa Global contains approximately 0.3% lidocaine , which is intended to reduce discomfort during injection without altering the filler’s rheologic characteristics. 5: How does Aessoa Global compare to other HA fillers? Like other HA fillers, Aessoa Global provides soft-tissue support through water binding and volume replacement. Differences among products relate to HA concentration, cross-linking, and gel viscosity, which influence behaviour and clinical use. This product is positioned for fine to moderate lines rather than heavy volumisation.

short_description: Aessoa Deep with Lidocaine is a dermal filler designed for deeper tissue augmentation where structural support and contour definition are required. Formulated with cross-linked hyaluronic acid, it provides volumising capacity while maintaining tissue integration. The inclusion of lidocaine hydrochloride is intended to enhance patient comfort during treatment. Supplied in a 1 × 1 ml prefilled syringe , Aessoa Deep is commonly selected for areas requiring stronger lifting capacity compared with superficial fillers. The product is intended strictly for use by trained medical professionals and should be administered under aseptic conditions, following official manufacturer guidance. Clinical outcomes depend on practitioner technique, anatomical assessment, and individual patient factors.
description: Aessoa Deep with Lidocaine Hyaluronic Acid Dermal Filler for Deep Tissue Volume and Facial Contour Support Aessoa Deep with Lidocaine is a hyaluronic-acid-based dermal filler classified as a cross-linked HA soft-tissue filler intended for deeper dermal and subcutaneous aesthetic correction. The product is supplied as a sterile, prefilled syringe containing cross-linked hyaluronic acid combined with lidocaine hydrochloride , designed to support patient comfort during injection. The mechanism of action relies on the hydrophilic properties of hyaluronic acid, which binds water molecules within the extracellular matrix, providing mechanical support and volume replacement in areas affected by age-related volume loss or structural changes. The “Deep” designation indicates a formulation intended for deeper placement compared to superficial HA fillers, supporting contouring and structural enhancement rather than fine line correction. What Aessoa Deep with Lidocaine Is Similar To Aessoa Deep with Lidocaine belongs to the category of cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal fillers designed for deeper dermal or subcutaneous placement . Products in this category are formulated to provide structural volume, contour support, and shape retention rather than superficial hydration alone. short_description: Radiesse® with Lidocaine is a calcium hydroxylapatite-based dermal filler designed for lifting, contouring, and facial volume restoration. Supplied in a 1.5 mL syringe, it provides immediate support and long-lasting structural results.
description: Radiesse® with Lidocaine – Lifting & Volume 1 × 1.5 mL Radiesse® with Lidocaine is an injectable dermal filler medical device composed of calcium hydroxylapatite (CaHA) microspheres suspended in an aqueous gel carrier , developed for facial volume restoration, contour enhancement, and structural support . Unlike hyaluronic acid fillers, Radiesse filler works through both immediate volumisation and longer-term collagen stimulation. The inclusion of lidocaine improves patient comfort during injection. The CaHA microspheres provide an immediate lifting effect while gradually stimulating the body’s own collagen production as the gel carrier is resorbed. Radiesse Lifting & Volume 1 × 1.5 mL is indicated for treatment of moderate to severe facial wrinkles and folds, as well as contouring in areas requiring firm structural support. What Radiesse® Is Similar To Radiesse can be regarded alongside other biostimulatory dermal fillers that provide both volumising and collagen-stimulating effects. Unlike traditional hyaluronic acid fillers that rely solely on gel volume, Radiesse combines mechanical lift with neocollagenesis over time. Compared with HA fillers used for softer contouring, Radiesse with Lido offers firmer structural support and may be selected for areas requiring stronger projection and durability. However, due to its different composition and mechanism of action, it is not directly interchangeable with hyaluronic acid fillers. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Radiesse treatment is indicated for correction of moderate to severe facial wrinkles and folds and for restoration of facial volume. Treatment areas may include: Nasolabial folds • Marionette lines • Cheeks • Chin • Jawline • Facial contours • Hands → Radiesse is typically selected for areas requiring structural support rather than superficial fine-line correction. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth: Deep dermal to subdermal or supraperiosteal plane, depending on indication. Volume per point / injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: Supplied with sterile needles as per packaging. Frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is marked as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Calcium hydroxylapatite (CaHA) microspheres Aqueous gel carrier (including sterile water and glycerin components) Lidocaine hydrochloride Other excipients as per IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1.5 mL pre-filled sterile syringe Shelf-life: Not specified in public documentation; refer to packaging for expiry date. Longevity (treatment duration): Results are typically reported to last approximately 12–18 months , depending on treatment area, injection depth, and individual patient metabolism. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the product. Avoid use in patients with active skin infection or inflammation at the injection site until resolved. Do not inject intravascularly. Radiesse should not be used in areas where soft, highly flexible fillers are indicated, such as superficial lip augmentation. Single use only; do not reuse the syringe; ensure packaging is intact and within expiry. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device in Europe. FDA-approved for specific indications in the United States. UKCA status: verify via IFU or authorised distributor. Regulatory classification may vary by jurisdiction; verify on the product packaging or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ 1. What is Radiesse® with Lidocaine? Radiesse with Lido is a calcium hydroxylapatite-based dermal filler designed for facial lifting and volume restoration, offering both immediate support and collagen stimulation. 2. How is Radiesse different from hyaluronic acid fillers? Unlike HA fillers, Radiesse filler contains CaHA microspheres that stimulate collagen production in addition to providing immediate volumisation. 3. How long does Radiesse last? Results are commonly reported to last between 12 and 18 months , depending on individual factors and treated area. 4. Is Radiesse suitable for lips? Radiesse is generally not indicated for superficial lip augmentation due to its firm structural properties. 5. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? Advanced anatomical knowledge, correct depth placement, and strict aseptic technique are essential when performing Radiesse treatment , particularly in vascular areas.

short_description: Seventy Hyal 2000 is a next-generation skin booster formulated to enhance skin hydration, stimulate collagen and elastin production, and improve overall skin quality. With one of the highest molecular weight hyaluronic acid (HA) formulations available (>2000 kDa), it provides intense hydration, gentle volume, and a natural glow. Designed for long-term skin rejuvenation or as a pre-event treatment, Seventy Hyal 2000 restores HA levels within the dermis, improving texture and laxity. The product comes in a pack of 3 x 2ml syringes , suitable for use across the face, neck, décolletage, hands, and lips.
description: Seventy Hyal 2000 is a highly advanced skin booster designed to address the physiological depletion of hyaluronic acid within the skin. As an injectable skincare solution, it integrates deep into the dermis to deliver intense hydration, improve skin elasticity, and stimulate the natural production of collagen and elastin. With an impressive HA concentration of 90mg per 6ml , this formulation ensures optimal moisture retention, skin plumpness, and overall rejuvenation. One of the key advantages of Seventy Hyal 2000 is its use of high molecular weight HA (>2000 kDa), which offers long-lasting hydration and structural support to the skin. Unlike traditional dermal fillers, this skin booster does not add excessive volume but instead imparts a natural glow and smooths out fine lines. Its biocompatible, CE-marked, and vegan-friendly composition ensures safety and effectiveness for all skin types, making it an ideal choice for aesthetic practitioners seeking high-performance skin rejuvenation treatments. Seventy Hyal 2000 is suitable for treating the face, tear troughs, neck, décolletage, hands, and lips , offering a comprehensive approach to non-surgical facial revitalization. The results of this treatment are visible almost immediately due to the high molecular weight HA, with continued improvements over time. The recommended treatment protocol varies depending on the patient’s skin quality and individual needs, with optimal outcomes seen after a series of sessions. Treatment Areas: Face (including tear troughs) Neck Décolletage Hands Lips Usage: Administered via injection by trained medical professionals. Can be used as a standalone skin booster or combined with other aesthetic treatments. Recommended treatment plan varies per individual; initial results are visible almost immediately, with continued improvement over time. Disodium Phosphate H2O & Monosodium Phosphate H2O – Buffering agents that regulate pH levels. Water for Injection – Ensures sterility and purity. Product Dimensions/Size: 3 x 2ml syringes per box Needles not included Product Duration: Results are immediate and continue improving over time. The longevity of results varies based on individual skin type and lifestyle factors. Manufactured By: Seventy Hyal Popular Questions & Answers: 1. What is Seventy Hyal 2000 used for? Seventy Hyal 2000 is a next-generation injectable skin booster designed to restore hydration, stimulate collagen and elastin production, and improve skin texture and elasticity. It is commonly used for facial, neck, décolletage, hand, and lip rejuvenation. 2. How long does Seventy Hyal 2000 last? The longevity of results varies depending on the individual’s skin quality and lifestyle factors. Typically, results are visible almost immediately and improve over time with a recommended treatment plan. 3. How does Seventy Hyal 2000 differ from traditional dermal fillers? Unlike traditional fillers that provide volume, Seventy Hyal 2000 is designed to hydrate and improve skin quality. It enhances the skin’s natural glow, smooths fine lines, and promotes elasticity without excessive volumization. 4. Can Seventy Hyal 2000 be used with other aesthetic treatments? Yes, it can be combined with treatments like Botox, microneedling, and chemical peels to enhance overall skin quality and anti-aging results. However, treatment protocols should be determined by a qualified aesthetic practitioner. 5. Is Seventy Hyal 2000 safe for all skin types? Yes, Seventy Hyal 2000 is CE-marked, biocompatible, and suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It is a non-surgical solution for individuals aged 18 and above looking for hydration and skin rejuvenation.

The product belongs to the Stylage range of cross-linked hyaluronic acid fillers and is designed to address significant volume loss while enhancing facial structure and projection. The formulation combines cross-linked hyaluronic acid with the company’s IPN-Like technology and includes antioxidant mannitol, which is incorporated to help reduce oxidative degradation of hyaluronic acid following implantation. Stylage XXL Bi-SOFT is intended for use in areas requiring substantial volumising capacity, particularly where age-related volume depletion or contour deficiencies are present.
