description: Stylage M with Lido Bi-Soft 2x1ml – Dermal Filler for Wrinkles and Lip Enhancement Stylage M with Lido Bi-Soft 2x1ml is a cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler developed by Vivacy Laboratories, designed for the correction of moderate to deep wrinkles, restoration of facial volume, and lip enhancement. The formulation contains lidocaine to improve patient comfort during injection and incorporates Vivacy’s Bi-Soft® injection technology for enhanced precision, control, and ergonomic handling. Stylage M offers a balanced viscoelastic profile, allowing smooth tissue integration while maintaining sufficient structural support, making it suitable for facial rejuvenation procedures where natural-looking volume, wrinkle smoothing, and lip definition are required. What Stylage M Is Similar To Stylage M can be regarded alongside other medium-density hyaluronic acid fillers such as Juvederm Ultra 3, Restylane Refyne, and Teosyal Global Action. These products are designed for moderate wrinkle correction and lip treatments, focusing on flexibility, smooth integration, and natural facial movement. Unlike higher-density fillers intended for deep structural contouring, Stylage M Bi-Soft is formulated for versatility, making it suitable for both wrinkle correction and Stylage M lip filler applications. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Stylage M with Lido Bi-Soft is indicated for the treatment of nasolabial folds, marionette lines, moderate facial wrinkles, and lips for volume enhancement, contour definition, and hydration. Stylage M for lips is frequently selected due to its smooth extrusion force, even product distribution, and ability to preserve natural lip movement. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth is mid to deep dermis or lip mucosa depending on the treatment area and indication. The volume per injection site is determined by wrinkle depth, lip anatomy, and practitioner assessment. Stylage M is supplied in the Bi-Soft® ergonomic syringe system to improve injection control and precision. Treatment is typically completed in a single session, with optional touch-ups after 2–4 weeks if required. Stylage M must be administered only by qualified medical or aesthetic professionals under strict aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is considered not provided by the manufacturer. Ingredient List (Stylage M Ingredients) Stylage M contains cross-linked hyaluronic acid sodium salt for wrinkle correction and volume support, lidocaine hydrochloride to improve injection comfort, mannitol as an antioxidant to reduce hyaluronic acid degradation, and phosphate buffer with water for injection. Presentation & Longevity Stylage M with Lido Bi-Soft is supplied as 2 × 1ml pre-filled sterile syringes with needles. Shelf life should be verified on the product packaging. Clinical results typically last between 9 and 12 months, depending on treatment area, patient metabolism, and injection technique. Stylage M price may vary depending on distributor and region. Common transient reactions may include redness, swelling, bruising, or tenderness at the injection site, typically resolving within a few days. description: Stylage Hydro Bi‑Soft 1x1ml – Skin Booster Dermal Filler Stylage Hydro Bi‑Soft 1x1ml is an advanced hyaluronic acid (HA) injectable developed by Vivacy Laboratories , formulated to improve skin hydration, elasticity, texture, and overall skin quality . Unlike traditional volumising fillers, Stylage Hydro is designed primarily as a skin booster , targeting superficial hydration and dermal revitalisation. The Bi‑Soft® syringe system enables controlled injection with reduced extrusion force and enhanced handling for practitioner precision and comfort. What Stylage Hydro Is Similar To Stylage Hydro Bi‑Soft can be considered alongside other skin booster HA formulations such as Restylane Skinboosters, Juvederm Volite, and Teosyal Redensity 1 — products used to enhance hydration and improve dermal texture rather than create deep volume. These treatments work by improving the dermal microenvironment , enhancing moisture retention and supporting smoother, more resilient skin. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation and clinical practice, Stylage Hydro is indicated for: Treatment areas: Face (cheeks, periorbital region, forehead) Neck and décolletage Fine surface lines Hydration and skin quality improvement Delicate zones such as lips ( Stylage Hydro lips ) where surface hydration and texture enhancement are the goals → Stylage Hydro is frequently selected by practitioners when the aim is to improve skin smoothness, hydration, and radiance rather than deeper structural support. Usage / Administration (IFU‑only) Injection depth: Superficial to mid‑dermal depending on treatment area and clinical objective. Volume per injection site: Small micro‑droplet or linear threading techniques are recommended; total volume tailored per patient assessment. Needle gauge: Fine gauge needle suitable for superficial dermal placement. Frequency / number of sessions: Typical protocols involve 2–3 sessions spaced 3–4 weeks apart, with maintenance every 3–6 months. Professional‑use disclaimer: Administered only by trained medical or aesthetic professionals under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is not specified in the official IFU, it is considered not provided by manufacturer . Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid (HA): Bi‑Soft® cross‑linked HA optimised for hydration and dermal integration Phosphate‑buffered saline and water for injection: Physiological carriers enhancing injectability Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1 ml pre‑filled sterile syringe with needle. Shelf‑life: Refer to product packaging for expiry information. Longevity (treatment duration): Improvements in skin hydration and texture are typically noticeable after the first session and may last approximately 3–6 months depending on individual skin condition, metabolism, and aftercare. Stylage Hydro filler price varies by distributor, region, and clinic pricing strategy; practitioners should consult authorised suppliers for current pricing and availability. Safety Notes / Contraindications Stylage Hydro Bi‑Soft is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid or any formulation component. Avoid injection into areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin conditions. Intravascular injection must be strictly avoided; slow injection and aspiration techniques are recommended. Single‑use syringes must not be reused. Patients may experience mild and transient reactions — such as redness, swelling, or tenderness at injection sites — usually resolving within several days. Regulatory Status Stylage Hydro Bi‑Soft is a CE‑marked medical device in applicable regions. Regulatory classification and approved indications may vary by jurisdiction; practitioners should verify local compliance and consult the official IFU prior to use. FAQ 1. What is Stylage Hydro? Stylage Hydro is a hyaluronic acid skin booster designed to improve skin hydration, elasticity, and texture by enhancing moisture retention and dermal quality. 2. How does Stylage Hydro work? Stylage Hydro delivers hydrophilic HA into superficial to mid‑dermal layers, attracting and retaining water to increase hydration and improve skin smoothness and quality. 3. How does Stylage Hydro vs Hydromax compare? Both are hydration‑focused boosters, but Stylage Hydro is formulated for general hydration and texture improvement, while Stylage Hydromax is optimised for deeper hydration and skin elasticity support. ( Note: exact differences should be confirmed via IFU or training. ) 4. Can Stylage Hydro be used for lips? Yes — Stylage Hydro lips treatments are performed to improve lip skin hydration and texture, though it is not typically used for volumisation. 5. What results can be expected and how long do they last? Improvements in hydration and smoothness are usually noticeable after the first session and can last around 3–6 months , with maintenance sessions advised for sustained benefits.

description: Lanluma V 1x15ml – Injectable PLLA Biostimulator Lanluma V 1x15ml is a professional injectable poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) biostimulatory treatment designed to restore volume, improve skin firmness, and stimulate long-term collagen production. Supplied as a sterile powder vial containing 210 mg PLLA , Lanluma V is reconstituted prior to injection and is intended for deep dermal and subcutaneous use in face and body treatments. Unlike hyaluronic acid fillers that provide immediate volume through gel implantation, Lanluma V works by stimulating the body’s natural collagen synthesis , delivering progressive, natural-looking volume restoration and skin quality improvement over time. What Lanluma V Is Similar To Lanluma V belongs to the category of collagen-stimulating injectables and is clinically comparable to other PLLA-based biostimulators such as Sculptra® . These products focus on bioremodeling and volumization through neocollagenesis , rather than direct filling. This comparison is provided for professional reference only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Lanluma V 1x15ml is indicated for: Treatment areas: Face (cheeks, temples, jawline) Mid-face volume loss Body contouring (buttocks, hips, thighs) Skin laxity and collagen depletion Volume restoration following aging or weight loss → Lanluma V is particularly suited for patients seeking long-lasting volume correction and structural support with gradual, natural results. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Deep dermal to subcutaneous plane Product preparation: Requires reconstitution with sterile water for injection (volume as per IFU) Injection technique: Cannula or needle using fanning or cross-hatching techniques Treatment protocol: Typically 1–3 sessions spaced 4–6 weeks apart Longevity: Results develop gradually over weeks and can last up to 24 months Professional-use disclaimer: For use only by trained and qualified medical or aesthetic practitioners If any parameter is not explicitly stated in the official IFU, it is considered not provided by the manufacturer . Ingredient List (Lanluma V Ingredients) Poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA): 210 mg Sodium carboxymethylcellulose Mannitol Lanluma V does not contain lidocaine . Reconstitution and dilution must follow official manufacturer instructions. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 15 ml vial (powder form) Reconstitution: Required prior to use Shelf life: Refer to packaging for expiry date Treatment longevity: Progressive collagen stimulation with results lasting up to 18–24 months , depending on patient factors and protocol Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to PLLA or any excipients Do not inject into areas with active infection or inflammation Not suitable for intravascular injection Strict aseptic technique required Practitioner must have advanced anatomical knowledge and biostimulator training Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device in applicable regions. Regulatory classification, approved indications, and usage protocols may vary by country. Practitioners should always consult the official IFU and comply with local regulations. FAQ 1. What is Lanluma V used for? Lanluma V is used for collagen stimulation, volume restoration, and skin firmness improvement in both facial and body treatments. 2. How does Lanluma V work? Lanluma V contains PLLA, which stimulates fibroblasts to produce new collagen over time. This leads to gradual volumization and improved skin structure rather than immediate filling. 3. Is Lanluma V the same as a dermal filler? No. Lanluma V is a biostimulator , not a traditional filler. It works progressively by inducing collagen production rather than instantly adding volume. 4. How long do Lanluma V results last? Results typically last 18 to 24 months , depending on patient metabolism, treatment area, and number of sessions. 5. What training is required to use Lanluma V? Advanced injector training is strongly recommended. Proper education in PLLA reconstitution, injection technique, and anatomy is essential for safe and effective outcomes.

description: Clinical Description Ejal 40 is a bio-revitalising injectable medical device developed by Medixa Srl for improving skin quality, hydration, and dermal support in patients showing signs of intrinsic and extrinsic skin ageing. description: AesPLLA Poly-L-Lactic Acid Collagen Stimulator Injectable for Facial Volume Restoration and Wrinkle Correction aesPLLA® Poly-L-Lactic Acid (PLLA) Collagen Stimulator is a biodegradable injectable collagen-stimulating device designed to support gradual facial volume restoration through neocollagenesis rather than immediate volumisation. The product contains poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA), a synthetic biocompatible polymer that has been extensively studied in aesthetic medicine for its ability to stimulate fibroblast activity and promote endogenous collagen production over time. Unlike conventional hyaluronic acid fillers that primarily provide immediate space-occupying volume, aesPLLA® acts as a biostimulatory treatment. Following administration and reconstitution according to manufacturer instructions, PLLA microparticles gradually trigger a controlled tissue response that may lead to progressive collagen deposition and structural support within treated tissues. aesPLLA® is intended for use by qualified medical professionals and is commonly selected for patients seeking gradual correction of age-related volume loss and skin laxity. Treatment outcomes develop progressively over several weeks and months following treatment. What aesPLLA® Is Similar To aesPLLA® belongs to the category of collagen-stimulating injectables and is commonly compared with products such as Sculptra® and Lanluma®. All three products utilise poly-L-lactic acid as their primary active component and are intended to stimulate endogenous collagen production rather than provide immediate volumisation through hyaluronic acid implantation. Compared with traditional HA fillers such as Juvederm® Voluma or Restylane® Lyft, PLLA-based products typically deliver gradual improvements over multiple treatment sessions. Results often emerge progressively as collagen remodelling occurs following administration. Product selection depends on treatment goals, patient anatomy, desired correction pattern, practitioner preference, and treatment planning considerations. Patients seeking immediate correction may be better suited to conventional HA fillers, while collagen stimulators are often selected where progressive tissue support and collagen induction are desired. short_description: Fillmed NCTF 135HA is a professional-grade, skin-booster injectable used by qualified practitioners to revitalise and hydrate tired or aging skin. It helps smooth fine lines, restore elasticity, and enhance radiance through a medically engineered blend of hyaluronic acid and 55 revitalising ingredients. description: Fillmed NCTF 135HA is a CE-marked , injectable biorevitalising medical device designed for skin quality enhancement. It combines 5 mg/mL non crosslinked sodium hyaluronate with a rich “polyrevitalising” formula containing vitamins, amino acids, nucleic acids, minerals, and co-enzymes. This cocktail supports fibroblast activity, promoting collagen and elastin synthesis, hydration, and dermal renewal. The mechanism of action is not volumetric filling, but biological stimulation of the dermis, helping to improve skin radiance, elasticity, and density. What It’s Similar To In terms of function and category, NCTF 135HA can be compared to other skin boosters such as Sunekos® or Profhilo® . Like Sunekos, it uses a multi-component formula (not just hyaluronic acid) to stimulate skin renewal; unlike cross-linked volumising fillers, it doesn’t add structure or volume, similar to Profhilo, but its action is more focused on skin revitalisation rather than deep hydration or bi-restructuring. The key difference lies in the ingredient profile: NCTF includes a broad mix of vitamins, amino acids, nucleic acids, minerals and co-enzymes alongside HA, giving it a richer “biological” stimulation. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to the manufacturer and distributor information, NCTF 135HA is indicated for: Face (including periorbital area) Neck Décolleté Hands Arms (some sources mention inner arms) Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Superficial dermis (intradermal). Needle gauge: According to clinical use, 32 G × 4 mm classic needle has been used. Frequency / number of sessions: The standard recommended protocol is 3 sessions spaced 15 days apart , followed by 2 sessions spaced one month apart . Volume per injection / point: The IFU does not publicly specify a fixed “volume per point / papule” for each injection site. (The public IFU / SSCP does not provide a detailed per-point dosage.) Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals, under aseptic conditions. Ingredient List Non–crosslinked sodium hyaluronate (5 mg/mL) 12 vitamins (A, B-complex including B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B8, B9, B12; C; E) 24 amino acids (e.g., glycine, proline, leucine, etc.) 5 nucleic acids (deoxyadenosine, deoxycytidine, etc.) 6 minerals (e.g., calcium, potassium, magnesium) 6 co-enzymes (e.g., NAD, FAD, CoA) Other excipients: glutathione, polysorbate 80, glucuronic acid / lactone, glucosamine, dextrose (anhydrous) Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 5 × 3 mL sterile vials. Shelf life: Not publicly specified in the manufacturer SSCP. Treatment duration / longevity: According to clinical evidence, skin improvements (wrinkles, radiance, density) were still measurable at 120 days (4 months) after the third injection in studies. Maintenance protocols typically follow every 3–6 months as used in practice. Safety Notes / Contraindications From publicly available prescribing and distributor information: Hypersensitivity : Contraindicated in patients with known allergy or hypersensitivity to any component (e.g., hyaluronic acid). Active infection : Avoid in areas with active skin infection, inflammation, or wounds. Autoimmune or clotting disorders : Use cautiously (or avoid) in patients with autoimmune disease, bleeding/clotting disorders. Pregnancy / Breastfeeding : Not recommended during pregnancy or in breastfeeding mothers (precaution due to lack of safety data). Regulatory Status CE-marked (European Conformity) medical device. Regulatory classification: injectable medical device for professional use (as stated by Fillmed). FAQ Q1: How does NCTF 135HA actually improve skin quality? A: NCTF 135HA works by delivering a synergistic blend of non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid and vital “polyrevitalising” nutrients (vitamins, amino acids, nucleic acids, minerals, co-enzymes) into the dermis. This stimulates fibroblasts, which in turn produce more collagen and elastin, improving elasticity, hydration, and skin tone over time. Q2: Is NCTF 135HA safe for use, and what side-effects are common? A: Clinical evidence and safety performance reports show that most adverse reactions are mild: bruising (~36%) and redness (~23%) are common but generally light in intensity, with nearly half resolving within 48 hours. It should not be used in patients with hypersensitivity, active infection, or certain systemic conditions. Q3: How often should treatments be performed? A: According to Fillmed’s recommended protocol, you would typically administer 3 sessions spaced 15 days apart, followed by 2 further sessions with one-month intervals.Some practitioners then use maintenance treatments every 3–6 months. Q4: How long do the effects last? A: In clinical studies, improvements in skin density, radiance, and the appearance of fine lines were still measurable at 120 days after the treatment course. Maintenance treatments can help sustain results. Q5: How does NCTF 135HA compare with other skin boosters like Profhilo or Sunekos? A: Unlike volumising fillers, NCTF 135HA doesn’t add structure—its strength lies in “biological revitalisation.” Compared to Sunekos, which also uses amino acids, NCTF provides a more complex mix, including nucleic acids and co-enzymes. Compared to Profhilo, which focuses on very high-purity hyaluronic acid and bi-restructuring, NCTF is more nutrient-rich and stimulatory. This comparison is for clinical orientation and does not imply interchangeability.

description: Gouri – Liquid PCL (Polycaprolactone) 1 × 1 mL Gouri®, also referred to as Liquid PCL , is an injectable polycaprolactone (PCL) biostimulator medical device formulated to support natural collagen regeneration (collagenesis) in the skin through a fully solubilised liquid PCL solution. Unlike traditional microparticle fillers, Gouri’s liquid PCL spreads evenly within the dermal and subdermal layers to stimulate fibroblasts and encourage the body’s own production of collagen and elastin, addressing signs of aging such as skin laxity, fine lines, and decreased elasticity. The product is typically administered across multiple sites with fine needles and may be used for broad facial rejuvenation rather than focal volumetric correction. The liquid PCL formulation makes Gouri adaptable for more uniform tissue distribution compared with particulate PCL or suspended fillers, which can require shaping after injection. It is intended for use by qualified medical professionals experienced in facial anatomy and collagen stimulation techniques. What Gouri Liquid PCL Is Similar To Gouri PCL can be regarded alongside collagen stimulator injectables such as Sculptra® (poly-L-lactic acid) and other PCL-based products, in that all are designed to promote endogenous collagen production rather than solely providing immediate volume like hyaluronic acid dermal fillers. However, unlike particulate PCL or PLLA products that encapsulate solid particles requiring reconstitution and carry a higher risk of nodule formation, Gouri’s liquid formulation is fully solubilised, allowing smoother injection and broader tissue distribution. Compared with HA-based skin boosters (e.g., Profhilo®), which primarily hydrate and improve matrix quality, Gouri emphasises longer-term collagenogenesis and tissue firmness due to PCL’s polymer structure and sustained biostimulatory effect. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to available product information, Gouri Liquid PCL is indicated for: Full-face collagen stimulation and generalized rejuvenation. Improvement of skin elasticity and firmness across facial zones. Support for deeper wrinkles and skin laxity associated with aging. Gouri is typically injected into the dermal or subdermal layers of the face and may be used around areas such as cheeks, forehead, temple, and under-eye zones, depending on clinical assessment. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Dermal or subdermal layer. Volume per injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: Recommended 30 G to 35 G needles. Frequency / number of sessions: Many professional protocols recommend 3 treatment sessions spaced about 4 weeks apart , followed by maintenance every 3–6 months; however, official IFU details may vary by country and supplier. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. If a parameter is omitted in the official IFU or manufacturer documentation, it is recorded as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Polycaprolactone (PCL) – 210 mg/mL (fully solubilised liquid PCL). Physiologic buffer/excipients as per IFU; additional trace components not publicly disclosed. PCL is a biodegradable, biocompatible polymer used widely in aesthetic and medical applications for its ability to induce collagen production as it degrades. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1 mL pre-filled syringe of liquid PCL injectable. Longevity: Clinical sources indicate that results may be sustained for up to approximately 6–12 months following a complete treatment protocol, depending on patient factors such as age, metabolism, and skin condition. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to polycaprolactone or any component of the product. Avoid injecting into areas with active skin infection, inflammation, or compromised integrity until resolved. Do not administer intravenously or into non-target tissues. Strict aseptic technique, appropriate anatomical knowledge, and trained clinical judgement are essential to minimize risk. Follow local regulatory guidance and product instructions when administering Gouri Liquid PCL. Regulatory Status Regulatory classification for Gouri PCL varies by source and supplier; verify CE-marking, UKCA status, or other regional regulatory markings on the official Instructions for Use or product packaging prior to use. Gouri is administered into the dermal or subdermal layers with fine needles (30 G to 35 G). Professional protocols often involve multiple sessions spaced weeks apart to cumulatively stimulate collagen production across the face. 4. How long do results last after Gouri PCL treatment? Results may continue to develop over weeks following injection and are commonly reported to last up to approximately 6–12 months , depending on individual response and treatment protocol. 5. Can Gouri PCL be used with other aesthetic treatments? While professionals may integrate Gouri with other modalities (e.g., HA fillers, neuromodulators, skin boosters), it is important to space treatments appropriately and follow clinical judgment and product guidance; official IFU instructions should be consulted for safety. description: Belotero Volume with Lidocaine Dermal Filler 2×1 mL Belotero® Volume with Lidocaine is a hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler medical device formulated for deep soft-tissue augmentation, volumising, and contour enhancement . description: Teoxane Teosyal RHA 4 Teosyal® RHA 4 is a CE‑marked, resilient hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler developed by Teoxane Laboratories (Switzerland) for professional aesthetic use in deep volume restoration and correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial wrinkles and folds. RHA stands for Resilient Hyaluronic Acid , a patented HA formulation designed with a low degree of modification (MoD ~3.6‑4 %) that preserves longer HA chains and supports natural tissue movement while maintaining structural support. This gel combines 23 mg/mL cross‑linked HA with 0.3 % lidocaine for enhanced patient comfort during injection. Its rheological profile provides a combination of elasticity and strength suited for deep dermal to subcutaneous placement in areas with significant volume loss or dynamic expression, including the cheeks, chin, jawline, and other contour regions. RHA 4 integrates smoothly with tissue and adapts to facial motion over extended durations , commonly reported between 9–22 months depending on patient factors and treatment area. What Teosyal® RHA 4 Is Similar To Teosyal® RHA 4 is functionally comparable to other deep volume HA fillers such as Juvederm® Voluma and Restylane® Lyft in that all provide structural volume augmentation and deep fold correction via cross‑linked hyaluronic acid. Like these products, RHA 4 is designed for deep dermal or subcutaneous placement to restore midface volume and support facial contours. However, RHA technology’s lower degree of HA modification is intended to maintain longer polymer chains with improved dynamic resilience , allowing the gel to adapt to facial expressions and motion with fewer rigid constraints. In contrast, standard high‑modification HA gels may offer stronger lift at the cost of stiffness. Longevity for deep HA fillers generally ranges from 9–18+ months , with RHA 4 often cited toward the higher end depending on anatomical site and patient metabolism. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Regulatory classification not specified in public documentation; verify on product pack or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ 1. What is Teosyal® RHA 4? Teosyal® RHA 4 is a resilient hyaluronic acid dermal filler designed for deep volumisation and contouring of facial structures. It uses patented RHA technology with a balanced cross‑linked HA formulation to provide elasticity and strength for dynamic facial areas while supporting natural expression. It contains lidocaine for improved patient comfort during clinical injection. 2. How does the RHA technology differ from traditional HA fillers? RHA technology minimises excessive cross‑linking of HA chains, preserving longer HA polymers that are more adaptable to facial movements. This can result in a filler that integrates smoothly with tissues and maintains elasticity, compared with traditional highly cross‑linked HA gels that may prioritise lift over pliability. 3. Where can Teosyal® RHA 4 be used? It is typically used in areas requiring deep volume restoration such as cheeks, chin, jawline, and regions with moderate to severe dynamic wrinkles. Placement is generally in the deep dermis to subcutaneous plane, administered by a qualified clinician. 4. How long do results last? While individual outcomes vary, clinical and distributor information suggests visible volumising effects may persist 9–22 months after treatment, with longevity influenced by treatment area, metabolism, and lifestyle. 5. Is it safe? When used by trained professionals under aseptic technique, RHA 4 is generally well tolerated. Common, transient side effects include swelling, redness, or tenderness at injection sites. Contraindications include hypersensitivity to components and active infections.

short_description: Teosyal® PureSense Deep Lines is designed for qualified medical professionals treating established facial wrinkles and folds. The hyaluronic acid gel offers reliable dermal support, while the inclusion of lidocaine helps enhance treatment comfort. As part of the Teosyal® PureSense range, this filler is developed for predictable handling and controlled tissue integration. It is supplied in sterile, single-use syringes and intended for use only within a clinical setting. Teosyal® PureSense Deep Lines should always be administered in accordance with the official IFU and after appropriate patient assessment.
description: Teoxane Teosyal® PureSense Deep Lines Teoxane Teosyal® PureSense Deep Lines is a sterile, resorbable hyaluronic acid–based dermal filler intended for the correction of deep facial wrinkles and folds. It is formulated using non-animal stabilised hyaluronic acid and incorporates lidocaine hydrochloride to improve patient comfort during injection . The gel is designed to provide structural support within the dermis while maintaining appropriate tissue integration, making it suitable for areas requiring moderate filling capacity. The product belongs to the Teosyal® PureSense range, which combines hyaluronic acid with local anaesthetic in a single formulation. Teosyal® PureSense Deep Lines is supplied in prefilled syringes and is indicated exclusively for professional aesthetic use. Its clinical performance is influenced by product properties, injection technique, and patient-specific factors. Administration must be carried out strictly according to the manufacturer’s Instructions for Use (IFU) and relevant regulatory requirements . What Teosyal® PureSense Deep Lines Is Similar To Teosyal® PureSense Deep Lines is classified as a hyaluronic acid dermal filler intended for the correction of deeper facial lines. Within the broader Teosyal portfolio, it sits between softer fillers designed for fine lines and higher-density products formulated for volumisation. For clinical orientation, it may be compared with products such as Juvederm® Ultra 3 or Restylane® Lyft , which are also indicated for moderate to deep wrinkle correction. While these fillers share a common HA-based mechanism, differences exist in cross-linking technology, gel firmness, and tissue behaviour, which may influence handling and clinical outcomes. Teosyal® PureSense Deep Lines includes lidocaine within the formulation, whereas some alternatives rely on topical or separate anaesthesia. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. description: Sunekos® Body Mesotherapy Gel 2 × 10 mL Sunekos® Body Mesotherapy Gel is an injectable medical device formulated with hyaluronic acid and a specific amino acid complex, developed for dermal biostimulation in body areas. Manufactured by Professional Dietetics S.p.A. , this formulation is designed to support extracellular matrix regeneration and improve skin quality in areas showing laxity or textural irregularities. Unlike cross-linked body fillers that provide structural augmentation, Sunekos Body is a non-cross-linked mesotherapy gel intended for intradermal delivery. The product focuses on dermal restructuring, collagen and elastin support, and improvement of skin elasticity rather than volumetric enhancement. What Sunekos® Body Is Similar To Sunekos Body Mesotherapy Gel can be regarded alongside other biostimulation-based body mesotherapy treatments designed to improve dermal density and elasticity. Compared with traditional body contouring fillers, sunekos mesotherapy products do not create mechanical lift but instead aim to stimulate physiological tissue regeneration. In clinical practice, topics such as “sunekos body stretch marks” or “sunekos body protocol” relate to structured treatment regimens addressing dermal thinning and skin texture concerns. It differs from volumising body fillers due to its non-cross-linked composition and regenerative focus. description: EXP: Short Date 31/03/2026 Restylane® Vital Light with Lidocaine Dermal Filler 1 × 1 mL Restylane® Vital Light with Lidocaine is an injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) skin booster medical device developed by Galderma for skin hydration, elasticity improvement, and enhancement of overall skin quality . Formulated with a lower HA concentration and softer gel structure than volumising fillers, Restylane Vital Light is indicated for the treatment of early skin ageing, fine lines, and reduced skin firmness , particularly in delicate or thinner skin areas. The inclusion of lidocaine improves patient comfort during treatment. description: Ellansé® M 2 × 1 mL Dermal Filler Ellansé® M is an injectable polycaprolactone (PCL)-based dermal filler medical device developed for the correction of facial wrinkles, folds, and contour deficiencies , while also providing long-term collagen stimulation. Unlike traditional hyaluronic acid fillers, Ellanse dermal filler contains biodegradable PCL microspheres suspended in a carboxymethylcellulose (CMC) gel carrier. This formulation provides immediate volumisation followed by progressive neocollagenesis as the PCL component is gradually resorbed. Upon injection, the gel carrier delivers instant correction, while the PCL microspheres stimulate the body’s natural collagen production over time. Ellanse M represents the medium-duration option within the Ellansé range, designed for patients seeking extended longevity compared with the S version. What Ellansé® M Is Similar To Ellansé M can be regarded alongside other biostimulatory dermal fillers that combine structural volumisation with collagen stimulation. Unlike hyaluronic acid fillers, which rely solely on gel volume, Ellanse works by supporting tissue regeneration through controlled biodegradation of PCL microspheres. Compared with Ellansé S, the M version offers a longer duration profile. Due to its composition and mechanism of action, it is not interchangeable with hyaluronic acid fillers. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. description: BOTOX 200 Allergan Units is a prescription-only medicine containing botulinum toxin type A , supplied as a white powder for solution for injection. Each vial contains 200 Allergan Units of botulinum toxin type A derived from Clostridium botulinum . The active neurotoxin acts at peripheral cholinergic nerve terminals by inhibiting acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction. This temporarily reduces neuromuscular transmission and produces a reversible reduction in targeted muscle activity. The UK-authorised BOTOX formulation has multiple therapeutic indications. In aesthetic medicine, it is authorised for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines, lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet), forehead lines. BOTOX should only be administered by an appropriately qualified healthcare practitioner with expertise in the relevant indication and the required equipment. Treatment Areas / Indications For aesthetic use, the current UK SmPC identifies: Glabellar lines between the eyebrows at maximum frown. Lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet) at maximum smile. Forehead lines at maximum eyebrow elevation. Platysma prominence at maximum contraction. These aesthetic indications apply to adults where the severity has an important psychological impact. Administration Parameters Professional administration: BOTOX should only be administered by an appropriately qualified healthcare practitioner with expertise in the relevant indication and required equipment, in accordance with national guidelines. Treatment frequency: The aesthetic indications should not be treated more frequently than every 3 months . Single use: BOTOX is intended for treatment of one patient during a single session , with unused product discarded according to the product information. description: Prostrolane Inner B SE Dermal Filler 1x1ml Prostrolane Inner B SE Dermal Filler 1x1ml is an advanced injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) filler formulated for targeted soft tissue augmentation, skin hydration, and contour refinement. Designed for professional use, Inner B SE combines a smooth, cohesive HA gel with proprietary stabilisers to provide predictable tissue integration and balanced aesthetic improvement. It is often selected in aesthetic practice for fine to moderate contour correction, mild volume restoration, and skin quality enhancement in delicate or superficial regions. Prostrolane Inner B SE is part of the wider Prostrolane range — a roster of HA‑based fillers engineered for versatility across facial and body applications. Its rheological profile makes it suitable for areas requiring natural integration and minimal swelling . What Prostrolane Inner B SE Is Similar To Prostrolane Inner B SE can be regarded alongside other soft to medium HA dermal fillers that prioritise smooth tissue integration and surface contour refinement, such as Juvederm Ultra 3, Restylane Refyne, or Teosyal RHA products. These fillers are designed to improve skin hydration and mild contour correction without aggressive volumisation. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to available product documentation and clinical practice, Prostrolane Inner B SE is indicated for: Treatment areas: Fine to moderate nasolabial and perioral lines Superficial contour refinement Soft volume correction in cheeks and temples Light periocular or perioral enhancement → Inner B SE is often used where natural enhancement and a smooth transition between tissues are priorities, especially in regions with dynamic movement or delicate anatomy. Usage / Administration (IFU‑Only) Injection depth: Superficial to mid‑dermal depending on target anatomy and clinical objective. Volume per injection site: Determined by clinical assessment; typically small aliquots to avoid overcorrection. Needle gauge: Fine gauge needle recommended for precise placement in superficial and mid‑dermal planes. Frequency / number of sessions: A single treatment session may suffice; additional touch‑ups can be administered based on clinical response. Professional‑use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical or aesthetic professionals under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is missing from the official IFU, it is denoted as not provided by manufacturer . Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid sodium salt: Cross‑linked HA optimised for smooth integration into soft tissue. Physiological buffers and stabilisers consistent with the IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 ml pre‑filled sterile syringe. Shelf‑life: Refer to product packaging for expiry details. Longevity (treatment duration): Clinical experience suggests effects typically last about 6–12 months , depending on area treated, patient metabolism, and injection technique. Clinics should consult authorised channels when they buy Prostrolane Inner B SE for up‑to‑date supply and pricing information. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid or any component of the formulation. Avoid injection into areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin integrity until resolved. Do not inject intravascularly; aspiration and slow injection technique are recommended. Single‑use product; do not reuse the syringe. Practitioners must apply strict aseptic technique and possess detailed anatomical knowledge to ensure safe and effective outcomes. Regulatory Status Prostrolane Inner B SE is CE‑marked in applicable regions. Regulatory status, classification, and approved indications may vary by jurisdiction. Practitioners should verify local compliance and the official IFU via the authorised distributor. FAQ 1. What is Prostrolane Inner B SE? Prostrolane Inner B SE is a hyaluronic acid‑based dermal filler formulated for soft tissue augmentation, facial contour refinement, and correction of fine to moderate lines. It uses a smooth, cohesive HA gel for balanced tissue integration. 2. How does Prostrolane Inner B SE work in the skin? Once injected into the superficial to mid‑dermis, the HA gel attracts water molecules to improve hydration and supports subtle volume correction and contouring. Its cohesive gel matrix promotes natural integration into tissue. 3. Can Prostrolane Inner B SE be used for lips or perioral enhancement? Yes. Prostrolane Inner B SE may be used for moderate lip enhancement or refinement — particularly where a natural, soft result is desired rather than dramatic volume. Careful assessment and conservative technique are recommended. 4. How long do results from Prostrolane Inner B SE last? Results are typically visible immediately and may last 6–12 months , depending on patient factors, treated area, and injection technique. 5. What are common Prostrolane Inner B SE side effects? Common side effects are similar to other HA fillers and may include temporary swelling, redness, tenderness, or minor bruising at the injection site. These effects usually resolve within a few days. Monitoring and proper aftercare reduce the risk of persistent reactions.

short_description: Juvederm Volite Mesotherapy Skin Conditioning 2x1ml is a hyaluronic acid injectable designed to improve skin hydration, elasticity, and texture through mesotherapy-style delivery. Enhances skin quality with subtle, natural results suitable for face, neck, and perioral areas.
description: Juvederm Volite Mesotherapy Skin Conditioning 2x1ml Juvederm Volite Mesotherapy Skin Conditioning 2x1ml is an advanced injectable skin conditioning product formulated with low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid (HA) designed to improve skin hydration, elasticity, and overall skin quality . Rather than adding volume like traditional dermal fillers, Juvederm Volite acts as a mesotherapy treatment that targets the superficial and mid-dermal layers to enhance skin texture, smooth fine lines, and promote radiant skin appearance. Using Allergan’s proprietary technology, Volite delivers a gentle, hydrophilic HA gel that attracts and retains moisture within the dermis, supporting improved skin pliability and resilience. The formulation and administration protocol make it especially suitable for areas requiring delicate enhancement, such as the face, neck, décolletage, and even perioral regions (including Juvederm Volite lips) where skin conditioning and fine line improvement are desired. What Juvederm Volite Is Similar To Juvederm Volite mesotherapy is often compared to other skin conditioning and hydrating injectables such as Restylane Skinboosters and Teosyal Redensity 1, which focus on skin quality rather than volumetric augmentation. These products work by improving hydration and dermal matrix function, resulting in smoother texture and enhanced elasticity. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer and distributor documentation, Juvederm Volite is indicated for: Treatment areas: Face (cheeks, periorbital, forehead) Neck and décolletage Perioral fine lines Areas of dull or dehydrated skin → Juvederm Volite is specifically used to improve skin hydration, elasticity, surface texture, and overall appearance . It is also applied in lip area conditioning where smoothing fine perioral lines and improving tissue hydration is the goal. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Superficial to mid-dermal layers based on treatment area and desired effect. Volume per injection site: Small micro-droplet or linear threading techniques are recommended, with total volume tailored per patient assessment. Frequency / number of sessions: Standard treatment typically involves 2–3 sessions spaced 3–4 weeks apart, with maintenance treatments considered every 3–6 months. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by trained medical or aesthetic professionals under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is not specifically stated in the official IFU, it is listed as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid (HA): Non-cross-linked or lightly cross-linked HA optimised for hydration and skin condition improvement. Physiological buffers and stabilisers consistent with the IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Juvederm Volite does not aim to volumise like fillers — instead, its formulation is tailored for skin conditioning and mesotherapy applications . Presentation & Longevity Presentation: Two 1 ml pre-filled sterile syringes (total 2 ml). Shelf-life: Refer to product packaging for expiry details. Longevity (treatment duration): Improvements in skin hydration and elasticity are typically noticeable after the first treatment and continue to improve over subsequent sessions. Results may last approximately 3–6 months depending on individual skin quality, treatment area, and aftercare. Juvederm Volite price varies by region, supplier, and clinic pricing strategy. Clinics should consult authorised distributors and confirm when they buy Juvederm Volite to ensure current pricing and product authenticity. Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid or any component of the product. Avoid injection in areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin integrity. Use strict aseptic technique and appropriate small-volume administration for mesotherapy. Single-use only; do not reuse the syringe. Practitioners must possess detailed anatomical knowledge for safe and effective delivery. Regulatory Status Juvederm Volite is CE-marked as a medical device in applicable regions. Regulatory classification and approved indications may vary by jurisdiction; practitioners should always verify local compliance via the official IFU and authorised distributor documentation. FAQ 1. What is Juvederm Volite? description: Belotero Intense Dermal Filler by Merz Aesthetics 1×1 mL Belotero® Intense is an injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler medical device developed by Merz Aesthetics for the correction of deep facial wrinkles, folds, and volume loss . Formulated using Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM®) technology , Belotero Intense is designed to provide strong lifting capacity and tissue support while maintaining smooth integration within the skin. The product is indicated for areas requiring pronounced volume restoration and structural reinforcement , including deep nasolabial folds and facial contours. The gel is engineered for deep dermal to subcutaneous placement , allowing it to integrate cohesively with surrounding tissue and support natural facial movement. Unlike superficial fillers, Belotero Intense focuses on durability and projection , making it suitable for patients with more advanced signs of ageing or deeper structural deficiencies. What Belotero® Intense Is Similar To Belotero Intense can be regarded alongside other high-strength volumising hyaluronic acid dermal fillers intended for deep wrinkle correction and facial volume restoration. Within the Belotero range, it represents one of the most robust formulations, positioned above softer products designed for superficial lines or skin quality improvement. Compared to lighter fillers, Belotero Intense provides greater projection and resistance to deformation, which is why it is sometimes selected for Belotero Intense for lips in cases where enhanced structure or definition is required. However, unlike products designed specifically for fine lip contouring, Belotero Intense prioritises support and volume . This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. description: Aliaxin FL is a sterile, resorbable hyaluronic acid dermal filler manufactured by IBSA Derma and included in the Aliaxin® product line. It is classified as a temporary injectable medical device intended for soft tissue augmentation, with specific suitability for dynamic facial areas. The formulation is based on biofermentative, non-animal derived hyaluronic acid processed using proprietary IBSA technologies, resulting in a cohesive gel with controlled viscoelastic properties . Clinically, Aliaxin FL is primarily indicated for lip augmentation and contour refinement, where elasticity and tissue adaptability are essential. Its rheological profile supports volumisation while allowing natural movement, making it appropriate for areas subject to frequent muscular activity. The product is gradually biodegraded through physiological metabolic pathways and is designed for use exclusively by qualified medical professionals in accordance with the manufacturer’s Instructions for Use (IFU) . What Aliaxin FL Is Similar To Aliaxin FL belongs to the category of hyaluronic acid dermal fillers formulated specifically for lip augmentation and fine contour corrections. Products in this category are characterised by moderate elasticity, controlled cohesivity, and an emphasis on natural integration within mobile tissues. For clinical orientation, Aliaxin FL can be compared to fillers such as Stylage® Special Lips or Restylane® Kysse. Like Aliaxin FL, these products are HA-based and designed to enhance lip volume and definition while maintaining softness and flexibility. Differences between these fillers may include HA concentration, crosslinking methods, and gel rheology, which can influence handling properties, tissue response, and duration of effect. Within the Aliaxin® range, Aliaxin FL is positioned for applications requiring a balance of firmness and adaptability rather than deep structural volumisation. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Aliaxin FL is formulated to provide a balance of firmness and flexibility within the Aliaxin® range. description: Saypha Dermal Filler Volume without Lido – HA Dermal Filler without Lidocaine Saypha® Filler Volume without Lido is a class of injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler medical device formulated with a high concentration of cross-linked HA sodium salt designed to restore lost facial volume and smooth moderate to deep wrinkles and folds. The formulation uses non-animal sourced HA stabilised through advanced S.M.A.R.T. technology, which produces a smooth, visco-elastic gel suitable for facial contouring and structural support. Saypha Volume without Lido is formulated without lidocaine , making it a dermal filler without lidocaine suitable for patients sensitive to anaesthetics or where lidocaine is not indicated. It is intended for use exclusively by qualified medical professionals trained in aesthetic injectable procedures. The gel binds water in the dermal tissues to replace volume lost due to aging or facial lipoatrophy, helping to improve contours of the cheeks, chin and jawline, and to treat deeper nasolabial and marionette lines. What Saypha Filler Volume without Lido Is Similar To Saypha Filler Volume without Lido can be regarded alongside other dermal fillers without lidocaine in the hyaluronic acid category that aim to restore facial volume and correct deeper wrinkles without the addition of local anaesthetic. Like products such as Saypha Volume with Lidocaine , it uses cross-linked HA at a high concentration (~23 mg/mL) to provide structural support and longer-lasting volumetric effects — but without the lidocaine component, which some practitioners or patients may prefer to omit. In contrast to skin-booster products focused primarily on hydration and skin quality (e.g., Profhilo®), Saypha Volume without Lido emphasises volumetric augmentation and contour enhancement . It differs from lighter HA fillers (e.g., those targeting fine lines only) by utilising a more robust gel suited to medium-deep to deep dermal placement for significant contouring. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to available product data, Saypha Filler Volume without Lido is indicated for: Facial volume restoration — cheeks, chin, jawline and midface sculpting. Correction of medium to deep wrinkles and folds — nasolabial folds, marionette lines and other deeper facial creases. Contour enhancement to refine and balance facial features. Treatment areas should be determined by clinical assessment and practitioner judgment. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Deep dermis or sub-cutaneous layer, depending on target indication. Volume per injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: Supplied with 2 × 27 G × ½″ thin-wall needles. Frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals trained in facial anatomy and aseptic injection technique. If a parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is recorded as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Cross-linked hyaluronic acid (≈23 mg/mL) in a physiologic buffer. Sodium chloride and phosphate buffer. Lidocaine: Not included. Other excipients as per IFU; trace components not publicly disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1 mL pre-filled sterile syringe, supplied with 2 × 27 G × ½″ needles and traceability labels. Shelf life: Not specified in public documentation; refer to product packaging for expiry date. Longevity: Clinical experience and distributor information suggest results may last approximately 9–12 months , depending on treatment area, patient metabolism and injection technique. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the product. Avoid injection into areas with active skin infection, inflammation or compromised integrity until resolved. Do not inject intravenously or into unintended tissue layers. Strict aseptic technique and detailed anatomical knowledge are essential to reduce risks of adverse events. Regulatory Status Saypha Filler Volume without Lido is a CE-marked medical device under EU regulations. UKCA marking should be verified via the official IFU or authorised distributor documentation for the relevant market. FAQ 1. What sets Saypha Filler Volume without Lido apart from other hyaluronic acid fillers? Saypha Volume without Lido is a dermal filler without lidocaine , formulated with high-concentration cross-linked HA for volumetric augmentation and contour enhancement. Unlike fillers with lidocaine, it does not include a local anaesthetic, which some practitioners may prefer for specific protocols or patient sensitivities. 2. How does this filler work in the skin? The cross-linked HA gel integrates into the deep dermal or sub-cutaneous layers, binding water and helping to restore volume and smooth deeper wrinkles and folds. The visco-elastic properties and gel consistency support facial contours in treated regions. 3. Is lidocaine always necessary in dermal fillers? No. While lidocaine can reduce discomfort during injection, some practitioners may choose dermal fillers without lidocaine for patients with sensitivity to anaesthetics or when alternative pain mitigation strategies are used. Saypha Filler Volume without Lido provides an option for these clinical preferences. 4. Where is Saypha Volume typically injected? This product is generally injected into the deep dermis or sub-cutaneous layer of target areas such as cheeks, jawline and chin, as determined by clinical assessment and treatment goals. 5. How long do results usually persist? Visible effects are commonly reported for approximately 9–12 months , with longevity influenced by factors such as injection technique, treated area and individual metabolism.

description: NEXFILL® Volume 1 × 1 mL Dermal Filler NEXFILL® Volume is an injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler medical device developed for the correction of moderate to severe facial wrinkles, contour deficiencies, and volume loss . Formulated with cross-linked hyaluronic acid of non-animal origin, NEXFILL Volume is designed to provide structured projection, lifting capacity, and durable tissue support in mid- to deep-dermal applications. As a higher-density option within the NEXFILL filler range, this formulation offers greater volumising capability compared with lighter products intended for superficial wrinkle correction. NEXFILL dermal filler integrates within tissue to provide contour enhancement while maintaining natural facial expression. What NEXFILL® Volume Is Similar To NEXFILL Volume can be regarded alongside other high-density hyaluronic acid dermal fillers designed for deeper facial folds and structural volume restoration. Compared with softer fillers used for fine lines, NEXFILL Volume provides increased lift and projection suitable for areas requiring more pronounced correction. Within the NEXFILL range, Volume is typically positioned above lighter formulations such as Fine or Deep in terms of structural support. Due to formulation differences, it is not interchangeable with skin boosters or low-density fillers. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. description: Skinfill Body 50 mL Dermal Filler Skinfill® Body is an injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler medical device developed by Promoitalia for non-surgical body volumisation and contour enhancement . Supplied in a large-volume 50 mL format , Skinfill Body is formulated with cross-linked hyaluronic acid designed for deep dermal to subcutaneous placement , allowing correction of volume deficits and improvement of body contours across larger anatomical areas. The product is indicated for aesthetic body treatments rather than facial fine-line correction. The gel is engineered to provide high cohesiveness and structural stability , supporting even tissue integration and durable volumetric results. Unlike standard facial fillers, Skinfill Body filler is specifically designed for body applications where higher filler volumes and sustained support are required. What Skinfill® Body Is Similar To Skinfill Body can be regarded alongside other large-volume hyaluronic acid body fillers intended for non-surgical body contouring and volumisation . Products in this category are formulated to treat broader surface areas and deeper tissue planes compared with traditional facial dermal fillers. In contrast to facial Skinfill filler products that focus on wrinkle correction or subtle contouring, Skin Fill Body is optimised for body shaping and volume restoration , where structural support and longevity are prioritised. Handling characteristics and rheological properties may differ between body fillers, and products are not interchangeable. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Skinfill Body is indicated for aesthetic body treatments requiring volume restoration and contour correction. Perfect for aesthetic practitioners seeking a high-performance skin booster, Lemon Bottle delivers visible results through intradermal microinjection, leaving the skin plumper, smoother, and more radiant. With its premium formulation of ultra-pure HA, vitamins, amino acids, and peptides, Lemon Bottle is suitable for use on the face, neck, and décolleté, restoring youthful elasticity and glow in patients with dull, tired, or ageing skin. description: Lemon Bottle Skin Booster is a highly innovative and in-demand intradermal treatment developed by Dermantech Korea . It represents a new generation of skin boosters designed to restore hydration, elasticity, and overall dermal vitality without the heaviness or rigidity often associated with traditional cross-linked HA fillers. This product is formulated with non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid , blended with a complex of rejuvenating agents including amino acids, peptides, antioxidants , and vitamins . The light, bio-compatible composition allows for smoother diffusion in the dermal layers, encouraging cellular regeneration and collagen production. Its fine molecular structure makes it an ideal choice for sensitive skin areas, or for patients desiring a more natural and subtle aesthetic result. For medical aesthetic professionals, Lemon Bottle Skin Booster is a high-yield, low-downtime treatment that fits perfectly into modern clinic offerings. Each box contains six 3.5ml vials, providing ample solution for a full course or multiple smaller-area treatments. The treatment protocol typically involves a series of microinjections into the superficial dermis, delivering the active ingredients directly into the target areas for maximum effect. Its standout feature is the intense moisturising and firming effect , which can be observed even after a single session. For patients with skin fatigue, photodamage, or signs of premature ageing, Lemon Bottle helps restore a youthful glow, even tone, and improved elasticity. It is also suitable as a preventative measure for younger patients looking to maintain skin health and hydration. Additionally, Lemon Bottle can be seamlessly incorporated into combination protocols with microneedling, LED therapy, or after superficial peeling, making it versatile for clinics offering customised treatment plans. Clinical Benefits Include: Hydrates and revitalises dull, dry skin Improves fine lines and skin laxity Evens out skin tone and texture Stimulates collagen and elastin production Enhances skin brightness and firmness Minimal discomfort with no downtime From a B2B standpoint, Lemon Bottle enables aesthetic practitioners to deliver premium mesotherapy-style results with a skin booster that is both effective and cost-efficient. The growing popularity of Korean skincare science in the professional sphere further enhances patient interest and confidence in this product. This skin booster does not cause volumisation, making it ideal for patients seeking hydration and glow rather than structural augmentation. It is particularly beneficial for use in facial mesotherapy, periocular rejuvenation, neck and chest treatments, and hand revitalisation. Lemon Bottle Skin Booster is also supported by a loyal user base due to its high tolerability and consistent, glowing results—making it a must-have for practitioners who specialise in skin rejuvenation and non-surgical treatments. description: Prostrolane Blanc B is an injectable skin booster / dermal filler developed by Caregen Co., Ltd., formulated to support skin revitalisation and tone improvement. Prostrolane Blanc B is primarily positioned for professional aesthetic use where concerns include uneven skin tone, dull appearance, and early signs of photoaging. description: Nucleofill Age is a next-generation bio-stimulant treatment that targets the key signs of skin aging, offering a powerful, non-invasive solution for patients with mature skin. Designed for medical professionals in the aesthetic field, Nucleofill Age stands out due to its unique formulation of polynucleotides, natural polymers that encourage deep tissue regeneration and hydration. As the aging process begins to degrade skin elasticity, reduce hydration, and slow collagen production, Nucleofill Age intervenes by boosting fibroblast activity and restructuring the extracellular matrix. This treatment offers more than just hydration. It is specifically formulated for the advanced needs of aging skin, providing bio-stimulation to enhance the skin’s natural healing and repair mechanisms. What is Nucleofill? It is a skin rejuvenation treatment that doesn’t rely on adding volume but instead focuses on enhancing the skin’s ability to regenerate itself naturally. Unlike fillers that focus on plumping up specific areas, Nucleofill Age works across the entire treatment area to restore skin vitality and resilience. The bio-active polynucleotides penetrate deeply into the skin, improving dermal quality by stimulating collagen and elastin production. The result is firmer, more elastic skin with improved texture and tone. Is Nucleofill a filler? No, Nucleofill Age is not a traditional filler. It is a bio-stimulant that enhances the skin’s natural regenerative processes rather than adding artificial volume. It is an ideal option for patients seeking a natural, youthful appearance without the use of fillers. The polynucleotides in Nucleofill Age trigger the skin’s repair system, making it a more natural option for anti-aging treatments. For aesthetic practitioners, Nucleofill Age is an essential part of their portfolio, offering a safe, effective, and long-lasting solution for aging skin. The effects of this skin booster can last for up to 6 months, with patients often reporting improved skin elasticity, fewer wrinkles, and a more hydrated complexion. As it works deep within the skin, it not only improves surface appearance but also addresses the underlying causes of aging skin, making it a comprehensive solution for skin renewal. Additionally, Nucleofill Age has a high safety profile due to its biocompatible ingredients, making it suitable for a wide range of patients, including those with sensitive skin. Its application is versatile, making it ideal for areas that show visible signs of aging, such as the face, neck, and hands. The treatment can be customized according to the patient’s specific needs, whether they are looking to improve elasticity, reduce fine lines, or enhance overall skin quality. jsonld.name: Bocouture 50 units (POM) STANDARD DELIVERY ONLY
jsonld.description:
1 x vial of 50 units of Merz botulinum toxin

Bocouture is a prescription only medicine manufactured by Merz and is a non-fridge line toxin. It works by blocking the nerve impulses in all injected muscles. This prevents muscles from contracting leading to temporary and reversible relaxation. It is made up of Botulinum toxin type A, free from complexing proteins, and each vial contains powder for injection.

Bocouture is indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of upper facial lines in adults below 65 years when the severity of these lines has an important psychological impact for the patient.

Store at room temperature

AMI eyes 2ml
AMI EYES is an advanced tissue stimulator, designed for needle mesotherapy of the eye area and the tear valley with a filling effect, without side effects in the form of lumps or lymphatic stagnation. When applied to the skin, it stimulates it to produce more collagen and elastin. As a result, the structure and appearance of the dermis is significantly improved. In addition, the product supports skin regeneration from the inside.
The secret of this rejuvenating treatment is that AMI Eyes contains Polynucleotide (PDRN) which is safe for human use and has no adverse effects. Instead, it revitalises, energises and moisturises the skin. In fact, it also has a skin lightening effect.
Polynucleotide (PDRN) is obtained by purifying the DNA of salmon family fish. PDRN is a low molecular weight complex that affects the repair of cells and damaged tissues, and homeostasis from within. The mechanism of action of the substance is based on stimulating the active synthesis of collagen, which helps to rebuild DNA chains and increase the production of its own elastin.
 
The package contains:


one pre-filled syringe with a capacity of 2 ml

Product for professional use only.By deciding to purchase, you declare that you are a doctor or cosmetologist trained in aesthetic medicine.

BELOTERO Balance - 1 x 1ml
Hyaluronic Acid Dermal Filler for Fine Lines, Wrinkle Correction & Natural Facial Rejuvenation
 
What is BELOTERO Balance?
BELOTERO Balance is a professional hyaluronic acid dermal filler developed for smoothing fine lines, correcting moderate wrinkles and enhancing facial rejuvenation treatments. The filler uses CPM® technology to create a smooth injectable gel that distributes evenly within the skin for soft and natural integration.
 
Unlike heavier dermal fillers designed for deep structural support, BELOTERO Balance is formulated specifically for delicate treatment areas and superficial wrinkle correction, making it highly suitable for precision aesthetic treatments.
 
Widely used across UK aesthetic clinics, BELOTERO Balance is trusted for subtle wrinkle correction and refined facial rejuvenation while preserving natural expression.
 
Its lightweight gel formulation allows seamless integration into the skin for smooth, natural-looking results.
 
Key Benefits 

Advanced hyaluronic acid dermal filler
Smooth integration into the skin
Designed for fine lines and moderate wrinkle correction
Supports natural facial movement and expression
Ideal for delicate facial treatment areas
Lightweight injectable gel formulation
Helps soften smile lines and superficial wrinkles
Suitable for subtle lip enhancement treatments
Professional-grade injectable filler
Minimal downtime treatment option
Natural-looking facial rejuvenation results


 
Treatment Areas
BELOTERO Balance is commonly used for professional aesthetic treatments across multiple facial areas, including:

Nasolabial folds
Perioral lines
Lip border definition
Smile lines
Marionette lines
Tear trough area
Fine facial wrinkles
Superficial facial lines

 
Composition

Cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid (HA)
Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM®) technology
Sterile injectable gel formulation
Lidocaine-free formulation

 
Frequently Asked Questions
What is BELOTERO Balance used for?
BELOTERO Balance is used for fine line correction, wrinkle smoothing, facial rejuvenation, and subtle contour enhancement treatments.
 
Is BELOTERO Balance good for fine lines?
Yes. BELOTERO Balance is specifically designed for superficial and moderate facial lines, making it ideal for delicate wrinkle correction treatments.
 
Does BELOTERO Balance look natural?
Yes. BELOTERO Balance is known for its smooth skin integration and natural-looking results without creating a heavy or overfilled appearance.
 
How long does BELOTERO Balance last?
Results typically last approximately 6–12 months depending on the treatment area, metabolism, and injection technique.
 
Is there downtime after treatment?
Patients may experience temporary redness, swelling, bruising, or tenderness following treatment. Downtime is generally minimal.

Dr.CYJ Hair Filler - 2 x 1ml
Dr. CYJ Hair Filler is an advanced peptide-based injectable treatment designed to revitalize the scalp, strengthen hair follicles, and improve hair thickness.
Dr.CYJ Hair Filler is a cutting-edge hair revitalisation treatment formulated with seven unique peptides to promote scalp health and support hair growth. This innovative injectable solution is designed to enhance blood circulation in the scalp, helping to nourish and strengthen hair follicles while improving overall hair quality. It is widely used to assist in addressing concerns such as hair thinning, weakened follicles, and scalp revitalization.
Dr.CYJ Hair Filler works by delivering a peptide-hyaluronic acid formula directly into the dermis layer of the scalp, supporting hair follicle health and scalp regeneration. By increasing follicle size and optimizing scalp integration, this treatment helps create an optimal environment for hair revitalization.
Developed over thirteen years of research by Caregen, Dr.CYJ Hair Filler is a CE-marked (CE 2265) Class III medical device that meets European regulatory standards. Results may vary, with improvements in hair thickness and vitality typically observed within a few months.
Key Benefits

Supports scalp revitalization and strengthens hair follicles
Helps improve hair thickness and quality
Promotes blood circulation for a healthier scalp
Contains seven peptides to optimize skin and follicle integration
Developed through extensive research and holds CE certification

jsonld.description:
Fillmed NCTF 135 - 5 x 3ml
Advanced Polyrevitalising Skin Booster for Hydration, Skin Rejuvenation & Anti-Ageing Treatments
 
What is Fillmed NCTF?
Fillmed NCTF 135 HA is an advanced injectable skin revitalisation treatment designed to improve skin hydration, radiance, elasticity and overall skin quality. Developed by Fillmed Laboratories, this professional-grade mesotherapy solution combines hyaluronic acid with a powerful complex of vitamins, amino acids, minerals, coenzymes and antioxidants to support comprehensive skin rejuvenation and anti-ageing treatments.
 
Fillmed NCTF 135 HA is widely used across UK aesthetic clinics for treating dull, dehydrated, ageing and tired-looking skin while helping improve skin texture and luminosity with minimal downtime.
 
Unlike traditional dermal fillers designed to add volume, Fillmed NCTF 135 HA focuses on improving overall skin quality, hydration and revitalisation at the cellular level for healthier, brighter and smoother-looking skin.
 
Key Benefits

Advanced injectable skin revitalisation treatment
Deeply hydrates and revitalises the skin
Helps improve skin texture and elasticity
Supports collagen stimulation and skin regeneration
Contains hyaluronic acid plus 50+ active ingredients
Helps reduce the appearance of fine lines
Improves dull and tired-looking skin
Supports brighter and smoother skin appearance
Popular for preventative anti-ageing treatments
Professional-grade mesotherapy solution
Suitable for face, neck, décolletage and hands
Minimal downtime treatment option

 
Treatment Areas
Fillmed NCTF 135 HA is commonly used for professional skin rejuvenation treatments across multiple areas, including:

Face
Neck
Décolletage
Hands
Under-eye area
Cheeks
Forehead
Jawline
Perioral area

 
Composition

Non-cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid (5mg/ml)
12 Vitamins
23 Amino Acids
6 Minerals
6 Coenzymes
5 Nucleic Acid Bases
Antioxidants
Sterile injectable solution

 
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Fillmed NCTF 135 HA used for?
Fillmed NCTF 135 HA is used for skin rejuvenation, hydration, anti-ageing treatments and improving overall skin quality and radiance.
Is Fillmed NCTF 135 HA a skin booster?
Yes. Fillmed NCTF 135 HA is an injectable skin booster and mesotherapy treatment designed to deeply hydrate and revitalise the skin.
What areas can Fillmed NCTF 135 HA treat?
Common treatment areas include the face, neck, décolletage, hands and under-eye area.
Does Fillmed NCTF 135 HA stimulate collagen?
Yes. The hyaluronic acid and polyrevitalising ingredients help support collagen production and fibroblast activity.
How many Fillmed NCTF treatments are recommended?
Many practitioners recommend an initial course of treatments followed by maintenance sessions depending on skin condition and treatment goals.
Is there downtime after treatment?
Patients may experience temporary redness, swelling, tenderness or mild bruising following treatment. Downtime is generally minimal.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

jsonld.name: Gouri Skin Booster
jsonld.description:
GOURI is the 1st liquid type PCL injectable. GOURI rejuvenates our skin through the collagenesis on the entire face.
These features make GOURI a fundamental anti-aging product:

Spreadability: GOURI naturally spreads and regenerates collagen on the entire face.
Easy to Use: GOURI needs only 10 injection points for the entire face
Natural & Sustainable Improvements: GOURI restores the collagen synthesis rate which has decreased due to skin ageing and rejuvenates the skin, making it younger and healthier.

Unlike fillers, GOURI has no microparticles. Microparticle-free composition allows GOURI to be solubilized homogenously in the water, yielding a smoother extrusion force that is acceptable for use of 30G – 35G needles as necessary for injection.
GOURI is injected uniformly into dermal or subdermal layer. GOURI, as a biodegradable polymer, degrades naturally due to hydrolysis. Compared to hyaluronic acid, it has a longer cosmetic performance.
For the best results, three sessions are recommended at 4 week intervals. After the 3 sessions, apply additional 1~2 treatments at 3-6 month interval, depending on patient’s condition.
