Jalupro is a sterile re-absorbable injectable solution which acts – as dermal biorevitaliser which can be used for improving skin texture and minimizing evidence of skin wrinkles of the face; – as adjuvant in the physical or chemicals treatments such as peeling, laser therapy, dermabrasion, radiofrequency, dermal filler, botulinum toxin, etc.
Benefits of Jalupro:

Can fix scars
Areas: Face, neck, décolleté, underarms, hands, inner thighs, abdomen, knee region

How long does the result last for?
Results are instant from the first treatment. In general, results last up to 6 months.
 
 
Jalupro® is a professional mesotherapy product for bio revitalisation. Using a combination of sodium hyaluronate (a salt of hyaluronic acid) of inorganic origin and a rich complex of important amino acids, it gradually reduces the appearance of wrinkles, hydrates the skin, and improves its smoothness and appearance in general.
JALUPRO is composed of two small bottles each one containing lyophilised Amino Acids and two vials, each one including Sodium Hyaluronate which must be mixed together with Amino Acids.
This is a sterile, resorbable, injectable solution that acts as a dermal bio revitaliser. It can be used for improving skin texture and minimising evidence of skin wrinkles in the face. Jalupro Amino Acid can be used as an additional step in physical or chemical treatments such as peeling, laser therapy, dermabrasion, radiofrequency and dermal filler. Use Jalupro for photo-aging and anti-aging of the face and body (light and medium degree), stretch marks, preparation, improvement, and prolongation of results for different aesthetic procedures and for pre and post-surgery.

Advanced Skin Booster for Deep Hydration, Collagen Stimulation & Skin Rejuvenation
 
What is Jalupro Super Hydro
Jalupro Super Hydro is a professional bio-revitalising skin booster formulated with high and low molecular weight hyaluronic acid, amino acids and peptides to deliver intensive hydration and advanced skin rejuvenation.
 
The treatment is specifically designed to improve skin laxity, dehydration, fine lines, dullness and loss of elasticity while helping stimulate natural collagen and elastin production.

Lumi Eyes - 1 x 1ml
Lumi Eyes is a specialised tissue stimulator designed for mesotherapy treatments around the eyes and tear trough area. This product contains polynucleotides, which support tissue regeneration and hydration, helping to improve the overall appearance of the skin.
Formulated with high-quality ingredients, Lumi Eyes works to repair damage to the dermis, offering deep hydration and rejuvenation. It is designed to improve the appearance of dark circles, fine lines, and signs of fatigue. By stimulating collagen and elastin production, this treatment can contribute to a refreshed and revitalised look.
The key ingredient in this skin booster, polynucleotide is known for its ability to support cell regeneration and hydration while promoting a smoother, more even skin texture. PDRN, or Polydeoxyribonucleotide, is a natural compound derived from DNA fragments, often from salmon sperm, known for its regenerative and anti-inflammatory properties. Lumi Eyes also contains glutathione, which provides antioxidant benefits and helps to enhance skin quality.
Lumi Eyes is designed for a gradual, natural-looking improvement. To achieve optimal results, a series of treatments is recommended at four-week intervals. Regular use can support long-term skin health and help to maintain a refreshed, well-rested appearance.
Key Benefits

Targets dark circles and signs of fatigue
Hydrates and revitalises the skin
Supports collagen and elastin production
Aims to improve skin firmness and elasticity
Designed to reduce the appearance of fine lines

Product Details

Needle Size: 32G x 4mm


Lumi Eyes offers an advanced approach to under-eye rejuvenation, supporting a refreshed and well-rested appearance over time. Regular treatments can help to maintain skin hydration and reduce common concerns associated with ageing and fatigue.

jsonld.description:
Sculptra Poly-L-Lactic Acid – 2 x 5ml vials
 
Advanced Collagen-Stimulating Injectable for Facial Volume Restoration & Long-Lasting Skin Rejuvenation
 
What is Sculptra Poly-L-Lactic Acid?
Sculptra Poly-L-Lactic Acid is an advanced professional collagen biostimulator developed to restore facial volume, improve skin structure and support long-term collagen regeneration. Designed specifically for professional injectable aesthetic treatments, this high-performance collagen-stimulating injectable helps address age-related volume loss, facial hollowing, skin laxity and overall facial rejuvenation.
 
Its advanced formulation contains Poly-L-Lactic Acid (PLLA), a clinically recognised collagen stimulator that works deep within the skin to gradually stimulate collagen production while supporting natural-looking volume restoration and improved facial contour definition.
 
Widely used by aesthetic practitioners across the UK, Sculptra is suitable for professional collagen stimulation treatments targeting facial ageing, structural volume loss, skin firmness concerns and advanced facial rejuvenation protocols.
 
The sterile injectable formulation allows precise professional administration while helping support progressive collagen synthesis, improved facial support and long-lasting rejuvenation.
 
Unlike traditional dermal fillers, Sculptra works by stimulating the body’s natural collagen production process to gradually improve skin structure and restore youthful facial contours over time.
 
Key Benefits:

Professional collagen-stimulating injectable treatment
Helps restore lost facial volume
Supports natural collagen regeneration
Promotes gradual, natural-looking enhancement
Helps improve skin firmness and elasticity
Supports long-lasting facial rejuvenation
Helps improve facial contour definition
Professional-grade PLLA injectable
Suitable for multiple facial treatment areas


 
Treatment Areas:
Sculptra Poly-L-Lactic Acid is designed for professional injectable collagen stimulation treatments across multiple facial areas, including:

Cheeks
Temples
Jawline
Chin
Nasolabial folds
Marionette lines
Mid-face volume restoration
Facial hollowing correction
Lower face contouring
Overall facial rejuvenation


 
Composition:

150mg Poly-L-lactic acid
90mg Sodium carboxymethylcellulose
127.5mg Non-pyrogenic mannitol

 
FAQs:
What is Sculptra Poly-L-Lactic Acid used for?
Sculptra is used for professional collagen stimulation treatments designed to restore facial volume, improve skin structure and support long-term facial rejuvenation.
Is Sculptra suitable for facial rejuvenation treatments?
Yes. Sculptra is specifically formulated for professional facial rejuvenation treatments focused on collagen stimulation and volume restoration.
 
Does Sculptra help with facial volume loss?
Yes. Sculptra helps stimulate collagen production to improve visible facial hollowing, age-related volume loss and contour definition.
 
How long do Sculptra results last?
Results can last up to two years or longer depending on treatment protocol, patient response and practitioner technique.

Sunekos Performa Dermal Filler - 2 x 3.5ml
Sunekos Performa is an injectable dermal filler designed to correct skin imperfections by restoring elasticity and enhancing volume in areas affected by wrinkles and scars.
Sunekos Performa is a sterile, re-absorbable injectable solution recommended for treating blemishes and depressions in the skin caused by wrinkles and scars. It supports the restoration of physiological elasticity by temporarily replacing lost volume in soft tissues.
Ideal for use in conjunction with physical or chemical treatments such as peeling, laser therapy, and dermabrasion, Sunekos Performa is formulated to correct mild to moderate skin imperfections. By supplementing the intracellular matrix, it helps to normalize the appearance of anatomically depressed skin.
The solution is administered using a sterile syringe with a needle size selected by the practitioner based on the treatment area. This product is supplied as a pack containing two 3.5ml vials, offering a comprehensive approach to skin rejuvenation.
Key Benefits

Corrects skin imperfections and depressions
Restores physiological elasticity and supports volume restoration
Compatible with complementary treatments such as peeling, laser therapy, and dermabrasion
Provides a minimally invasive solution for skin rejuvenation
Designed to enhance the overall appearance of the skin

Contains: 2 x 3.5ml vials

Formulation: Re-absorbable injectable filler

For use on: Areas with wrinkles, scars, and skin depressions

Application: Administered via sterile syringe; needle size as per practitioner’s discretion

Recommended use: Can be used with peeling, laser therapy, and dermabrasion

Teosyal Puresense Kiss with Lidocaine - 2 x 1ml
Teosyal Puresense Kiss is a hyaluronic acid-based filler designed to enhance lip volume and shape, with added Lidocaine for improved comfort during treatment.
Teosyal Puresense Kiss is a Swiss-manufactured premium dermal filler formulated specifically for lip augmentation. Its hyaluronic acid composition offers excellent hydration and elasticity, helping to create fuller, more defined lips. The addition of 0.3% Lidocaine aims to reduce discomfort, making the injection process more tolerable.
Thanks to the 27G needle design, the Teosyal Puresense Kiss lip filler requires less injection force, facilitating precise application. The double bevel, lubricated needle helps ensure smooth penetration, supporting accurate shaping of the lips while minimizing patient discomfort.
Results may last between 9 to 12 months, depending on factors such as age, lifestyle, and individual skin characteristics. This dermal filler can also help diminish mouth wrinkles and refine lip contours, contributing to a refreshed and youthful appearance.
Check out the entire Teosyal collection, including Teosyal Puresense and Teosyal RHA products.
Key Benefits

Enhances lip volume and contour
Contains 0.3% Lidocaine to improve comfort
27G needle requires less injection force
May reduce mouth wrinkles for a smoother look
Typically offers results lasting 9–12 months

Product Details


Brand: Teosyal

Product: Teosyal Puresense Kiss

Contains: 1 x pre-filled syringe

Key Ingredients: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid, 0.3% Lidocaine

Needle: 27G needle for precise application

For use on: Lips (volume, shape) and perioral wrinkles

Duration: Results typically last 9–12 months

This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

jsonld.name: Teosyal Puresense Redensity 1 (1 x 3ml)
jsonld.description:
Teosyal Puresense Redensity 1 dermal filler is the first of two Redensity formulas from Teoxane, delivering patented Teosyal hyaluronic acid to contoured parts of the face. In particular, the pair of pre-filled 1.0 ml syringes offer enough capacity to restore contours and fullness to parts of the face where the natural plumpness of hyaluronic acid may have diminished over the years. This dermal redensification helps to fill out loose or sagging skin and eliminate wrinkles whilst producing a soft, natural finish that does not appear excessively taut.
Use Teosyal Puresense Redensity 1 on the cheeks and jawline to return a more naturally curved appearance to aged faces, restoring the curves and contours associated with a younger individual. This product has been specifically designed to redensify and deeply rehydrate your face, neck and neckline.
Teosyal products are made according to a Teoxane Laboratories patent, and closely mimic natural human hyaluronic acid found in the face, allowing them to produce a uniquely soft, flexible and authentic-looking finished effect.
 
Teosyal Puresense Redensity 1 Treatment Areas:
Teosyal Puresense Redensity 1 has been designed to moisturise the skin and correct wrinkles in the following areas:

Neckline
Neck
Face

jsonld.name: Teosyal PureSense Redensity II
jsonld.description:
Teosyal PureSense Redensity II is an advanced gel designed to treat the delicate and sensitive eye area. The product has a subtle mix of non cross-linked and cross-linked hyaluronic acid that is specifically indicated for under-eye circles and hollow eye-circles. The ingredients in Teosyal PureSense Redensity II helps to regenerate and restructure skin cells, while it protects the cells from oxidation. This improves the quality of the skin and provides a natural and long-lasting correction of tired looking eyes.
Please be aware that the product cannot be used to treat sunken under-eye circles and malar bags.


Benefits of Teosyal PureSense Redensity II:

Areas: the delicate and sensitive eye area
Treat under-eye circles and hollow eye-circles
Also designed for tear trough treatment

How long does the result last for?
In general, results can last up to 9-12 months. The duration depends on the individual's lifestyle, age and skin type.
THE ORIGIN OF THIS PRODUCT IS FROM THE EUROPEAN COMMUNITY (EC)

jsonld.description:
Teosyal RHA 1 is a dermal filler and the first of four RHA formulas by Teoxane Laboratories, and is suitable for a number of minor to moderate signs of ageing on the face. These include circles below the eyes, fine wrinkles on the upper and lower eyelids and adjacent areas, and light neck imperfections.

Using a patented formula, RHA 1 restores the hyaluronic acid levels in these areas using a compound that closely resembles that naturally found in the face. It offers soft, flexible support to the skin, for a smoothing effect that delivers firmness without hardness or excessive tautening of the skin surface.
Teosyal RHA 1 is supplied in two 1.0 ml syringes for immediate application to the precise position and depth required, and versatile choice over how much product is delivered into the face.
Teosyal RHA 1 (2 x 1ml)
How long will the effect last for?
Effects are long-lasting with the skin’s elasticity significantly improved. On average, the effect can last for months.
What are the Benefits of Teosyal RHA 1?
Teosyal RHA 1  dermal filler is recommended for:

Treating the delicate eye area’s dark circles
Minimising fine lines and wrinkles as they first start to appear on the face, neck and décolleté area
Improving skin hydration

jsonld.description:
Restylane Defyne - 1 x 1ml
Advanced Hyaluronic Acid Dermal Filler for Deep Wrinkle Correction, Facial Contouring & Natural Facial Movement
 
What is Restylane Defyne?
Restylane Defyne is an advanced hyaluronic acid dermal filler designed to correct deep facial wrinkles, restore lost facial volume and enhance natural facial contours while maintaining dynamic facial movement. Developed using Restylane’s proprietary XpresHAn Technology™, Restylane Defyne delivers flexible support and smooth tissue integration for natural-looking facial rejuvenation results.
 
Widely used across UK aesthetic clinics, Restylane Defyne is a trusted injectable treatment for addressing moderate to severe facial folds while preserving natural facial expression.
 
Its advanced gel formulation allows the filler to adapt naturally to facial movement while providing structural support and long-lasting contour enhancement.
 
Unlike more rigid dermal fillers, Restylane Defyne is specifically designed for expressive facial areas requiring both flexibility and support.
 
Key Benefits:

Advanced hyaluronic acid dermal filler
Designed for moderate to severe facial wrinkles and folds
XpresHAn Technology™ supports natural facial movement
Helps restore facial structure and contour
Ideal for nasolabial folds and marionette lines
Supports natural-looking facial rejuvenation
Smooth gel integration into facial tissues
Flexible filler designed for expressive facial areas
Contains lidocaine for improved injection comfort
Professional-grade injectable filler
Long-lasting facial contouring results
Minimal downtime treatment option
Popular for non-surgical anti-ageing treatments

 
Treatment Areas
Restylane Defyne is commonly used for professional aesthetic treatments across multiple facial areas, including:

Nasolabial folds
Marionette lines
Chin
Jawline
Oral commissures
Lower-face contouring
Mid-to-deep dermal correction areas
Facial volume restoration zones

 
Composition:

Cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid (20mg/ml)
Lidocaine Hydrochloride 0.3%
Phosphate buffered saline
XpresHAn Technology™ gel formulation
Sterile injectable gel

 
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Restylane DEFYNE used for?
Restylane Defyne is used for correcting deep facial wrinkles and folds, restoring facial volume and enhancing facial contours.
Is Restylane DEFYNE good for nasolabial folds?
Yes. Restylane Defyne is particularly popular for treating deep nasolabial folds and marionette lines.
What is XpresHAn Technology™?
XpresHAn Technology™ allows the filler to move naturally with facial expressions while maintaining structural support and flexibility.
Does Restylane DEFYNE contain lidocaine?
Yes. Restylane Defyne contains 0.3% lidocaine to improve patient comfort during treatment.
What areas can Restylane DEFYNE treat?
Common treatment areas include nasolabial folds, marionette lines, chin, jawline and lower-face contouring areas.
How long does Restylane DEFYNE last?
Results typically last between 6–12 months depending on individual metabolism, lifestyle, treatment area and injection technique.
Does Restylane DEFYNE look natural?
Yes. Restylane Defyne is specifically formulated to maintain natural facial movement and expression while providing contour enhancement and wrinkle correction.
Is there downtime after treatment?
Patients may experience temporary swelling, redness, bruising or tenderness following injection. Downtime is generally minimal.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

Advanced Under-Eye Skin Booster for Hydration, Fine Lines & Eye Rejuvenation
 
What is Jalupro Young Eye?
Jalupro Young Eye is an advanced injectable skin booster specifically formulated for professional under-eye rejuvenation treatments. Developed with a unique combination of hyaluronic acid and amino acids, this professional eye treatment helps improve hydration, skin texture and elasticity in the delicate periocular area.
 
Designed for professional aesthetic use, Jalupro Young Eye helps reduce the appearance of tired-looking eyes, fine lines, dark circles and puffiness while supporting natural collagen production and skin regeneration.
 
Its lightweight injectable formulation integrates smoothly into the under-eye tissue, helping restore skin firmness and improve overall eye-area brightness for a refreshed and revitalised appearance.
 
Widely used by aesthetic practitioners across the UK, Jalupro Young Eye is suitable for professional under-eye rejuvenation and skin revitalisation treatment protocols.

Lightweight injectable formulation
Supports brighter and smoother-looking under-eyes
Professional-grade aesthetic treatment

Minimal downtime procedure


 
Treatment Areas

Under-eye area
Tear trough region
Crow’s feet area
Fine periocular lines
Delicate eye contour skin

 
Why Choose Jalupro Young Eye?
Jalupro Young Eye is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional injectable treatment specifically designed for under-eye rejuvenation and hydration. The treatment is ideal for patients seeking refreshed-looking eyes, improved skin quality and smoother under-eye texture through professional aesthetic protocols.
 
Composition

Hyaluronic Acid
Amino Acid Complex

 
FAQs
What is Jalupro Young Eye used for?
Jalupro Young Eye is used for professional under-eye rejuvenation treatments designed to improve hydration, fine lines, skin texture and tired-looking eyes.
 
Does Jalupro Young Eye stimulate collagen?
Yes. The amino acid complex helps support collagen synthesis and natural skin regeneration.
 
Is there downtime after treatment?
Patients may experience temporary redness, swelling or mild bruising following treatment. Downtime is generally minimal.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

iLLUMA PN Booster improves aging skin by strengthening the skin barrier. It is a skin booster that provides moisture to the epidermis and dermis and has and excellent effect on repairing thin and damaged skin.
The unique and patented stabilisation technique ensures that the natural cross-linked and entangles HA network is kept in place by introducing a limited number of synthetic cross-links i.e minimal modification.
Peptide ingredients and HA make the skin elastic and healthy. iLLUMA makes your skin bright and radiant.

PN Polynucleotides
Peptide
Hyaluronic Acid

FEATURES

Skin repair & hydration
Facial wrinkle removal
Strengthening of barrier properties and of local immunity of the cells
Reduction of pigmentation
Stimulation of collagen and elastin synthesis

TREATMENT INTERVAL

1 treatment per month, 1-3 sessions in total

NEEDLES I30G 13mm

jsonld.description:
Nucleofill 25 (Strong) is a  bio stimulant gel based on natural polynucleotides and high viscosity for skin rejuvenation and protection. As an anti-ageing treatment. Nucleofill is designed to improve skin elasticity and tightness as well as aid in the prevention of wrinkles. Nucleofill 25 is the new line of natural polynucleotide-based bio stimulating gels, with a high viscosity, for protecting and rejuvenating the skin. It’s recommended to have 2 treatments with 2-4 weeks in between each session, in severe cases you can have up to 4 treatments with 2-4 weeks intervals.
The product contains high molecular weight polynucleotide chains whose biochemical peculiarities make it highly viscoelastic and capable of binding and orient in space a considerable amount of water molecules, which are primarily retained in the hydrophilic groups level of phosphorylated sugars of the individual nucleotides.
The strong moisturising ability is mainly due to the water retention capabilities of the hydrophilic groups of the phosphorylated sugars of the single nucleotides. An “electrostatic sponge” able to guarantee cellular well-being by conferring deep hydration to tissues.
Free radical scavenger effect – The polymeric macromolecules are able to also play an immediate “scavenger” action against free radicals. This effect of this polynucleotide gel is possible thanks to the chemical structure capable of blocking free radicals in the nitrogenous ring. Moreover, the progressive degradation of polynucleotide molecules by enzymes present in the extracellular environment, free metabolites which, in turn, accentuate the protection activity against free radicals.
The biostimulating effect is given both by the presence of nucleoside structures capable of activating cell membrane receptors, and by metabolites that are produced by the enzymatic attack during the degradation process. A slow and continuous effect.
By promoting the metabolic activity of the fibroblastic cells, polynucleotides collaborate to reintegrate into the dermis various fundamental autologous components (glucoseaminoglycans, proteins, glycoproteins, fibrils, etc.) tending to maintain their physiological functionality. Their repeated administration over time, determines:– a protracted isosmotic hydration of the dermal matrix– an anti-radical actionBoth of these effects combine to recreate in the dermal matrix the most favourable physiological conditions for the regeneration and metabolic activity of fibroblasts, with long-lasting biorevitalising effects.
Polynucleotides activate two types of membrane receptors in fibroblasts, or rather Receptor CD39 and Receptor CD40. The activation of these receptors lead to two effects: stimulation of type I collagen production, saturation of fibroblasts in myofibroblasts
Contains:25mg/ml of polynucleotides
The synergy of 4 types of stimulation:– Skin regeneration– Cleansing effect on the cells by increasing circulation and removing  free radicals– Deep moisturising effect– Firming and contouring
Indications:– Loose skin with poor circulation– Dehydrated skin– Skin submitted to oxidative stress– Stretch marks– Scars– For those who want firming and contouring, more definition– Bio-stimulation and increase in collagen type 1.

jsonld.description:
Nucleofill 20 Medium – 1 x 1.5ml
 
Advanced Polynucleotide Skin Booster for Hydration, Skin Regeneration & Early Anti-Ageing Treatments
 
What is Nucleofill 20 Medium?
Nucleofill 20 Medium is an advanced injectable polynucleotide skin booster developed to improve skin hydration, elasticity and overall skin quality while supporting natural tissue regeneration. Formulated with highly purified sodium DNA polynucleotides, Nucleofill 20 Medium is specifically designed for younger skin and early anti-ageing treatments.

This professional bio-stimulation treatment works within the dermis to support fibroblast activity, improve skin firmness and help reduce the appearance of fine lines, mild to moderate wrinkles and skin laxity. Its regenerative action helps restore healthier-looking skin while maintaining natural facial features and expression.

Unlike traditional dermal fillers that add volume, Nucleofill 20 Medium focuses on skin quality improvement, hydration and tissue regeneration. The treatment is commonly used as part of mesotherapy and skin rejuvenation protocols for patients seeking smoother, firmer and more radiant skin.

Its antioxidant properties help protect the skin against oxidative stress and free radical damage while supporting collagen production and cellular renewal.
 
Key Benefits

Advanced polynucleotide skin booster treatment
Deeply hydrates dry and dehydrated skin
Helps improve skin elasticity and firmness
Supports collagen stimulation and tissue regeneration
Helps reduce fine lines and mild to moderate wrinkles
Supports improvement of stretch marks and superficial scars
Provides antioxidant protection against free radical damage
Suitable for face and body skin rejuvenation
Professional-grade injectable bio-stimulation treatment
Compatible with mesotherapy treatment protocols
Natural-looking skin rejuvenation results
Minimal downtime treatment option

 
Treatment Areas
Nucleofill 20 Medium is designed for professional injectable skin rejuvenation treatments across multiple areas, including:

Face
Neck
Décolletage
Hands
Cheeks
Perioral area
Abdomen
Thighs
Buttocks
Stretch mark-prone areas
Mild scar correction areas
Skin laxity treatment zones

 
Why Buy Nucleofill 20 Medium?
Nucleofill 20 Medium is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional polynucleotide treatment designed to improve hydration, skin elasticity and early signs of ageing. Its sodium DNA formulation helps support natural skin regeneration while improving overall skin quality, firmness and radiance without adding volume.
 
Composition:

Sodium DNA (Polynucleotides) 2%
Aqua
Sodium Chloride
Sterile injectable gel formulation
1 x 1.5ml pre-filled syringe

 
FAQs
What is Nucleofill 20 Medium used for?
Nucleofill 20 Medium is used for professional skin rejuvenation treatments designed to improve hydration, skin elasticity, fine lines and overall skin quality.

Is Nucleofill 20 Medium a dermal filler?
No. Nucleofill 20 Medium is not a traditional dermal filler. It is a polynucleotide skin booster designed to regenerate and revitalise the skin rather than add volume.

Does Nucleofill 20 Medium stimulate collagen?
Yes. Nucleofill 20 Medium helps stimulate fibroblast activity, supporting collagen production and natural tissue regeneration.

Is Nucleofill 20 Medium suitable for younger patients?
Yes. Nucleofill 20 Medium is specifically developed for younger skin and early anti-ageing treatments where hydration, prevention and skin quality improvement are the primary goals.

Does Nucleofill 20 Medium add volume?
No. Nucleofill 20 Medium is intended for skin regeneration and hydration and is not designed for volumisation or facial contouring.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

jsonld.name: Medisco Peelieve Skin Peel kit
jsonld.description:
Medisco Peelieve Skin Peel is an effective solution for renewing skin. Its combination of antioxidants and enhanced formula helps improve skin texture and protect against environmental damage. This powerful peel provides long-lasting results for a renewed and revitalized complexion.
1. Medium peeling

For all skin type, thin skin, sensitive skin, beginners.
Use half of powder and solution based on 1 vial (0.5 g of powder + 4 ml of solution).
Recommended to use once for 1-2 months. Use it once 2-3 months if have sensitive and thin skin.

2. Strong peeling

For all skin type, thick-skinned, large pores, experts.
Use each 1 vial of powder and solution based on 1 vial (1 g of powder + 8 ml of solution).
Recommended to use once for 2-3 months. Use it once 3-4 months if have sensitive and thin skin.

How to use Peelieve Skin Peel

Cleanse your face and lightly apply toner.
Place the Peelieve Peeling Solution in the vial containing the Peelieve Peeling Powder, cover the cap and shake it until it is sufficiently mixed. (Check proportions and recommendation for medium and strong peeling above.)
After applying the mixed solution evenly to the face, rub each cheek, chin, nose philtrum, and forehead, for 7-10 minutes. Even if you feel some pain, rub sufficiently first then press into the skin so the Spicule is properly stack in the skin. This is what makes it effective. (Do not exceed 7-10 minutes for total rubbing time).NOTE: If you rub focusing only on the one area it can create a wound. Please apply even pressure all over the face while rubbing. Also, please strictly adhere to the recommended rubbing time.Be careful to rub lightly on the thin part of the skin such as around the eyes.
If you experience dryness then spray facial mist intermittently during the peeling process. (Please only use normal hydration facial mist. Do not use facial mist that includes ingredients such as AHA, BHA, PHA, or oils.)(If it doesn't feel dry you do not need to spray facial mist.)
Apply a mask sheet pack without cleansing the face, so the particles of the Spicule properly stuck in the skin. (You can use any normal essence-type face mask pack. Avoid using mask pack with ingredients such alcohol, AHA, BHA, PHA, or oils.)
Take off the mask sheet pack after 10 minutes.
Do not use a cleanser but wash the face with lukewarm water lightly. (Spicule should be stuck in the skin for a good result.)
Apply washing plentiful Medisco Peelieve Cica Cream, after wiping off the water.
After washing your face each day, apply plenty of Medisco Peelieve Cica Cream to provide hydration and nutrition. Drink a lot of water.Make sure to apply sunscreen carefully every day when you go out.(If you are exposed to ultraviolet rays without applying sunscreen, blemishes may rise.)
According to the age, exfoliation starts approximately 7-10 days post-treatment. After the exfoliation begins do not forcefully remove dead skin.

jsonld.description:
Plinest One - 5 x 4ml 
 
Advanced Polynucleotide Skin Booster for Skin Rejuvenation, Hydration & Skin Elasticity
 
What is Plinest One?
Plinest One is an advanced polynucleotide-based injectable treatment developed to improve skin hydration, elasticity and overall skin quality. Formulated using PN-HPT® (Polynucleotide High Purification Technology), Plinest One helps support skin regeneration while improving the appearance of skin laxity, dehydration and early visible signs of ageing.
 
Designed for professional aesthetic treatments, Plinest One works by supporting fibroblast activity and helping stimulate collagen production for healthier, firmer and more revitalised-looking skin.
 
Widely used across UK aesthetic clinics, Plinest One is suitable for patients seeking skin rejuvenation treatments targeting dull skin, reduced elasticity, crepey texture and stretch mark concerns.
 
Unlike traditional dermal fillers designed to add volume, Plinest One focuses on improving overall skin quality and tissue regeneration while maintaining natural-looking results.



Key Benefits:

Advanced polynucleotide injectable skin treatment
Helps improve skin hydration and elasticity
Supports collagen stimulation and skin regeneration
Helps improve skin laxity and crepey skin
Supports smoother and firmer-looking skin
Suitable for face and body rejuvenation treatments
Helps improve overall skin texture and radiance
Professional-grade regenerative skin booster
Suitable for preventative anti-ageing treatments
Minimal downtime treatment option


 

Treatment Areas:

Plinest One is designed for professional skin rejuvenation treatments across multiple areas, including:

Face
Neck
Décolletage
Hands
Arms
Abdomen
Inner thighs
Stretch mark-prone areas
Body skin laxity areas
Overall skin quality improvement

 
Why Buy Plinest One?
Plinest One is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional polynucleotide skin booster designed to improve hydration, elasticity and visible skin quality. Its advanced PN-HPT® formulation supports natural skin regeneration and collagen stimulation while helping improve skin texture and firmness with natural-looking rejuvenation results.
 
Composition:

2mg/ml PN-HPT® Polynucleotides
High Purification Technology formulation
Sterile injectable solution
5 x 4ml vials


 
Treatment Protocol:

Injection depth: Dermal
Phase I: Every 7–14 days for 4 sessions
Phase II: Every 21–30 days for an additional 4 sessions

 
FAQs
What is Plinest One used for?
Plinest One is used for professional skin rejuvenation treatments designed to improve hydration, elasticity, skin texture and overall skin quality.
 
Is Plinest One a dermal filler?
No. Plinest One is not a traditional dermal filler. It is a polynucleotide skin booster designed to support skin regeneration and collagen stimulation rather than add facial volume.
What areas can Plinest One treat?
Common treatment areas include the face, neck, décolletage, abdomen, thighs and other areas affected by skin laxity or dehydration.
 
Does Plinest One stimulate collagen?
Yes. Plinest One helps support fibroblast activity and collagen production to improve skin firmness and elasticity.
 
Is Plinest One suitable for stretch marks?
Yes. Plinest One is commonly used in treatments targeting skin laxity and striae distensae (stretch marks).
 
How many Plinest One treatments are recommended?
An initial course of treatments is typically recommended, followed by maintenance sessions depending on skin condition and treatment goals.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

jsonld.description:
Profhilo Structura – 1 x 2ml

Advanced Injectable Skin Remodeling Treatment for Facial Structure & Tissue Restoration
 
What is Profhilo Structura?
Profhilo Structura is an advanced injectable skin remodeling treatment specifically developed to address age-related facial tissue changes, superficial fat loss and reduced structural support within the skin. Using stabilised hybrid hyaluronic acid technology, Profhilo Structura helps reposition superficial facial fat compartments while improving skin firmness, contour and overall facial structure.

jsonld.name: aesPlla®
jsonld.description:
aesPlla® is a Poly-L-Lactic Acid based (PLLA) collagen stimulator. Formulated with a biocompatible and biodegradable synthetic polymer, aesPlla® stimulates collagen production to help volumise and smooth the skin. Offering gradual results, the bio-stimulatory, PLLA filler works to correct the appearance of shallow to deep nasolabial fold contour deficiencies and facial wrinkles. Subsequent results may be observed from four weeks post-treatment, lasting for up to 3 years.
Key Features:

Ideal for patients aged 30+
Stimulates collagen to increase skin volume
Effects of aesPlla® can be observed from 4 weeks post-injection
Gradual and natural-looking results
Results last up to 3 years
Creates a softer and more natural-looking result

Treatment Areas:

Shallow to deep facial wrinkles
Nasolabial folds
Temple
Cheeks
Deep dermal deficiencies
Marionette lines
Sagging jowls
Scarring

Box Contents:

1 vial: 365mg of powder (150mg of PLLA)

Ingredients:
150mg of poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA), 90mg of sodium carboxymethylcellulose and 125g of mannitol.
Recommended Treatment protocol:

Dissolving time: 3 hours
Add 5ml of sterile water for injection, using 18G needle
Must be injected within 72 hours of reconstitution
Recommended technique: Linear Thread Technique
Recommended consumables: 18G sterile needle + 1/3ml syringe to withdraw
26G cannula or needle to inject
Inject into the deep dermis / lower layers of dermis / layers of hypodermis
Shelf life: 21 months

Aftercare:
Massage the skin for 5 minutes, 5 times per day, for 5 days post-treatment
Storage:

Do not refrigerate - store at room temperature
Stable for 72 hours post-reconstitution – discard after this duration

2.5% high molecular weight polynucleotides
Ideal for Repairs, revitalizes and regenerates tissues
Sterile disposable product that belongs to the new concept of regenerative medicine: it allows to promote cell turnover, improve skin elasticity and hydration and heal sun-damaged skin, photoaging and scars (acne).
The polynucleotide chain, in addition to attracting water molecules, has an anti-free radical action, acting as a scavenger of OH hydroxyl radicals which tend to accumulate as a result of stress, cell damage, external agents such as UV rays. The moisturizing action and the anti-free radical activity help to create an optimal environment for the growth of fibroblasts, favoring the restoration of tissue elasticity.
Nucleotides, natural DNA fractions, constitute the peculiar and original ingredient of this new product as they have an antioxidant action, protection and reduction of cell damage caused by UV radiation or scars.
The product contains high molecular weight polynucleotide chains whose biochemical characteristics make it highly viscoelastic and capable of binding and orienting in space a considerable quantity of water molecules, which are mainly retained at the level of the hydrophilic groups of the phosphorylated sugars of the individual nucleotides.

jsonld.name: aesPlla®
jsonld.description:
aesPlla® is a Poly-L-Lactic Acid based (PLLA) collagen stimulator. Formulated with a biocompatible and biodegradable synthetic polymer, aesPlla® stimulates collagen production to help volumise and smooth the skin. Offering gradual results, the bio-stimulatory, PLLA filler works to correct the appearance of shallow to deep nasolabial fold contour deficiencies and facial wrinkles. Subsequent results may be observed from four weeks post-treatment, lasting for up to 3 years.
Key Features:

Ideal for patients aged 30+
Stimulates collagen to increase skin volume
Effects of aesPlla® can be observed from 4 weeks post-injection
Gradual and natural-looking results
Results last up to 3 years
Creates a softer and more natural-looking result

Treatment Areas:

Shallow to deep facial wrinkles
Nasolabial folds
Temple
Cheeks
Deep dermal deficiencies
Marionette lines
Sagging jowls
Scarring

Box Contents:

1 vial: 365mg of powder (150mg of PLLA)

Ingredients:
150mg of poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA), 90mg of sodium carboxymethylcellulose and 125g of mannitol.
Recommended Treatment protocol:

Dissolving time: 3 hours
Add 5ml of sterile water for injection, using 18G needle
Must be injected within 72 hours of reconstitution
Recommended technique: Linear Thread Technique
Recommended consumables: 18G sterile needle + 1/3ml syringe to withdraw
26G cannula or needle to inject
Inject into the deep dermis / lower layers of dermis / layers of hypodermis
Shelf life: 21 months

Aftercare:
Massage the skin for 5 minutes, 5 times per day, for 5 days post-treatment
Storage:

Do not refrigerate - store at room temperature
Stable for 72 hours post-reconstitution – discard after this duration

Jalupro Glow Peel is a gentle yet powerful chemical peel designed to address multiple skin concerns, including fine lines, wrinkles, pigmentation, acne scars and uneven tone. It supports cell renewal, refines skin texture and helps restore a fresh, radiant and more youthful-looking complexion. Developed by Professional Derma, this peel combines targeted amino acids with an advanced acid complex that works in the deeper layers of the epidermis to support long‑term improvement in skin function.
Key Benefits


Skin appears brighter and more luminous immediately after treatment.


Cell renewal is stimulated, helping to promote a smoother, more youthful appearance.


Gentle exfoliation refines the skin’s surface for a more even texture.


The appearance of acne and inflammatory skin concerns is reduced, supporting a clearer complexion.


Pigmentation is visibly softened while the skin is helped to defend against oxidative stress.


Recommended Protocol
Jalupro Glow Peel fits easily into contemporary skincare routines and is suitable for all age groups. For best results, a course of four treatments spaced 2–3 weeks apart is recommended.
After application, slight redness may appear, usually subsiding within a few hours. To protect the skin and enhance outcomes, it is important to maintain intensive hydration and apply sun protection consistently. Even sensitive skin can benefit from the peel’s gentle yet effective action. If significant irritation occurs at any point during treatment, discontinue use immediately and rinse the skin thoroughly.

jsonld.name: Seventy Hyal 2000 Single (1 x 2ml)
jsonld.description:
Seventy Hyal 2000 is a bio-stimulating, injectable skin booster intended to help the treatment of physiological depletion of hyaluronic acid (HA) within the skin. The supplementation of hyaluronic acid (HA) simultaneously stimulates the production of new collagen and elastin while delivering moisture-surging hydration for a glowing appearance. 
Seventy Hyal 2000 is the perfect skin booster treatment to improve skin texture and skin laxity whilst gently adding volume. The Next Generation Skin Booster offers one of the highest molecular weights of hyaluronic acid formulations on the market to hydrate, contour and add glow to the skin. Seventy Hyal 2000 can be used for facial enhancements, delivering long-lasting hydration and a glow like no other. Alternatively, it can be used to rejuvenate the neck area, décolleté and hands as well as on the body to reduce the appearance of scarring, sagging and skin laxity.  
 Key Features: 

Contains one of the highest molecular weight hyaluronic acid (HA) formulations on the current market (> 2000 kDa) 
Results are expected to show almost immediately with full results showing two weeks post-treatment 
Covered by leading insurance providers, Insync and Cosmetic Insure 
CE-marked 
Bio-stimulates the production of new collagen and elastin within the skin 
Rejuvenates the skin to improve skin texture, skin laxity, dehydrated skin and crepiness 
With a HA concentration of 30mg per 2ml 

Targeting:  

Skin hydration  
Sagging skin  
Ageing skin  
Scarring  
Improved skin quality  
Reduction in fine lines  
Radiance 
Subtle contour  

Treatment areas: 

Face 
Lips
Neck 
Décolleté 
Hands 
Stomach   
Elbows    
Arms   
Abdomen   
Knees   

Composition: 

High molecular weight Sodium Hyaluronate 1.5, obtained by bacterial fermentation without any chemical modification. 

Other ingredients: Sodium Chloride, Disodium Phosphate 2H₂0, Monosodium Phosphate 2H₂0 Water for Injection. 


Box contents: 

Each box contains: 1 x 2ml pre-filled syringe of Seventy Hyal 2000 (with a HA concentration of 30mg per 2ml)

jsonld.name: Bellast Prime Soft  (1 x 1ml)
jsonld.description:
Bellast Prime Soft is the lightest dermal filler of the all-new range. This CE-marked dermal filler features high-quality and high-density hyaluronic acid (HA) and is formulated for use in more delicate areas, such as the periorbital area, to treat both fine lines and facial wrinkles. Due to its lightweight viscosity, Bellast Prime Soft has a shallow injection depth in the upper dermis, which helps to smooth and soften its application area.
 
Bellast Prime Soft Key Features

CE marked, meaning that it adheres to strict health, safety, and environmental criteria 
Lightweight dermal filler, perfect for more delicate application areas  
24mg of high-density hyaluronic acid  
0.3% lidocaine allows for a comfortable and painless injection  
Ergonomic syringe design allows for extra comfort and a more accurate injection 
Optimal viscoelasticity and long-lasting volume  

Treatment Areas of Bellast Prime Soft

Periorbital areas 
Superficial lines 
Facial wrinkles 
Tear trough (you must be fully trained and insured to inject in the tear trough area)

Composition 

Hyaluronic acid concentration 24mg 
Lidocaine 0.3%  

Bellast Prime Soft Benefits 
The benefits of Bellast Prime soft dermal fillers include, but are not limited to:  

Incredible results that last between 6 and 12 months  
Ergonomic syringe design which allows for extra comfort and accuracy  
Formulated using high-quality hyaluronic acid  
Incredible value for money  
Visible results after just one treatment  
Has been through stringent health and safety testing 
High viscoelasticity and high concentration of HA  

Bellast Prime Soft Contraindications

Not to be used on patients with bleeding disorders  
Not to be resterilised  
Not to be mixed with other products before injection  
Not recommended for patients who are susceptible to keloid pathogenesis 
Not to be used where there is inflammation, infection, or any active disease  
Not advised for use on patients taking medication that affects platelet function 
Not to be used on anyone with a known lidocaine allergy 
Not to be used on patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding

jsonld.name: Kiara Skin Booster (1 x 2.7ml)
jsonld.description:
Kiara is not a traditional skin booster. It’s a clinically backed bio-remodeller designed to improve skin quality by hydrating, lifting, and stimulating collagen production — for subtle, natural-looking results. It deeply hydrates and renews skin, stimulates collagen and elastin synthesis, lifts and firms, and improves elasticity, texture, and overall skin health. The treatment is perfect for patients who are looking for a refreshed and radiant look as it enhances collagen production, elasticity, and deep hydration. 
Key Features

54mg of high purity hyaluronic acid per syringe
CE Marked, meaning that the treatment has been through stringent health, safety, and environmental testing.  
Incredible bio-remodelling results that last between 6-9 months. 
Impressive results can be visible after just a single treatment.  
Progressive tissue remodelling 

Kiara Treatment Areas

Face  
Hands 
Neck  

Composition

Cross-linked HA  
Non-cross-linked HA  
DVS thermal cross-linking  

Kiara Bio Remodelling Benefits

DVS thermal cross-linking ensures incredible purity with fewer impurities  
Adds a natural lift without added volume needed 
Provides anti-inflammatory support post-injection for an enhanced recovery time  
Perfect for patients with age-related facial fat loss, sagging, and loss of elasticity  

High-quality product at an incredibly affordable and accessible price point 


Kiara Contraindications

Must not be given to anyone with an active infection  
Must not be given to women who are pregnant or breastfeeding  
Must not be given to anyone with an autoimmune disease  
Must take caution with any client on anticoagulants or anti-inflammatory medication

description: Dermaheal HSR is a rejuvenating and revitalising mesococktail, unique in composition of peptides and hyaluronic acid. Stimulates the proliferation of keratinocytes and fibroblasts. Increases skin elasticity due to the synthesis of elastin and collagen. Increases the synthesis of hyaluronic acid. Decapeptide-4 (C9-IDP2): It has a rejuvenating and wound healing effect. Enhances the synthesis of collagen, elastin, and other extracellular matrix components. Participates in the regulation of apoptosis. Copper Peptide Tripeptide-1 (C9-Copper Peptide): Helps to enhance blood microcirculation and skin regeneration. Stimulates angiogenesis (promotes the germination of new blood vessels), enhances tissue regeneration and renewal, increases skin elasticity; Oligopeptide-24 (C9-EDP3): Reduces skin scars by forming new skin cells. Stimulates the proliferation of keratinocytes and fibroblasts. Increases the synthesis of hyaluronic acid and elastin. Regulates keratinocyte apoptosis; Tripeptide-6 (C9-CTP): Moisturizes dry skin and maintains an optimal water balance. Increases the synthesis of hyaluronic acid, increases elasticity due to the synthesis of collagen and elastin, and also participates in the synthesis of new cells. HYALURONIC ACID Hyaluronic Acid is an indispensable and natural moisturizing element for the elastic-viscous balance of the dermis and epidermis. Hydroscopic effect due to the fixation of a large amount of water through the creation of hydrogen and aqueous compounds + effect on cell proliferation. Unstabilized hyaluronic acid 1% (with a molecular weight of 1.5 million Da) is as close as possible to endogenous HA. Which provides significant hydration and creates an ideal environment for the proliferation of skin cells. Potentiates the action of biomimetic peptides, significantly increases the activity of the drug as a whole, and also prolongs its effect. 13 VITAMINS Have a stimulating, antioxidant, and regulatory effect. Stabilized Hybrid Cooperative Complexes (HCC) of high and low molecular weight Ultrapure Hyaluronic Acid in high concentration, produced with a unique and innovative thermal production process patented by IBSA, the NAHYCO® Technology. Aging manifests as a result of the interplay of changes in the facial skeleton, ligaments, muscles, adipose tissue, and skin. The characteristic signs of aging in facial skin are, in part, associated with age-related alterations in the subcutaneous adipose tissue of the face. The movement of fat within compartments, due to gravity, can result in an inferomedial displacement of the overlying skin envelope. short_description: Jalupro HMW What’s in the box? 1 x glass disposable syringe, pyrogen (sterile gel of Sodium Hyaluronate) 1 x glass bottle sterile solution based on Amino Acids. No needles. In total: (1 x 1.5 ml & 1 x 1.0 ml solutions)
description: Description How does Jalupro HMW work? Jalupro HMW is an injectable solution that has been formulated using a clever combination of amino acids. Technically labelled as a ‘dermal biorevitalizer’, it eradicates skin depressions caused by ageing wrinkles and scars. The science behind Jalupro works by feeding the connective tissue under the skin layers, otherwise known as fibroblasts. Fibroblasts produce collagen and repair skin to ensure it always has elasticity and great looking texture. As skin ages, the fibroblasts function reduces in activity; this can be caused by many factors, including spending too much time in the sun, intense smoking and other reasons. Consequently, wrinkles appear. The amino acids in Jalupro HMW join forces with the existing fibroblasts to help them continue their pre-ageing function. The more abundant the amino acids, the more healthier the skin cells are, resulting in younger appearance. This natural phenomenon is an effective way for skin to look younger again without surgery. What’s in the box? 1 x glass disposable syringe, pyrogen (sterile gel of Sodium Hyaluronate) 1 x glass bottle sterile solution based on Amino Acids. No needles. In total: (1 x 1.5 ml & 1 x 1.0 ml solutions) What are the benefits of Jalupro HMW? Jalupro HMW can be used to fade out scars and improve skin appearance by eliminating depressions specifically: in the face, neck, decollete, underarms, hands, inner thighs, abdomen area and knees When can Jalupro HMW be used? Jalupro can be used as soon as the face area begins to show signs of ageing and photo-ageing. It can be used to correct dry and dehydrated skin. educe stretch marks and is especially ideal before or after any surgery is to take place. How long will results last for? Whilst results become more evident over time, the average effects can last for 6 months. Can be used prior to sunbathing and works well in mature aged skin.

description: Description Seventy Hyal 2000 (3 x 2ml) Seventy Hyal 2000 is an injectable hyaluronic acid skin booster treatment that aims to improve hydration levels within the skin for a rejuvenated and glowing appearance. Each box of Seventy Hyal 2000 contains 3 x 2ml syringes with a HA concentration of 90mg per 6ML. Description Seventy Hyal 2000 is a bio-stimulating, injectable skin booster intended to help treat the physiological depletion of hyaluronic acid (HA) within the skin. The supplementation of hyaluronic acid (HA) delivers moisture-surging hydration whilst simultaneously stimulating the production of new collagen and elastin. Seventy Hyal 2000 makes for the perfect skin rejuvenation treatment to improve skin texture and skin laxity whilst adding gentle volume. Aside from helping to influence the structural and functional elements of the skin, the main unique selling points are: to hydrate, contour and add glow. Seventy Hyal 2000 can be used for facial enhancements to create a radiant appearance or alternatively, it can be used to rejuvenate the neck area, décolleté and hands. Composition: High molecular weight sodium Hyaluronate 1.5, obtained by bacterial fermentation without any chemical modification. Other ingredients: Sodium Chloride, Disodium Phosphate 2H20, Monosodium Phosphate 2H20 water for injection. Box Contents: Contains three 2ml syringes (pre-filled) with a HA concentration of 90mg per 6ml. Each syringe is singularly sealed and contains 30mg/2ml.

description: Description Description PROFHILO ® STRUCTURA is indicated for facial treatment and for restoring adipose tissue. Stabilized Hybrid Cooperative Complexes (HCC) of high and low molecular weight Ultrapure Hyaluronic Acid in high concentration, produced with a unique and innovative thermal production process patented by IBSA, the NAHYCO ® Technology. Aging manifests as a result of the interplay of changes in the facial skeleton, ligaments, muscles, adipose tissue, and skin. The characteristic signs of aging in facial skin are, in part, associated with age-related alterations in the subcutaneous adipose tissue of the face. The movement of fat within compartments, due to gravity, can result in an inferomedial displacement of the overlying skin envelope. This repositioning or shift of fat often leads to increased hollows in the cheeks and to a flattening of facial angles. Consequently, there is a loss of fat volume in the middle and lateral cheek compartments. PROFHILO ® STRUCTURA provides a lipolifting effect by restoring adipose tissue and leading to deep firmness.

description: Description 2.5% high molecular weight polynucleotides Ideal for Repairs, revitalizes and regenerates tissues Sterile disposable product that belongs to the new concept of regenerative medicine: it allows to promote cell turnover, improve skin elasticity and hydration and heal sun-damaged skin, photoaging and scars (acne). The polynucleotide chain, in addition to attracting water molecules, has an anti-free radical action, acting as a scavenger of OH hydroxyl radicals which tend to accumulate as a result of stress, cell damage, external agents such as UV rays. The moisturizing action and the anti-free radical activity help to create an optimal environment for the growth of fibroblasts, favoring the restoration of tissue elasticity. Nucleotides, natural DNA fractions, constitute the peculiar and original ingredient of this new product as they have an antioxidant action, protection and reduction of cell damage caused by UV radiation or scars. The product contains high molecular weight polynucleotide chains whose biochemical characteristics make it highly viscoelastic and capable of binding and orienting in space a considerable quantity of water molecules, which are mainly retained at the level of the hydrophilic groups of the phosphorylated sugars of the individual nucleotides.

aesPlla is a Poly-L-Lactic Acid based (PLLA) collagen stimulator. Formulated with a biocompatible and biodegradable synthetic polymer, aesPlla® stimulates collagen production to help volumise and smooth the skin. Offering gradual results, the bio-stimulatory, PLLA filler works to correct the appearance of shallow to deep nasolabial fold contour deficiencies and facial wrinkles. Subsequent results may be observed from four weeks post-treatment, lasting for up to 3 years.
Key Features:


 	Ideal for patients aged 30+
 	Stimulates collagen to increase skin volume
 	Effects of aesPlla® can be observed from 4 weeks post-injection
 	Gradual and natural-looking results
 	Results last up to 3 years
 	Creates a softer and more natural-looking result

Treatment Areas:


 	Shallow to deep facial wrinkles
 	Nasolabial folds
 	Temple
 	Cheeks
 	Deep dermal deficiencies
 	Marionette lines
 	Sagging jowls
 	Scarring

Box Contents:


 	1 vial: 365mg of powder (150mg of PLLA)

Ingredients:

150mg of poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA), 90mg of sodium carboxymethylcellulose and 125g of mannitol.
Additional Information and Treatment Protocols:
Recommended Treatment protocol:


 	Dissolving time: 3 hours
 	Add 5ml of sterile water for injection using 18G needle
 	Must be injected within 72 hours of reconstitution
 	Recommended technique: Linear Thread Technique
 	Recommended consumables: 18G sterile needle + 1/3ml syringe to withdraw
 	26G cannula or needle to inject
 	Inject into the deep dermis / lower layers of dermis / layers of hypodermis
 	Shelf life: 21 months

Aftercare:
Massage the skin for 5 minutes, 5 times per day, for 5 days post-treatment
Storage:


 	Do not refrigerate - store at room temperature
 	Stable for 72 hours post-reconstitution – discard after this duration

description: Description HArmonyCa is a hybrid injectable dermal filler treatment from Allergan. It combines hyaluronic acid (HA) with Calcium Hydroxyapatite (CaHA), which is how it gets its name. It is designed to augment, tighten, and lift the skin via injections into the deep dermal and subdermal layers. It also encourages the production of collagen. HArmonyCa may improve your skin architecture by immediately lifting the skin, and supporting your body’s production of collagen. HOW DOES HARMONYCA WORK? The cross-linked hyaluronic acid gel plumps the skin, resulting in an immediate lifting effect. The CaHA particles support the body’s production of collagen, so that new collagen develops. PLENHYAGE XL Medium contains natural DNA fractions called nucleotides, which are the peculiar and original ingredients of this new product. The antioxidant action of these nucleotides protects against and reduces cell damage caused by UV radiation or scars. The product contains high molecular weight polynucleotide chains whose biochemical characteristics make it highly viscoelastic and capable of binding and orienting a considerable quantity of water molecules in space. The water molecules are mainly retained at the level of the hydrophilic groups of the phosphorylated sugars of the individual nucleotides. Macromolecules in PLENHYAGE XL Medium are also capable of carrying out an immediate “scavenger” action against free radicals. Polynucleotides are important tools available to regenerative medicine to counteract the ageing processes: skin revitalisation is activated by the main players involved in the development of the dermis, the fibroblasts and stem cells, respecting the biological time of tissue formation. Overall, PLENHYAGE XL Medium is an excellent product for individuals seeking to repair, revitalise, and regenerate their facial tissues. By attracting water molecules, it hydrates dehydrated skin, leaving it plump and rejuvenated. – Acne improvement: Plenhyage effectively addresses acne concerns by reducing acne scarring, inflammatory redness, and uneven skin tone. Its regenerative properties promote tissue repair and skin cell renewal, leading to a clearer complexion. – Anti-free radical activity: Plenhyage acts as a powerful scavenger of OH hydroxyl radicals, protecting skin cells from oxidative stress caused by UV radiation and other external aggressors. – Dark circles and uneven skin tone: Plenhyage helps alleviate dark circles and evens out skin tone by encouraging cell turnover and enhancing skin quality. Azzalure is indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines, also known as vertical lines between the eyebrows. Different clinical trials have validated the effectiveness of Azzalure for treating specific facial lines, involving numerous patients to ensure its efficacy and safety. In addition, frown lines, along with lateral canthal lines, are seen at maximum smile. Therefore, adult patients with visible signs of lines and wrinkles in these facial areas seeking a softening of the area of concern would be good candidates for Azzalure. Patients must be under 65 years old and not have any contraindications that would make them unsuitable for Azzalure treatment. How long does azzalure take to work? Clients should begin to notice a softening of the lines and wrinkles 2 to 3 days after treatment. After two weeks, the client should see the optimal level of results. What are the contraindications of Azzalure? The main contraindications for Azzalure include hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients, muscle weakness as a potential side effect, an existing infection at the injection site, and health conditions such as myasthenia gravis, Eaton-Lambert Syndrome, or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Individuals with an infection on the skin surface at the injection site should wait for the infection to fully resolve before undergoing treatment. IMPORTANT — PLEASE INSPECT BEFORE USE Azzalure contains a very small quantity of freeze-dried product, which may appear as a thin, barely visible film inside the vial rather than an obvious amount of powder. Please inspect every vial carefully before removing the flip-off cap, piercing the rubber stopper or injecting saline. If you believe a vial is empty, damaged or defective, do not open, reconstitute or otherwise tamper with it. Take clear photographs of the sealed vial and contact us immediately with the batch number and expiry date. Saline must be injected through the intact rubber stopper using a sterile needle. The rubber stopper must never be removed. Once a vial has been opened, had its stopper removed or been reconstituted, its original condition and sterility are compromised, and it may no longer be possible to return it to the laboratory for an accurate investigation. Opened or reconstituted products cannot be accepted as evidence of a manufacturing defect. Please do not use any vial if you have concerns about its condition or integrity.

description: Description Ejal 40 is a bio-revitalizing gel containing the latest generation of medium molecular weight hyaluronic acid ideal to rebuild the basic structure of the extracellular matrix. Treatments with Ejal 40 will firm sagging skin, reduce wrinkles, improve the skin tone and elasticity as well as improve the overall skin condition. A fantastic alternative to Profhilo. The formula of the product contains an optimal combination of molecular concentration and molecular weight of 40mg HA and 1200-1800 kDaltons, formulated in a phy­siological, sterile, biodegradable, and isotonic buffer. The syringe is pre-filled and contains 2,0ml of gel. Ejal 40 can be injected with several techniques, but the most effective technique is the 4-point technology (4 PBR), which allows the injection of 25ml with a 30G needle on each side of the face that minimizes the risk of edema, bruising, and pain. Treatments with Ejal 40 improves the density of the skin by stimulating fibroblasts and the formation of collagen and elastin fibers. Treatments with hyaluronic acid stimulate the production of new collagen and restore the level of natural hyaluronic acid in the skin by counteracting the breakdown process. Furthermore, the product is designed to restructure and reinforce the extracellular matrix revitalizing skin that is dehydrated and dama­ged by aging and solar exposure.

Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine contains biocompatible hyaluronic acid which is an injectable filler that provides instant results that are natural.

What is Volift?

Volift utilises VYCROSS™ technology; an innovative combination of low and high molecular weight HA to improve the cross-linking efficiency of HA chains. The cross-linking enables a low concentration of Hyaluronic acid to provide effective natural long-lasting results, alongside minimal swelling and bruising. 

What is in the box?

2 x 1ml syringes

What can Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine be used for?

Reduction of nasolabial folds whilst restoring your natural contours within the face.

How long will effects last?

A 30 minute treatment sessions can give you effects lasting for up to 15 months.

Who should not use Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine?

Pregnant or lactating women should not use Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine.

If you are considering Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine,  inform your Physician of any previous permanent products or body enhancing products you have used. You should also make them aware of any allergies, immune diseases and infections you have. Similarly if you have hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid.

The treatment should not be used in conjunction with any skin treatments including laser or dear abrasion treatment.

What are the associated side effects with Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine?

Common symptoms such as swelling, bruising and redness can occur at the site of gel injection. Resolution is usually within one week.

description: Description AMI eyes AMI eyes is a premium PN product which improves the conditions of damaged dermis with tissue regeneration material and purified DNA from salmon milt. Polydeoxyribonuclotides (PDRN) has previously been used as a skin injectable for anti-aging and hair growth treatments in Korea, and medically for skin regeneration purposes. PN is a purer and more concentrated form of PDRN and has stronger regenerative properties. Benefits of AMI eyes are: Increases skin elasticity Tightening effect of enlarged pores Increase fibroblast function Abundant moisture supply with polymer hyaluronic acid Improvement of skin tone and oil-water balance So, how to use AMI eyes ? Under eye treatment Use 30g 13mm needle or multi needle / Meso needle Point 6 ~ 10 spots under one eye Inject the same amount ( 1ml for one eye / 2ml for one session total ) *You can inject more amount on the dark circle area. Mesotherapy Use 33g needle or multi needle / Meso needle Inject the same amount ( 2ml for whole face ) * if you use AMI eyes with Collagen filler or HA booster, the effect will be better and last longer.

description: Description Jalupro HMW is composed of – one glass disposable syringe, apyrogen, containing a sterile gel of Sodium Hyaluronate; – one glass bottle containing a sterile solution based on Amino Acids. The package does not contain needles. WHEN TO USE JALUPRO – Photo-aging and Anti-aging of a face and a body (moderate and severe degree) – Dry and dehydrated skin – Procedures during summer time – The beginning of the course of revitalization (possible to combine with Jalupro) – Preparation, improvement and prolongation of results for different aesthetic – procedures WHERE Face, Neck, Decollete, Underarms, Hands, Inner thighs, Abdomen, Knee region INJECTION TECHNIQUES Micropapules, Linear, Fan shape, Grid shaped, mixed. A local anaesthetic can be associated – 0,5-1 ml of 2% procaine – in order to reduce the burning sensation which follows the injection. The needle has to be inserted along the wrinkle and then gradually retracted, by releasing the product. After injection, if necessary, proceed with a light massage in order to model the treated zone. For the correction of thin wrinkles, the more recommended site of injection is typically reticular dermis. FEEDING THE FIBROBLASTS WITH AMINO ACIDS The cells of the subcutaneous connective tissue in our skin are called fibroblasts. Fibroblasts act by forming collagen and repairing fragile and worn out skin, ensuring skin tone and elasticity.Fibroblasts activity reduces over time because of aging or other reasons (eating habits, diets, smoking, intense physical activity, long exposure to the sun). Therefore, skin gets old, loses tone, elasticity, brightness, volume, and subsequently wrinkles and furrows appear. Fibroblasts produce collagen by using a nutritional support: Amino Acids (Glicine, L-Proline, L-Lysine) which are essential to compensate the reduced fibroblasts activity. More is high the Amino Acids quantity available in the interested areas, more cells vitality and their number increase. Therefore, skin appearance gets better greatly. THE RESULTS A RAPID AND SAFE RECOVERY OF THE WRINKLE Jalupro’s use means to reduce skin wrinkleness significantly. Especially the product has shown to have an excellent biorevitalizing efficacy and to improve the main skin aging and photoaging signs. This efficacy grows over time and lasts 6 months. Jalupro’s tolerance was very good in all treated subjects and the treatment is ideal before sunbathing too.

description: Description Jalupro Amino Acid is a sterile, resorbable, injectable solution which acts as dermal biorevitalizer. It can be used for improving skin texture and minimising evidence of skin wrinkles in the face. Jalupro Amino Acid can be used as an additional step in physical or chemical treatments such as peeling, laser therapy, dermoabrasion, radiofrequency, dermal filler and botulinum toxin. Use Jalupro for photo-aging and anti-aging of the face and body (light and medium degree), stretch marks, preparation, improvement and prolongation of results for different aesthetic procedures and for pre and post surgery. The pack consists of: 2 sterile bottles containing amino acids 2 sterile vials containing Sodium Hyaluronate In total: (2 x 30 mg, 3 ml & 2 x 100mg Amino Acid solutions) Benefits of Jalupro Amino Acid: Eliminate wrinkles and improve skin texture Treatment areas: face, neck, décolleté, underarms, hands, inner thighs, abdomen, knee region How long does the result last for? Results become more evident over time and the average effects can last up to 6 months. Can be used prior to sunbathing and works well in mature aged skin

description: Description WHAT IS LETYBO? Letybo is a new Botulinum Toxin Type A, now available and approved for use in the UK, from aesthetic manufacturer Croma-Pharmacy. Letybo can be used to treat the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines, (wrinkles and lines between the eyebrows and forehead) in adults. One vial contains 50 units of botulinum toxin type A produced by Clostridium botulinum. The recommended dose is a total of 20 units, divided into 5 injections of 4 units each. You can purchase. WHAT ARE THE SIDE EFFECTS? The side effects are minimal, but you may experience reactions at the injection site, such as swelling, which should fade within 48 hours. You may also experience a headache, dropping of the eyelids, twitching eyelids, head discomfort, and bruising, which should fade within 1 to 2 weeks. WHO SHOULD NOT USE LETYBO? You should not use Letybo if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. You should consult a doctor before any treatment, and they will be able to help you decide the type of treatment needed. Only fully trained physicians should administer this product. Make sure to check out our selection of Botulinum Toxin products here, including solutions from Allergan, Galderma, Merz, and Croma. Please be aware – This is a prescription only medicine (POM) and will not be processed without receiving a copy of a valid private prescription from a registered UK prescriber

The medical-grade PN utilized in this formulation accelerates wound recovery, boosts fibroblast growth, and synthesizes collagen and elastin, fortifying the dermal structure. These activate cell secretion, improve dead skin cells, and ensure optimal moisture levels. Clinical Validation and Results Clinical studies have evidenced its efficacy in improving roughness, pore volume, pigmentation, and skin texture. Notably, patients treated with AETER Puri Eyes experienced brighter and improved skin texture, demonstrating substantial improvements in just weeks. Specialized Treatment Procedure Following treatment, post-care measures are crucial for optimized results, ensuring smoother skin texture, enhanced complexion, improved oil balance, and increased skin elasticity. The recommended treatment cycle includes 3 to 4 sessions in 2 to 3-week weeks to achieve maximum effectiveness.

description: Description PLENHYAGE XL Medium is a disposable sterile product that belongs to the new concept of regenerative medicine. The product contains 2% high molecular weight polynucleotides that are ideal for repairing, revitalising, and regenerating facial tissues. Plenhyage is renowned for its anti-free radical action, acting as a scavenger of OH hydroxyl radicals. These radicals, often generated by external agents like UV rays and stress, can wreak havoc on skin cells, leading to cell damage, dehydration, and skin elasticity reduction. This treatment is designed to promote cell turnover, improve skin elasticity and hydration, and heal sun-damaged skin, photoaging, and scars (acne). PLENHYAGE XL Medium is also an excellent option for preparing facial skin for other aesthetic medicine treatments. The polynucleotide chain in PLENHYAGE XL Medium has an anti-free radical action, acting as a scavenger of OH hydroxyl radicals that tend to accumulate because of stress, cell damage, and external agents such as UV rays. The moisturising action and anti-free radical activity help to create an optimal environment for the growth of fibroblasts, helping to restore the elasticity of the tissues. PLENHYAGE XL Medium contains natural DNA fractions called nucleotides, which are the peculiar and original ingredients of this new product. The antioxidant action of these nucleotides protects against and reduces cell damage caused by UV radiation or scars.

description: Description Vitaran I (or "Vitaran Eyes") is a specialized polynucleotide injectable skin booster designed to rejuvenate the delicate under-eye area. It comes in a 1 x 1ml syringe and is used by qualified aesthetic practitioners to improve skin quality, firmness, and hydration. Key features Active ingredient: The injectable is made from highly purified and sterilized fragments of salmon DNA. This ingredient works at a cellular level as a bio-stimulator. Mechanism of action: Polynucleotides promote the natural repair and regeneration of skin cells. It stimulates the production of collagen, elastin, and hyaluronic acid to improve the skin's structure and elasticity. It also has anti-inflammatory properties that help combat free radical damage. Target area: Vitaran I is specifically formulated for the thin, sensitive skin in the periorbital (under-eye) area. This makes it a targeted solution for concerns that may be challenging to treat with traditional fillers. Box contents: The product is sold as a 1 x 1ml syringe, with some boxes containing needles (typically 33G or 34G) appropriate for the treatment.

description: Description Discover the next generation of aesthetic treatment with Lumi-PN Face 1 x 2.5ml. This single syringe of high-performance injectable solution is expertly formulated to combat all major signs of ageing and environmental damage across the face, working at a deep cellular level to repair and renew. Lumi-PN Face utilises a cutting-edge blend of Polynucleotides (PN), Hyaluronic Acid (HA), and rejuvenating peptides. Polynucleotides, derived from purified salmon DNA, are known for their exceptional ability to promote tissue regeneration, strengthen the skin’s natural barrier, and stimulate fibroblast activity—the cells responsible for producing collagen and elastin. Key Benefits for Your Skin: Intensive Hydration: The stabilised Hyaluronic Acid provides immediate and deep moisture, improving skin plumpness and texture. Collagen & Elastin Boost: PN and peptides work in synergy to significantly stimulate the production of new collagen and elastin, restoring firmness and elasticity. Fine Line Reduction: The peptide component specifically targets and smooths the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Barrier Repair: Enhances the skin’s protective properties, making it more resilient against stress, pollution, and ageing. Restored Radiance: Combats dullness and improves overall skin tone, revealing a healthier, more luminous glow. Treatment Versatility: The 1 x 2.5ml format offers flexibility for comprehensive facial coverage or targeted application in areas of concern. Lumi-PN is suitable for a wide range of clients seeking a visible and natural improvement in skin quality without invasive procedures. Recommended protocols typically involve a course of 2–3 initial sessions, spaced a few weeks apart, followed by maintenance treatments for long-lasting results.

description: Description Juvederm VOLITE is an innovative Injectable Treatment using VYCROSS® technology Designed to Improve Skin Quality for up to 9 months. The face, neck, décolletage and hands can be treated. It is an injectable filler which should be placed to the deep layers of the skin point by point, so it involves multiple injections across the treatment area. For better comfort, the application of numbing cream is recommended prior to the treatment. The filler (hyaluronic acid) creates a lift to the skin and due to its cross-linked nature (VYCROSS® technology), the longevity is a good 9 month (natural hyaluronic acid would disappear from the skin within 2 days). A full face treatment requires an average of 2 ml of Juvederm VOLITE.
