description: Description Dermaheal LL: Advanced Lipolysis and Body Contouring Dermaheal LL (Lipolytic Solution) is a high-performance fat-dissolving treatment designed to target stubborn adipose tissue and cellulite. This mesotherapy injectable provides a non-surgical alternative for body contouring, helping your clients achieve a more defined and sculpted appearance in areas that are often resistant to diet and exercise. How It Works Dermaheal LL utilises a synergistic blend of active ingredients to break down fat cell membranes, allowing the stored fat to be naturally processed and excreted via the lymphatic system. Unlike many fat-dissolvers that can leave skin looking loose, Dermaheal LL is formulated to boost collagen, ensuring the treated area remains firm and lifted. Key Ingredients Hydrogenated Lecithin (Phosphatidylcholine): A renowned fat-breaking agent that emulsifies adipocytes (fat cells). Carnitine: Accelerates the transport of fatty acids to be metabolised and eliminated by the body. Decapeptide-4: A biomimetic peptide that promotes collagen synthesis, ensuring skin stays elastic and tight following fat reduction. Target Treatment Areas Dermaheal LL is highly versatile and can be used to eliminate fat and cellulite in the following areas: Face & Neck: Double chin, jowls, and cheeks. Body: Upper and lower abdomen (belly), thighs, buttocks, and hips. Specific Deposits: Back fat, arms, knees, and shoulders. Key Benefits Fat Reduction: Targets and destroys stubborn fat deposits for long-lasting results. Cellulite Smoothing: Minimises the “orange peel” effect for a refined skin texture. Skin Tightening: Improves elasticity and lifts sagging skin in the treated area. Collagen Support: Strengthens the skin’s structural integrity during the slimming process. Proven Results: Visible improvements in skin smoothness and contouring within a 6–8 week course. Maintenance and Longevity Results typically last between 6 to 12 months. To ensure the best outcome and prevent the return of fat deposits, clients should maintain a healthy diet and active lifestyle. Stock Dermaheal LL and offer your clients a powerful, non-invasive solution for body confidence.

description: Description Dermaheal SB: Professional Skin Brightening & Pigmentation Control Dermaheal SB (Skin Brightening) is a high-performance mesotherapy solution engineered to target discolouration and restore a natural, healthy radiance to the skin. This sophisticated meso-cocktail works at a cellular level to regulate melanin synthesis, making it an essential treatment for clients struggling with uneven skin tone and environmental damage. The Science of Radiance By combining over six active ingredients, Dermaheal SB does more than just brighten; it actively protects and rejuvenates. The formula features three biomimetic peptides that work in synergy to prevent the formation of new age spots while fading existing hyperpigmentation. The addition of Vitamin C and Arbutin provides a double-action approach to brightening—blocking the enzymes that trigger pigmentation while shielding the skin from the oxidative stress caused by UV rays and pollution. Target Concerns Dermaheal SB is the ideal choice for treating: Hyperpigmentation: Visible sun damage and dark patches. Age Spots: Pigment changes associated with maturing skin. Uneven Skin Tone: Dullness and lack of clarity. Freckles: Targeted reduction of concentrated pigment spots. Key Benefits Melanin Regulation: Effectively reduces and prevents future hyperpigmentation. Luminous Complexion: Brightens and evens out the skin tone for a “lit-from-within” glow. Antioxidant Defence: Features Liquorice Root Extract and Vitamin C to fight free radicals. Enhanced Hydration: Rejuvenates the skin by activating the natural synthesis of Hyaluronic Acid. Environmental Protection: Safeguards the skin against the damaging effects of UV rays and pollutants. The Dermaheal Collection As part of the versatile Dermaheal range, SB can be integrated into a wider treatment plan alongside Dermaheal HSR or SR to provide a comprehensive anti-ageing and brightening programme.

description: Description Dermaheal HSR: The Ultimate Hyaluronic Skin Rejuvenation Restore your clients’ youthful radiance with Dermaheal HSR (Hyaluronic Skin Rejuvenating), a premium meso-cocktail designed to combat the primary signs of ageing. Specifically formulated for dry, dull, and mature skin types, this advanced treatment provides intense hydration while stimulating the skin’s natural repair mechanisms. Advanced Formula for Superior Results At the heart of Dermaheal HSR is a sophisticated blend of over 50 active ingredients. The addition of concentrated Hyaluronic Acid (HA) ensures that moisture is locked into the dermis, resulting in skin that looks plumper, smoother, and significantly more elastic. The formula features 5 potent peptides that work at a cellular level to enhance skin structure, alongside a complex of vitamins and amino acids that nourish and protect the complexion. Key Benefits Deep Hydration: High-concentration HA plumps dry, dehydrated skin from within. Anti-Ageing Excellence: Effectively reduces the appearance of fine lines and deeper wrinkles. Skin Refinement: Minimises the look of enlarged pores, acne scarring, and sagging. Collagen Support: Triggers the production of collagen and elastin for improved firmness and structure. Cellular Repair: Promotes rapid regeneration to help heal and revitalise damaged skin tissue. Dermaheal HSR vs Dermaheal SR While both products offer exceptional anti-ageing benefits, Dermaheal HSR is the preferred choice for clients with noticeably dry or mature skin. The higher concentration of Hyaluronic Acid allows HSR to treat deeper wrinkles and provide the extra nourishment required for aged complexions, whereas Dermaheal SR serves as a lighter alternative for general skin rejuvenation. Recommended Treatment Programme To achieve and maintain optimal results, the following protocol is recommended: Phase 1: One session per week for the first month. Phase 2: Two sessions per month for the second month. Maintenance: One session per month to sustain skin health and radiance. Stock the full Dermaheal collection to provide your clients with industry-leading mesotherapy results.

description: Description Velora Skin Booster is a sterile dermal bio-revitalisation product formulated with 18 mg/mL of non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid and enhanced with CHP-Hydrate (Cyclic(His-Pro)) peptide—a clinically active biomimetic peptide registered as Imidazolylmethyl Pyrrolopiprtazinedione. Designed to improve dermal hydration, elasticity, and overall skin quality, Velora delivers targeted hydration to the mid to deep dermis while activating the skin’s natural regeneration processes. The addition of CHP peptide promotes collagen synthesis, soothes inflammation, and supports the skin’s extracellular matrix by mimicking the action of naturally occurring skin-repair peptides. The high concentration of hyaluronic acid provides deep, lasting hydration and mechanical support, while CHP peptide enhances cellular communication, helping to stimulate fibroblast activity and improve skin resilience. As a result, patients experience a noticeable improvement in skin tone, firmness, texture, and radiance over a course of treatments. Velora Skin Booster is suitable for use on the face, neck, décolletage, and hands, and is indicated for patients showing early signs of aging, dehydration, or loss of skin density. It may be used alone or as part of a comprehensive aesthetic treatment plan for optimal skin renewal.

description: Description Juvelook is an advanced hybrid filler that blends HA with Polylactic Acid (PLA). HA delivers deep hydration for an instant plumping effect, while PLA works beneath the surface to stimulate natural collagen production, providing long-lasting wrinkle reduction and skin renewal. Juvelook is CE marked. The result: Smoother, firmer, and more youthful looking skin. Juvelook contains KFDA-approved Poly DL-Kactide, a form of PLA that is known to stimulate the production of collagen in the skin. When injected, the PLA particles work to replace lost collagen and reinforce the skin’s structure. Over time, the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles will decrease as the skin’s collagen levels rise. HA helps to provide an immediate plumping effect, drawing moisture into the skin. When the effects of the HA wear off, the PLA continues to boost collagen synthesis. This means that the skin will gradually become smoother and look younger after the injection, with the results lasting up to 2 years. Main benefits: Long lasting anti aging affection Visible anti wrinkle effects Safe, non toxic, biodegradable Juvelook comes in powder form and needs to be diluted with distilled water and a numbing agent before use. Store at room temperature, avoiding excessive temperatures. Box contains 1 x 50ml

description: Description Stylage® Hydromax is an effective skin booster designed to improve hydration and overall skin appearance. It contains cross-linked hyaluronic acid to retain moisture and sorbitol to help protect the skin from damage caused by environmental factors. The treatment works by gently stimulating collagen and improving skin elasticity, helping the skin look smoother, firmer, and more refreshed. It is especially helpful for dry skin, fine lines, and dull or tired-looking complexions. Stylage® Hydromax can be used on the face, neck, décolletage, and hands, and is delivered through small microinjections into the skin. Most patients require 2–3 sessions for best results, with effects lasting around 6–9 months. This treatment is a great option for anyone looking for natural skin improvement and long-lasting hydration without changing facial volume.

description: Description What is NAD 3+? Lapiena NAD 3+ is an innovative all in one skin booster that combines NMN, NAD+, and Hyaluronic Acid (HA) to target skin health at multiple levels. HA delivers immediate hydration and visible plumping, while NMN and NAD+ support cellular energy, repair, and long term skin vitality. The formula is enhanced with powerful skin supporting actives. Polynucleotides promote skin regeneration and improved elasticity, Succinic Acid boosts cellular metabolism, and Tranexamic Acid helps reduce hyperpigmentation for a brighter, more even skin tone. Niacinamide strengthens the skin barrier and refines texture, while Glutathione provides antioxidant protection to enhance clarity and radiance. Why NAD 3+ and NMN work best together? description: Description RRS® HA Long Lasting is a sterile, resorbable dermal implant designed for skin revitalisation, long-lasting hydration, and improvement of early signs of skin ageing. Developed by Skin Tech Pharma Group, the product combines BDDE cross-linked hyaluronic acid with a protective amino acid buffer intended to support hydration, antioxidant protection, and dermal regeneration. RRS® HA Long Lasting is positioned within the category of hybrid skin boosters and biorevitalising injectables. It is commonly used to improve skin elasticity, superficial to moderate wrinkles, dermal atrophy, and photoaged skin. The formulation contains 21 mg/3 ml cross-linked hyaluronic acid together with 15 amino acids that help stabilise the HA while supporting tissue quality and hydration. The product is frequently selected for patients presenting with dull, dehydrated, lax, or prematurely aged skin, particularly in facial areas such as the cheeks, jawline, nasolabial folds, and marionette lines. Results may remain visible for approximately 9–12 months depending on patient-specific factors and treatment protocol. What RRS® HA Long Lasting Is Similar To RRS® HA Long Lasting is often compared with injectable skin boosters and biorevitalisers such as Profhilo and Jalupro Super Hydro due to its focus on hydration, skin quality improvement, and collagen-supportive activity. Like Profhilo®, RRS® HA Long Lasting uses hyaluronic acid to improve hydration and skin elasticity. However, RRS® HA Long Lasting incorporates an amino acid protective buffer and cross-linked HA structure intended to prolong hydration effects and support antioxidant activity. Compared with Jalupro Super Hydro, RRS® HA Long Lasting also combines HA with amino acids, but it is generally positioned more toward long-lasting hydration and dermal support rather than intensive collagen biostimulation alone. The product is additionally described by some distributors as a hybrid between a skin booster and a soft dermal filler due to its cross-linked HA composition. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications Manufacturer and distributor information indicates use for: Face Jawline Cheeks Chin Nasolabial folds Marionette lines Décolletage Hands Areas affected by photoaging and dermal atrophy Primary indications include: Skin hydration BioRevitalisation Improvement of skin elasticity Reduction of superficial and moderate wrinkles Support for photoaged skin Improvement of tired or dull skin appearance Usage / Administration (IFU-Only Section) According to publicly available manufacturer and distributor guidance: Recommended injection depth: deep dermis Suggested needle size: 30G needle Proposed maintenance schedule: 1–3 booster sessions may be performed depending on clinical outcome Injection volume per point: not provided by manufacturer Number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer The product should only be administered by qualified medical professionals under appropriate aseptic conditions. Some practitioners apply a “7-point technique”; however, this is not clearly established within the official manufacturer IFU guidance and may vary according to practitioner preference.

description: Description Hyalmass Aqua Exosome An innovative exosome-based hydrating product designed to achieve resilient and radiant skin, giving it an aqua-infused glow. It provides immediate hydration with hyaluronic acid, while PDRN and exosome ingredients support skin regeneration, enhancing the overall skin environment. What makes Hyalmass Aqua Exosome different from traditional hydration products? Hyaluronic acid + PDRN + Exosomes are added as key ingredients. Provides moisture replenishment to the skin in the short term. Helps with skin elasticity and regeneration in the long term Main Ingredients Hyaluronic Acid is a substance that exists in the human body, inducing cell differentiation and growth, providing and maintaining moisture in the skin. It can hold up to 1,000 times its weight in water, making it widely used in products aimed at maintaining skin elasticity and smooth texture Exosomes Exosomes are nano-sized vesicles produced and secreted by cells, generated in trace amounts during the process of culturing stem cells. They contain bioactive molecules such as genetic material and proteins. In the skin, exosomes stimulate fibroblasts to promote collagen production, exhibiting excellent anti-ageing and regenerative effects. Polydeoxyribonucleotide PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide) is a DNA fragment extracted from salmon semen, which has a composition most similar to human DNA. It helps in tissue regeneration by enabling continuous production of growth factors within the body. Activating the skin’s regeneration ability at the cellular level improves the skin environment and restores the skin structure, resulting in firmer and healthier skin. Method of Use Hyalmass Exosome can be used as a Topical product, with Microneedling and as a Mesotherapy (injection) product How to use: (Topical and Microneedling use) 1. Thoroughly clean and disinfect the application area before use. 2. Evenly apply the product to the treatment area. 3. To enhance absorption into the skin, you may use a derma roller or derma pen. (Microneedling) 4. Gently massage the area after application, taking care not to apply excessive pressure. Usage Protocol Topical use | Recommended to use 1 ml in the morning and 1 ml at night. Microneedling | Recommended to use 1 syringe with intervals of 3 weeks Mesotherapy | Recommended to use 3 times at intervals of 3-5 weeks Application Area | Suitable for all facial areas except around the eyes. If any adverse reactions occur during use, consult a specialist immediately.

Ninety Hilo is designed to redefine skin rejuvenation. With a high concentration of 90mg dual-phase hyaluronic acid (45mg H-HA + 45mg L-HA), this advanced formulation delivers surface hydration, deep repair, and structural support without the need for chemical crosslinkers.

The proprietary ABEP™ Technology (Acid-Base Equilibrium &amp; Redox Process) fuses High Molecular Weight HA and Low Molecular Weight HA into a stable hybrid complex. This ensures enhanced hydration, elasticity, and biocompatibility, with reduced risk of adverse reactions.

Enriched with Polynucleotides (PN from salmon DNA), Succinic Acid, and Copper Tripeptide-1, Ninety Hilo goes beyond hydration to stimulate collagen synthesis, accelerate healing, and protect skin from oxidative stress.

Key Benefits
Deep hydration and plumping effect
Improves skin firmness and elasticity
Promotes collagen synthesis for long-term rejuvenation
Strengthens the skin barrier and accelerates repair
Provides natural, radiant, and long-lasting results
Application Areas
Ninety Hilo is versatile and can be applied across multiple areas for targeted rejuvenation:

Cheekbones – lift and volumize
Nose Base – refine contour
Chin – enhance definition
Jawline – sculpt and firm
Temple – restore fullness
Neck – smooth lines and improve texture
Hands – restore hydration and youthful appearance
Treatment Methods
Ninety Hilo is compatible with a range of advanced treatment modalities, making it highly adaptable in clinic protocols:
MTS (Microneedle Therapy System) – for precise delivery and collagen induction
Derma-Roller – enhances penetration and skin texture improvement
RF &amp; Laser Devices – synergistic effect with energy-based treatments

description: Description PN Eyes is a polynucleotide eye booster designed specifically for the delicate under-eye area. Powered by medical-grade PN (Polynucleotides) derived from salmon DNA, this skin regeneration treatment supports collagen production, improves elasticity, and revitalises tired under-eye skin. Formulated with DNA-based regenerative ingredients, brightening actives, peptides, and hydration boosters, PN Eyes helps restore skin quality, reduce dark circles, smooth fine lines, and strengthen the fragile periorbital skin structure. Unlike traditional eye treatments that target only one concern, Lapiena PN Eyes delivers comprehensive under-eye rejuvenation, combining skin repair, brightening, hydration, and wrinkle improvement in one powerful PN skin booster solution. What is PN (Polynucleotide) Skin Booster? PN (Polynucleotides) are highly purified DNA fragments derived from salmon germ cells, sharing over 95% similarity with human DNA. Polynucleotides are MFDS-approved for wound healing and tissue repair after skin transplantation, making them a trusted ingredient for skin regeneration treatments. Stimulate fibroblast activity Boost collagen and elastin production Improve dermal density and skin thickness Support cellular repair and skin regeneration Reduce micro-inflammation How PN Eyes Improves the Skin’s Regenerative Environment PN Eyes enhances the skin’s regenerative micro-environment, creating optimal conditions for cellular repair and tissue recovery. Because the eye area has thin, fragile skin, PN provides a strong structural foundation for regeneration, helping restore healthy skin structure and improve overall skin quality. Key regenerative actions include Enhancing the skin’s natural repair process Supporting recovery of damaged skin tissue Improving skin elasticity and firmness Reducing micro-inflammation Strengthening delicate under-eye skin

jsonld.name: Relfydess™▼ (relabotulinumtoxinA) 100 units/ml 1.5ml Single Vial (POM) (cold chain)
jsonld.description:

Relfydess™▼ is indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate-to-severe glabellar lines at maximum frown and moderate-to-severe lateral canthal lines at maximum smile alone or in combination, in adult patients under 65 years, when the severity of these lines has an important psychological impact on the patient. Relfydess SmPC

 

Relfydess™ ▼ (RelabotulinumtoxinA) is the first and only ready-to-use liquid neuromodulator created with PEARL™ Technology, developed and manufactured by Galderma. Relfydess SmPC

 
Relfydess™▼ 100 units/mL solution for injection - Prescribing Information:
Relfydess▼ 100 units/mL solution for injection - Prescribing Information (Ireland) – alternative version
 
▼This medicinal product is subject to additional monitoring. This will allow quick identification of new safety information. Healthcare professionals are asked to report any suspected adverse reactions. See ‘Undesirable Effects’ for how to report adverse reactions.
 
Presentation: Each vial contains 150 units of botulinum toxin type A 100 units/mL manufactured from Clostridium botulinum in 1.5 mL of solution.
Indications: Relfydess is indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of: 
·       Moderate to severe glabellar lines at maximum frown
·       Moderate to severe lateral canthal lines seen at maximum smile 
alone or in combination, in adult patients under 65 years, when the severity of these lines has an important psychological impact on the patient. 
Dosage: The treatment interval should be no more frequently than every twelve weeks. The efficacy and safety of the repeated administration of this product has not been studied for more than 52 weeks. Consideration of the cumulative dose is necessary if other botulinum toxin products are being or have been used to treat other indications for those products. The potency units are specific to Relfydess and are not interchangeable with other preparations of botulinum toxin. Relfydess is ready-to-use with a concentration of 10 units per 0.1 mL and no reconstitution is required.
Dosing Instructions for Relfydess





Treatment(s)


Total Recommended Dose


Dose per injection




Glabellar Lines (GL)


50 units (0.5 mL) 


5 injections of 10 units (0.1 mL):
2 injections on each side at the corrugator muscle and 1 injection at the procerus muscle near the nasofrontal angle




Lateral Canthal Lines (LCL)


60 units (0.6 mL)


6 injections of 10 units (0.1 mL):
3 injections on each side at the orbicularis oculi muscle 




Combined treatment of Glabellar Lines and Lateral Canthal Lines


110 units (1.1 mL) 


11 injections total of 10 units (0.1 mL) for combined GL and LCL





General information
In the event of treatment failure or diminished effect following repeat injections, alternative treatment methods should be employed. In case of treatment failure after the first treatment session, the following approaches may be considered:
·       Analysis of the causes of failure, e.g. incorrect muscles injected, inappropriate injection technique, and formation of toxin-neutralising antibodies.
·       Re-evaluation of the relevance of treatment with botulinum toxin A.
Paediatric population: The safety and efficacy of Relfydess in children aged up to 18 years have not been established. The use of Relfydess is not recommended in patients under 18 years. 
Elderly population: There is limited phase 3 clinical data with Relfydess in patients 65 years and older.
Method of administration: Relfydess should only be administered by health care professionals with appropriate qualifications and expertise in this treatment and having the required equipment, in accordance with national guidelines and legislation. Intramuscular use. Dosing and treatment intervals depend on assessment of the individual patient’s response, but dosing should not exceed maximum doses allowed and the treatment interval should be at least 12 weeks. Each vial should be used for a single patient during a single treatment session only. Any residual product after the treatment should be discarded. Use aseptic technique and standard practice to prevent cross-infections. The median time to onset is 2 to 3 days, with some patients reporting an effect within 1 day. Treatment effect has been demonstrated for 6 months, with up to 75% of patients not returning to baseline. Glabellar lines: The recommended dose for the treatment of glabellar lines in adults is a total of 50 units/0.5 mL administered by intramuscular injection divided equally (10 units/0.1 mL per injection) into each of the 5 intramuscular injection sites: 2 injections on each side at the corrugator muscle and 1 injection at the procerus muscle near the nasofrontal angle. The anatomical landmarks can be more readily identified if palpated and observed at patient maximum frown. Before and during the injection, place the thumb or index finger firmly below the orbital rim in order to prevent extravasation below the orbital rim. The needle bevel should be pointed upward and medially during the injection. In order to reduce the risk of eyelid ptosis, the following steps should be taken:
·       Avoid injections near the levator palpebrae superioris muscle, particularly in patients with larger brow-depressor complexes.
·       Lateral corrugator injections should be placed at least 1 centimetre above the bony supraorbital ridge.
·       Ensure the injected dose (volume) is accurate. 
·       Avoid injecting closer than 1 centimetre above the central eyebrow.
Lateral canthal lines: The recommended dose for the treatment of lateral canthal lines in adults is a total of 60 units/0.6 mL administered by intramuscular injection divided equally into 10 units/0.1 mL into each of the 6 intramuscular injection sites: 3 injections (30 units/0.3 mL) on each side at the orbicularis oculi muscle. Injections should be given with the needle bevel-up and oriented away from the eye in the lateral orbicularis oculi muscle. When lines in the lateral canthal region appear both above and below the lateral canthus, inject above and below lateral canthus. In case lines in the lateral canthal region are mainly below the lateral canthus, inject per below lateral canthus. Lateral canthal line anatomical landmarks can be more readily identified if observed and palpated at maximal smile. Care must be taken to avoid injecting the zygomaticus major/minor muscles to avoid lateral mouth drop and asymmetrical smile. Glabellar lines/lateral canthal lines combined treatment: For combination treatment of glabellar lines and lateral canthal lines, the respective individual dosing and administration should be followed for a total dose of 110 units/1.1 mL of Relfydess. The recommended dose for the treatment of glabellar lines is 50 units/0.5 mL (10 units/0.1 mL per injection) into each of 5 intramuscular injection sites and for lateral canthal lines is 60 units/0.6 mL (10 units/0.1 mL in each of 6 intramuscular injection sites).
Contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to any botulinum toxin products or to any of the excipients. Presence of infection at the proposed injection sites. Presence of myasthenia gravis, Eaton Lambert Syndrome or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. 
Precautions and Warnings: General: Relfydess should not be injected into a blood vessel. As with all intramuscular injections, use of Relfydess is not recommended in patients who have a prolonged bleeding time. Patients treated with the recommended dose may experience exaggerated muscle weakness. Each vial of Relfydess must be used for a single patient treatment during a single session. Any excess of unused product must be disposed of and specific precautions must be taken for the inactivation and disposal of any unused solution. Hypersensitivity reactions: Serious and/or immediate hypersensitivity reactions have been reported for botulinum toxin products and anaphylactic reactions can occur very rarely (see ‘Undesirable Effects’). These reactions include anaphylaxis, serum sickness, urticaria, soft tissue oedema, and dyspnoea. Equipment and medications (including adrenaline) needed to treat anaphylaxis should therefore be readily available. If such a reaction occurs, further injection of Relfydess should be discontinued, and appropriate medical therapy immediately instituted. Spread of Toxin effect: Post-marketing safety data from other approved botulinum toxin products suggest that botulinum toxin effects (such as diplopia, blurred vision and ptosis) may be observed beyond the site of local injection (see section 4.8). In addition, adverse reactions possibly related to the spread of toxin effect distant from the site of injection have been reported very rarely with botulinum toxin and may include asthenia, generalised muscle weakness, dysphagia, dysphonia, dysarthria, urinary incontinence, and breathing difficulties. These symptoms are consistent with the mechanism of action of botulinum toxins and have been reported hours to weeks after injection. Swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening and there have been reports of death related to spread of toxin effects. Patients with pre-existing swallowing or breathing difficulties may be more susceptible to these complications. More specifically, following treatment with botulinum toxin, very rare cases of death have been reported in the context of patients who have dysphagia, pneumopathy, or significant asthenia. Therefore, Relfydess is not recommended in such patients. Patients or caregivers should be advised to seek immediate medical care if swallowing, speech or respiratory disorders arise. Pre-existing neuromuscular disorders: Relfydess should be used with caution in patients with a risk of, or clinical evidence of, marked defective neuro-muscular transmission. These patients may have an increased sensitivity to agents such as botulinum toxin, and excessive muscle weakness (including systemic effects of severe dysphagia and respiratory compromise) may follow treatment. In some of these cases, dysphagia has lasted several months and required placement of a gastric feeding tube. Pre-existing conditions at the injection site: Caution should be taken when Relfydess is used in the presence of inflammation at the proposed injection site(s) or when excessive weakness or atrophy is present in the targeted muscle(s). Caution should be used when Relfydess treatment is used in patients who have marked facial asymmetry, ptosis, excessive skin laxity (such as dermatochalasis), deep dermal scarring, or thick sebaceous skin. Ophthalmic adverse reactions: Dry eye, reduced tear production, reduced blinking, and corneal disorders may occur with the use of botulinum toxins. If symptoms of dry eye (e.g., eye irritation, photophobia, or visual changes) persist, consider referring the patient to an ophthalmologist. Increased lacrimation may occur with the use of botulinum toxins. Muscle atrophy: Muscle atrophy is expected after repeated botulinum treatment secondary to the flaccid paralysis of the treated muscles. Antibody formation: Injections at more frequent intervals or at higher doses may increase the risk of neutralising antibody formation to botulinum toxin. Clinically, the formation of neutralising antibodies may reduce the effectiveness of subsequent treatment. Traceability: In order to improve the traceability of biological medicinal products, the name and the batch number of the administered product should be clearly recorded. Potassium and Sodium content: This medicine contains potassium, less than 1 mmol (39 mg) per 150 units vial, i.e. essentially ‘potassium-free’. This medicine contains less than 1 mmol sodium (23 mg) per 150 units vial, i.e. essentially ‘sodium-free’. Polysorbate 80 content: This medicine contains 1.6 mg of polysorbate 80 per 150 units vial which is equivalent to 1.1 mg/mL. Polysorbates may cause allergic reactions.
Interactions: No drug interaction studies have been conducted. Concomitant treatment with Relfydess and aminoglycosides or other agents interfering with neuromuscular transmission (e.g. curare-like agents or other botulinum toxin products in other locations) should only be used with caution since the effect of botulinum toxin may be potentiated. 
Pregnancy, Breastfeeding and Fertility: Pregnancy: There are no adequate data from the use of botulinum toxin type A in pregnant women. Animal studies do not indicate direct or indirect harmful effects with respect to reproductive toxicity other than at high doses causing maternal toxicity. The potential risk for humans is unknown. Relfydess should not be used during pregnancy and in women of childbearing potential not using contraception. Breastfeeding: It is unknown if Relfydess is excreted in human milk. The excretion of Relfydess in milk has not been studied in animals.  Relfydess should not be used during breast-feeding. Fertility: There are no clinical data examining the effect of Relfydess on fertility.  There is no evidence of direct effect of botulinum toxin A on fertility in animal studies. 
Effects on ability to drive and use machines: Other botulinum toxin products have been reported to have a minor or moderate influence on the ability to drive and/or use machines. There is a potential risk of localised muscle weakness or visual disturbances linked with the use of Relfydess which may temporarily impair the ability to drive or operate machinery.
Undesirable Effects: The majority of adverse reactions reported after one treatment with Relfydess in subjects receiving ≥ 50 units in all placebo-controlled studies in the development program were of mild to moderate intensity. The most frequently reported adverse reactions were injection site reactions and headache occurring in approximately 7% and 5% of subjects, respectively. In general, treatment/injection technique-related reactions occurred within the first month following injection and were transient. When glabellar lines and lateral canthal lines were treated in combination, the nature and frequency of adverse reactions were comparable to what was observed when patients were treated for the individual indications. The following adverse reactions were observed in patients that were administered Relfydess for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines: Common (≥ 1/100 to < 1/10): Headache, eyelid ptosis, injection site reactions (e.g. bruising, swelling, pruritus, pain, discomfort,  haematoma, hypersensitivity and warmth), uncommon (≥ 1/1,000 to <1/100): Hypersensitivity, visual impairment, dry eye, asthenopia, brow ptosis, urticaria, muscular weakness, muscle spasm. The following adverse reactions were observed in patients that were administered Relfydess for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe lateral canthal lines: Common (≥ 1/100 to < 1/10): Headache, injection site reactions (e.g. erythema, pain, and bruising), uncommon (≥ 1/1,000 to <1/100): Hypersensitivity, dry eye, asthenopia, swelling of eyelid, muscular weakness.
 
Prescribers should consult the summary of product characteristics for further details.

jsonld.name: Teosyal Redensity ONE  (2 x 1ml) Puresense
jsonld.description: TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 1 is a sterile, transparent, non-pyrogenic, viscoelastic gel made of non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid (HA) of non-animal origin (from HA mean molecular weight higher than 1 million Dalton), and contains 0.3% by mass of lidocaine hydrochloride, for its anesthetic properties. Each box contains one or two pre-filled syringes of TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 1. For each syringe, the box contains two sterile 30G1/2’’ needles and two traceability labels (one to be given to the patient, and one to be kept by the doctor in the patient medical records). The volume of gel in each syringe is indicated on the cardboard box as well on each syringe.Hyaluronic acid is a major constituent of the ground substance of the dermal extracellular matrix. A genuine molecular sponge, its helicoidal structure enables it to trap up to a thousand times its weight in water. It is widely distributed in cutaneous tissue and hydrates the skin, though its content diminishes with age. As the skin becomes thinner and fragile, initial skin fracture lines appear. Thanks to its marked fluidity and its viscoelastic properties, TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 1 is evenly distributed. This characteristic ensures that an optimal level of dermal hydration is maintained and leads to a lasting improvement in the skin's texture and elasticity.TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 1 is a biodegradable implant that is progressively resorbed over time. The estimated lifetime of TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 1 is at least 3 months. The duration of the treatment depends on several factors including skin type, the severity of the wrinkle to be treated, the injection area, the volume injected, the patient’s physiology and lifestyle.In their aesthetic indications, TEOSYAL® products do not have an intended medical purpose. Therefore, the non-medical benefit of TEOSYAL® devices is understood as clinical performance. Overall, 70 to 100% of patients experienced an aesthetic improvement of the treated area following the injection, based on data collected throughout clinical studies program.

jsonld.description: TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 2 is a sterile, transparent, non-pyrogenic, viscoelastic gel made of hyaluronic acid (HA) of non-animal origin and of mean molecular weight higher than 1 million Dalton. It is crosslinked with BDDE (1,4-Butanediol diglycidyl ether), and contains 0.3% by mass of lidocaine hydrochloride, for its anesthetic properties. Each box contains two pre-filled syringes of TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 2. For each syringe, the box contains two sterile 30G1/2” needles and two traceability labels (one to be given to the patient, and one to be kept by the doctor in the patient medical records). The volume of gel in each syringe is indicated on the cardboard box as well on each syringe.Hyaluronic acid is a major constituent of the ground substance of the dermal extracellular matrix. A genuine molecular sponge, its helicoidal structure enables it to trap up to a thousand times its weight in water. It is widely distributed in cutaneous tissue and hydrates the skin, though its content diminishes with age. As the skin becomes thinner and fragile, initial skin fracture lines appear. Thanks to its malleability and its specific viscoelastic properties, TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 2 is evenly distributed into the tissues injected. This characteristic ensures that an optimal level of dermal hydration is maintained and leads to a long-lasting improvement in the skin’s elasticity. TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 2 creates a volume that corrects fine lines/wrinkles and restores skin hydration.TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 2 is a biodegradable implant that is progressively resorbed over time. The estimated lifetime of TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 2 is at least 12 months. The duration of the treatment depends on several factors including skin type, the severity of the wrinkle to be treated, the injection area, the volume injected, the patient’s physiology and lifestyle. The injector will decide if a touch-up session may be required for optimal results.In their aesthetic indications, TEOSYAL® products do not have an intended medical purpose. Therefore, the non-medical benefit of TEOSYAL® devices is understood as clinical performance. Overall, 70 to 100% of patients experienced an aesthetic improvement of the treated area following the injection, based on data collected throughout clinical studies program.
